title: Prodavač/ka -  Nový Smíchov
description:
Úkolem Asistenta prodeje Skechers je poskytnout vynikající zákaznický servis. Hledáme Asistenty prodeje, kteří jsou nadšení a vstřícní, odborníci na produkty Skechers a usilující o spokojenost zákazníků.

Náplň práce

  • Podpora prodeje prostřednictvím vynikajícího zákaznického servisu
  • Být odborníkem na naše produkty a působit jako velvyslanec značky Skechers ve všech oblastech a využívní těchto znalostí k tomu, aby si zákazníci vybrali ten správný produkt
  • Neustále zajišťovat správnou úroveň zásob, merchandising, skladování a úklid - cokoli, co je třeba k vytvoření prvotřídního zážitku z nakupování pro zákazníka
  • Efektivní zpracování zákaznických transakcí, slev atd. Na prodejně. Profesionální přijem vráceného zboží a podpoa výměny nebo nabídnutí alternativy, pro spokojenost zákazníka
  • Udržuje si aktuální znalosti o nejnovějších produktech společnosti Skechers

Dovednosti, kvalifikace a zkušenosti

  • Rád je součástí týmu a ke každému spolupracovníkovi se chová s respektem a pozitivně.
  • Předchozí zkušenosti v maloobchodě, restauraci nebo pohostinství jsou výhodou, ale ne podmínkou
  • Časovou flexibilitu
  • Flexibilní a motivovaný poskytovat vynikající služby zákazníkům
  • Silný smysl pro detail

Co Vám můžeme nabídnout

• Konkurenceschopný plat a balíček výhod

• Příležitosti pro kariérní růst a rozvoj

• Zábavné a dynamické pracovní prostředí

O společnosti Skechers:

Společnost Skechers (NYSE: SKX), globální značka z žebříčku Fortune 500®, vyvíjí a prodává rozmanitou řadu lifestylové a výkonnostní obuvi, oblečení a doplňků. Základem všeho, co děláme, je vývoj komfortních technologií - dodáváme stylové, inovativní a kvalitní výrobky. Společnost Skechers, která obsluhuje více než 180 zemí a teritorií, spojuje zákazníky s výrobky prostřednictvím obchodních a specializovaných prodejen, e-shopů a digitálních obchodů a prostřednictvím více než 5 200 maloobchodních míst vlastněných společností a třetími stranami. Společnost Skechers, která sídlí v jižní Kalifornii, má kanceláře a distribuční centra po celém světě, již 30 let pomáhá lidem všech věkových kategorií vypadat a cítit se dobře.

Co Vám můžeme nabídnout

WHO WE ARE:
Headquartered in Southern California, Skechers—the Comfort Technology Company®—has spent over 30 years helping men, women, and kids everywhere look and feel good. Comfort innovation is at the core of everything we do, driving the development of stylish, high-quality products at a great value. From our diverse footwear collections to our expanding range of apparel and accessories, Skechers is a complete lifestyle brand.

Be You - Feel Welcome

Skechers recognises the importance and power of diversity within our business. We ensure that our people processes are fair, transparent and promote equality of opportunity for all employees and job applicants.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities or health conditions, who are otherwise qualified for the job position, to perform the essential functions as detailed above.

title: BCS Business Card Consultant - Charlotte
description:
At U.S. Bank, we’re on a journey to do our best. Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions and enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.

Job Description

Develops profitable business account relationships and increased profitability from existing and new accounts. Identifies business opportunities based on knowledge of clients, markets, products and services. Makes sales presentations to existing and/or prospective clients informing them of benefits of using the organization's products and services to meet their needs. Implements and maintains an effective referral network and call program to promote sales

Basic Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree, or equivalent work experience
- Seven to nine or more years of relevant work experience
- Ability to travel (local and regional, some national)

Preferred Skills/Experience

- Prior experience in business card sales/payments

- Well-developed sales and new business development skills, including the development of sales strategies and goals and closing skills

- Demonstrated ability to build a book of business from the ground up through proactive prospecting and developing and leveraging Centers of Influence (COIs) to generate new business opportunities

- Experience working with businesses with $2.5MM+ in annual revenue

- Strong credit analysis and financial assessment skills, with understanding of basic accounting principles related to financial transactions

- Proven success developing and leveraging Centers of Influence (COIs) to generate new business opportunities

- Demonstrated ability to manage pipeline activity with strong follow‑up and execution discipline

- Solid knowledge of payment products, with general understanding of product marketing and organizational operations

- Strong customer relationship management skills, including negotiation, decision‑making, and creative problem resolution

- Experience using Salesforce or similar CRM tools to manage leads, activities, and sales performance

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate a disability during any portion of the application or hiring process, please refer to our disability accommodations for applicants.

Benefits:

Our approach to benefits and total rewards considers our team members’ whole selves and what may be needed to thrive in and outside work. That's why our benefits are designed to help you and your family boost your health, protect your financial security and give you peace of mind. Our benefits include the following:

  • Healthcare (medical, dental, vision)

  • Basic term and optional term life insurance

  • Short-term and long-term disability

  • Pregnancy disability and parental leave

  • 401(k) and employer-funded retirement plan

  • Paid vacation (from two to five weeks depending on salary grade and tenure)

  • Up to 11 paid holiday opportunities

  • Adoption assistance

  • Sick and Safe Leave accruals of one hour for every 30 worked, up to 80 hours per calendar year unless otherwise provided by law

Review our full benefits available by employment status here.

U.S. Bank is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, religion, color, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or veteran status, and other factors protected under applicable law.

E-Verify

U.S. Bank participates in the U.S. Department of Homeland Security E-Verify program in all facilities located in the United States and certain U.S. territories. The E-Verify program is an Internet-based employment eligibility verification system operated by the U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services. Learn more about the E-Verify program.

The salary range reflects figures based on the primary location, which is listed first. The actual range for the role may differ based on the location of the role. In addition to salary, U.S. Bank offers a comprehensive benefits package, including incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase 401(k) contribution and pension (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). Pay Range: $103,950.00 - 127,050.00

U.S. Bank will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records for employment. U.S. Bank conducts background checks consistent with applicable local laws, including the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance and the California Fair Chance Act as well as the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
QA Engineer -AI & Engineering

Join our AI & Engineering team in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology & data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements.

Engineering as a Service provides complete design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise. We transform engineering teams, modernize technology, and deliver complex programs with a product engineering approach. Our flexible delivery models-traditional teams, pools, or pods-are tailored to each client's needs, offering engineering-led advisory, implementation, and operational capabilities to accelerate innovation.

Work You'll Do

As a SDET II, you will bring considerable technical expertise to deliver effective solutions to clients including the following:
  • Acting as an individual contributor with strong hands-on QA skills, working directly with clients and our Deloitte teams.
  • Helping to create testing solutions to meet our clients' business needs.
  • Working as a valued member of the QA team, testing of custom technology solutions.

Required Qualifications and Experience
  • 4+ years' relevant consulting or industry experience.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering or a related field.
  • 3+ years hands-on experience defining the testing strategy for large scale programs and ensuring requirements traceability throughout the system development lifecycle. Experience should include leading the testing efforts, including experience with all phases of testing: system integration, user acceptance, and performance testing.
  • Experience with at least two of the following: TOSCA, TMO, mobile testing, automation testing, SAP testing, data testing in a client-facing or industry role.
  • 3+ years' experience driving the quality assurance processes and gaining delivery and buy-in from executive leadership.
  • Experience with Test and Defect Management tools - MicroFocus, ALM, JIRA.
  • 3+ years' experience working in a testing role in different environments including the following: client server, service-oriented architecture, web-based, mainframe-based and three-tier architectures.
  • Experience with the following: MicroFocus UFT, Rational Tooling, and Open Source Automation Tools such as Selenium, Cucumber, OpSoapUI, PostMan, RESTAssured, Mockito.
  • Experience in at least one Scripting language - Shell, VBScript, Perl or Python.
  • Experience with Source Control Systems - SVN or GIT.
  • Experience with Build tools - Maven, CircleCI.
  • Experience with Automated Reporting.
  • Experience with Cloud testing, API testing
  • Experience with CI/CD/CT tools - Jenkins, Bamboo, Quickbuild.
  • Ability to travel up to 50% of the time, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred Qualifications and Experience
  • Experience working with robotics solutions such as UIPath, AutomationAnywhere or BluePrism.
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools to expedite the testing process, to gain efficiencies and to streamline testing operations.
  • Experience working in Cloud, Web and Mobile Testing platforms - Saucelabs, Browerstack are preferred.
  • Hands-on experience with machine learning models.
  • Experience in Python NLTK or similar natural language processing technology.
  • Experience implementing testing best practices specific to the test planning and execution processes and gaining buy-in for changes from executives.
  • A deep understanding of testing planning and associated delivery challenges.
  • A strong understanding of the various approaches used in testing techniques - white-box, black-box, load testing, coverage testing and regression testing.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $82,600 to $162,800. You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, the individual, and organizational performance.

Information for applicants with a need for accommodation: https://www2.deloitte.com/us/en/pages/careers/articles/join-deloitte-assistance-for-disabled-applicants.html

title: Program Associate
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Program Associate based in the United States.

This role offers the opportunity to drive operational excellence within a fast-growing, technology-enabled hospitality environment.
The Program Associate will support the execution of strategic initiatives that improve processes, tools, and team performance.
Working across operations, product, and program teams, this position transforms ideas into scalable solutions.
The role combines project coordination, change management, documentation, and data-driven improvement.
The ideal candidate enjoys solving complex problems, learning quickly, and bringing structure to evolving environments.
This is a highly collaborative opportunity for someone passionate about innovation, operational impact, and continuous improvement.
Remote flexibility, ownership, and exposure to cross-functional projects make this role ideal for a proactive generalist.

Accountabilities:

The Program Associate will support the successful delivery, adoption, and optimization of operational initiatives by coordinating projects, improving workflows, and ensuring teams have the tools and knowledge needed to succeed. This role requires strong organization, communication, and analytical skills to connect strategy with execution.

  • Own the execution of assigned operational projects from initial planning through implementation, rollout, and adoption.
  • Review, update, and improve standard operating procedures and operational documentation to ensure clarity, accuracy, and usability.
  • Lead change management activities by identifying impacted teams, supporting training efforts, and monitoring adoption after launches.
  • Partner with program leaders, operational teams, and product stakeholders to translate business needs into actionable solutions and requirements.
  • Use AI-powered tools to improve documentation processes, automate operational checks, and identify workflow improvements.
  • Act as a bridge between frontline teams and strategic initiatives by collecting feedback, identifying challenges, and recommending improvements.
  • Define project success metrics, track outcomes, and use operational data to evaluate performance and support decision-making.
  • Maintain clear communication with stakeholders through regular updates, documentation, and progress reporting.
  • Support product and tooling improvements by helping identify operational pain points and contributing to solution design.
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining attention to detail, deadlines, and quality standards.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate is a proactive, adaptable professional who enjoys working across multiple teams and turning ambiguous challenges into structured solutions. They should combine project coordination experience with strong communication skills, analytical thinking, and comfort working in technology-driven environments.

    • 2+ years of experience in operations, project coordination, hospitality, or a related field.
    • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience preferred.
    • Experience managing multiple projects, priorities, and stakeholders in a dynamic environment.
    • Strong change management skills, including experience rolling out new processes, tools, or workflows and driving adoption.
    • Data-oriented mindset with the ability to analyze operational information, measure outcomes, and identify improvement opportunities.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create clear updates, documentation, and recommendations.
    • Comfortable learning new technologies and using tools such as Google Suite, Notion, AI platforms, and collaboration tools.
    • Strong organizational skills and the ability to proactively manage timelines, risks, and project details.
    • Ability to travel occasionally to operational locations for implementation, testing, and onsite support.
    • Experience in a startup, high-growth environment, hospitality operations, short-term rentals, or product collaboration is a plus.
    • Familiarity with dashboards, reporting tools, process improvement methodologies, or technical team collaboration is beneficial.

      • Benefits:

      • Competitive base salary range of $60,000–$70,000 depending on experience, skills, market conditions, and business needs.
      • Potential eligibility for equity, bonuses, additional perks, and travel-related benefits.
      • Fully remote work flexibility with the ability to work from various locations.
      • Travel credits allowing employees to enjoy complimentary stays and discounts.
      • Generous stock option plan designed to encourage ownership and long-term participation.
      • Flexible paid time off policy to support work-life balance.
      • 401(k) retirement plan.
      • Comprehensive health insurance coverage.
      • Additional perks such as home office support, internet stipend, mobile phone reimbursement, and other employee benefits.
      • Opportunities for professional development, learning, and career growth.

title: Senior Test Analyst (IT)
description:
Overview

As a Senior Test Analyst at Linesight, you will work with highly experienced, culturally diverse, and passionate teams nurturing a strong social dynamic and a shared sense of achievement. You will gain vast industry experience that will open doors for you, extend your skillset and expand your perspective. We will empower, support, and enable you to take real responsibility in your role so that you can take charge of your career progression with us. For us lasting trusted relationships are everything, both with our teams and our clients.

The successful candidate will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing testing activities across a diverse portfolio of projects, working closely with business stakeholders, project teams, developers, product owners, and third-party vendors. The role will play a key part in ensuring quality is embedded throughout the delivery lifecycle while supporting multiple concurrent initiatives.

This is an excellent opportunity for a testing professional who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment, influencing quality outcomes, and contributing to strategic business transformation programmes.

The Opportunity

In this role you will:

  • Plan, design, and execute functional, integration, system, regression, and end-to-end testing across multiple projects and releases.
  • Develop and maintain test strategies, test plans, test scenarios, and test cases to ensure comprehensive test coverage.
  • Review and validate business requirements and acceptance criteria to ensure solutions meet business needs and are testable.
  • Support and coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT), working closely with business stakeholders to achieve successful outcomes.
  • Identify, manage, and communicate testing risks, issues, and dependencies throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Manage defect tracking and resolution, working collaboratively with development and project teams to drive timely fixes.
  • Provide clear reporting on testing progress, quality metrics, risks, and release readiness.
  • Build strong relationships with Business Analysts, Product Owners, Developers, Architects, Project Managers, and business stakeholders.
  • Support the delivery of strategic initiatives across Salesforce, Data Platform, workforce management solutions, integrations, and business transformation projects.
  • Champion a quality-first approach, ensuring testing is embedded throughout the delivery lifecycle.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of testing processes, governance, standards, and best practices.
  • Identify opportunities to improve testing efficiency through automation, reusable test assets, and process enhancements.

We would love to hear from you if you have:

  • 5+ years' experience in software testing or quality assurance roles.
  • Strong experience in functional, system, integration, regression, UAT and end-to-end testing.
  • Experience working within Agile and/or hybrid project delivery environments.
  • Proven ability to manage testing activities across multiple concurrent projects.
  • Strong defect management and root-cause analysis skills.
  • Experience working with test management and defect tracking tools (e.g., Azure DevOps, Jira, TestRail).
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently while managing competing priorities.

Desirable:

  • Experience testing Salesforce platforms.
  • Experience testing data migration, integration, and data platform solutions.
  • Experience working on enterprise transformation programmes.
  • Exposure to API and integration testing.
  • Knowledge of test automation principles and frameworks.
  • ISTQB Foundation or Advanced Certification.

All interviews are conducted either in person or virtually with video required.

#LI-AP2

About us

Linesight is a highly successful global project and cost management consultancy that keeps clients coming back. And for that we have our people to thank. You see we’re not like the others. We’re different. Unique. It’s our fresh thinking and focus on what matters that has led to our evolving. We are on a journey working in some of the most exciting innovative sectors with some of the world’s most prestigious companies delivering major projects that deliver a more sustainable built environment. We have an open culture and a flat structure where you can expect to be treated with genuine care, respect, and empathy. With Linesight, you can truly discover the power of team!

Diversity, inclusion and accessibility

Linesight is committed to transparent, equal opportunity employment practices. We are building a diverse and inclusive organisation, accessible to all, based on having a safe culture which enables all our people to be their true selves. We are a people business, and we understand that the more inclusive we are, the happier our people and better our work will be. If you require assistance or accommodation of any kind, please mention this in your application, we would love to hear from you!

title: Vice President Physician Operations – Primary Care, Women’s & Children’s, and Medical Specialties
description:
Lead the future of ambulatory care at Logan Health.

Logan Health is seeking an experienced, visionary healthcare executive to serve as our Vice President of Physician Operations – Primary Care, Women's & Children's, and Medical Specialties. This newly created executive leadership role will provide strategic and operational oversight for a diverse portfolio of physician practices and ambulatory services, ensuring exceptional patient care, provider engagement, operational excellence, and sustainable growth.

As a key member of the leadership team, you will partner closely with physicians, advanced practice providers, clinic leaders, and executive leadership to shape the future of outpatient care across our integrated health system. This is an exciting opportunity to influence strategy, expand access to care, strengthen provider relationships, and drive innovation while making a meaningful impact on the communities we serve throughout northwest Montana.



Our Mission: Quality, compassionate care for all.

Our Vision: Reimagine health care through connection, service and innovation.

Our Core Values: Be Kind | Trust and Be Trusted | Work Together | Strive for Excellence.





What You'll Do

As the Vice President of Physician Operations, you will:

  • Provide executive leadership for Primary Care, Women's & Children's, and Medical Specialty clinic operations.

  • Develop and execute strategic initiatives that improve patient access, operational performance, provider engagement, and clinical excellence.

  • Partner with physician and administrative leaders to achieve organizational goals while fostering collaboration across the health system.

  • Lead business growth initiatives, clinic development, and operational optimization to support the future of ambulatory care.

  • Oversee financial performance, budgeting, productivity, quality metrics, patient experience, and operational outcomes.

  • Champion a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, accountability, and exceptional service.

  • Ensure compliance with regulatory, accreditation, quality, and patient safety standards.

  • Represent Logan Health in strategic planning efforts and help navigate the evolving healthcare landscape, including payer dynamics and market opportunities.


What You'll Bring

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, Management, or a related field.

  • Master's degree preferred.

  • Minimum of eight (8) years of progressive leadership experience.

  • Minimum of five (5) years of healthcare or physician practice leadership experience.

Ideal Candidate

We're looking for an accomplished healthcare executive who demonstrates:

  • Proven success leading large, complex physician practices or ambulatory operations.

  • Strong strategic planning and operational leadership abilities.

  • Experience driving physician engagement, clinic growth, and organizational performance.

  • Financial acumen with experience managing operating and capital budgets.

  • Exceptional relationship-building, communication, and collaboration skills.

  • Ability to lead through change while inspiring high-performing teams.

  • A commitment to patient-centered care, quality improvement, and service excellence.

  • Integrity, empathy, sound judgment, and a passion for developing leaders.

Why Logan Health?

At Logan Health, our mission extends beyond healthcare—we are committed to improving the health, comfort, and life of every person we serve. As an integrated healthcare system serving communities across northwest Montana, we offer the opportunity to lead meaningful change while enjoying an unmatched quality of life.

Nestled in the beautiful Flathead Valley, you'll enjoy access to Glacier National Park, Flathead Lake, Whitefish Mountain Resort, and endless year-round outdoor recreation, all while helping shape the future of healthcare for our region.

If you're an innovative healthcare leader who thrives on building strong partnerships, leading high-performing teams, and advancing physician operations, we invite you to join us in making a lasting impact.


Lead with purpose. Inspire excellence. Transform care. Apply today.

Shift:

Day Shift - Variable Hours (United States of America)

Schedule:

Logan Health operates 24 hours per day, seven days per week. Schedules are set to accommodate the requirements of the position and the needs of the organization and may be adjusted as needed.

  • Criminal background check

  • Reference checks

  • Drug Screening

  • Health and Immunizations Screening

  • Physical Demand Review/Screening

Equal Opportunity Employer

Logan Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE/AA/M-F/Vet/Disability). We encourage all qualified individuals to apply for employment. We do not discriminate against any applicant or employee based on protected veteran status, race, color, gender, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, age, disability or any other basis protected by applicable law. title: Customer Experience Specialist
description:
Ready to build your future? We're Groundworks, North America's leading foundation repair and water management specialist. We're more than a company - we're a team driven by purpose. As a Top Workplace, we're looking for top talent to fuel our mission: to protect, repair, and improve our customers’ greatest asset – their home.

But what makes us a great place to work? Here, you'll find real career growth, comprehensive and affordable benefits, a culture that values hard work and innovation, and company ownership equity. Whether you’re starting your career or looking for your next big move, we offer hands-on training, advancement opportunities, and the chance to make a real impact every day.

Join us and lay the foundation for your success. Apply today!

Position Summary

The Customer Experience (CX) Specialist serves as the central point of communication between our customers, technicians, and office team. While this role includes traditional dispatch responsibilities, it is centered around delivering an exceptional customer experience from the first phone call through job completion.

A successful CX Specialist is a proactive problem solver who can think critically, communicate effectively, and make sound decisions that support both our customers and our business. This role requires balancing technician efficiency with customer satisfaction while ensuring every interaction reflects our commitment to excellence.

Earn what you're worth! This position includes a $20.00/hour base wage plus uncapped commission. If you're competitive, goal-oriented, and motivated by performance, this is your opportunity to build a rewarding career with an industry leader.

Beyond competitive pay, Groundworks offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) with company match, and paid training. After six months, every employee becomes eligible for our Employee Ownership Program (ESOP), giving you the opportunity to share in the company's long-term success while building your own career.

This is a full-time, 40-hour-per-week position operating on a rotating schedule of four (4) consecutive workdays followed by three (3) consecutive days off. Due to the nature of the role, candidates must have flexibility to work varying shifts, including weekends, as scheduled. Weekend availability is required as part of the regular rotation.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Experience

  • Deliver an exceptional experience on every customer interaction.

  • Listen actively to customer concerns and provide thoughtful, solution-oriented responses.

  • Resolve customer issues whenever possible while escalating complex situations appropriately.

  • Build trust and confidence through clear, professional communication.

  • Follow up with customers to ensure concerns have been resolved and expectations exceeded.

Dispatch Operations

  • Schedule and dispatch technicians based on skill set, certifications, availability, and geographic efficiency.

  • Continuously monitor technician boards and adjust schedules throughout the day to maximize productivity.

  • Prioritize emergency calls while maintaining an efficient daily schedule.

  • Communicate schedule updates and changes with technicians in real time.

  • Coordinate with field leadership to ensure successful execution of the daily workload.

Business Support

Category Strategy: Product / Brand Objectives

  • Drive category growth (category-first mindset) and achieve/exceed annual sales and commercial spend targets.
  • Maintain and manage profitable growth to drive market share gains.
  • Collaborate with Wholesaler CAM (s) to develop customer promotion plans for Indirect Retailers based on distribution, category trends, and promotional activities.

  • Build and maintain strong business relationships internally with cross-functional partners & teammates as well as externally with customer personnel.

  • Utilize data and reporting tools to support 4P (Product, Price, Place, Promotion) objectives and provide actionable insights.

Integrated Approach: Team & Cross-Functional Communication

  • Partner with CAM on forecast, trade, and events.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor’s degree required (business-related preferred), and minimum of 2 years of relevant sales experience is required.
  • Analyst and customer-facing project experience preferred (an ideal candidate is someone with at least two of three roles - an NRS role, an Analyst role, an Associate role and have experience with some level of customer interaction to showcase strong analytical, communication and interpersonal skills).
  • Strong ability for collaboration, courage, speed, and agility; being a productive team player.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Teams, Outlook, Excel, and PowerPoint) and ability to work in various operating systems (i.e., customer portals).
  • Strategic analytical skills; experience with data sources and such as Power BI, Circana, & Nielsen
  • Skilled in business mathematics.

  • Knowledge of sales fundamentals: pricing, promotion, assortment, merchandising, and financial reconciliation.
  • Ability to create compelling, fact-based selling stories and customer plans.
  • Ability to resolve issues promptly and communicate potential impacts to stakeholders.

title: Vice President, Structured Credit Trading - London or Madrid | SCIB
description:
Vice President, Structured Credit Trading - London or Madrid | SCIB

Country: United Kingdom

Join our community.

Santander Corporate & Investment Banking (SCIB) is Santander's global division that supports some of the world's most complex and sophisticated corporate and institutional clients, offering customised services and value-added wholesale products to best meet their needs.

The SCIB Global Markets team is looking for an established VP to join the Structured Credit Trading team in London or Madrid.

We are offering a rare opportunity to join a fast-growing global trading franchise with an established track record in credit and hybrid markets. We’re shaping the way we work through innovation, cutting-edge technology, collaboration and the freedom to explore new ideas.

The difference you’ll make:

  • Pricing, executing and hedging structured credit and hybrid transactions, including repacks and Credit Linked Notes (CLNs)

  • Actively managing and monitoring trading risk, dynamically adjusting positions to optimise portfolio performance and maintain risk limits

  • Mentoring and training less experienced team members, supporting their technical development and enhancing team capability

  • Creating, maintaining and improving trading monitoring tools

  • Contributing to new product development initiatives in collaboration with Quantitative Analysts, Structurers, and Support and Control functions

What you’ll bring:

Our people are our greatest strength. Every individual contributes unique perspectives that make us stronger as a team and as an organisation. We’re enabling teams to go beyond by valuing who they are and empowering what they bring.

The following requirements represent the knowledge, skills, and abilities essential for success in this role.

  • Extensive experience in a Credit, Hybrids, Structured Rates or XVA trading/structuring/quant role

  • Proven ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced trading environment

  • Well-developed problem-solving skills

  • Higher qualification, or equivalent, in Maths, Statistics, Physics, Computer Science, Economics or similar

  • Entrepreneurial, delivery-oriented mindset

It would also be nice for you to have:

  • Fluency in Spanish or another European language

  • Familiarity with AI-augmented coding tools

What else you need to know:

This role can be based at our offices in London or Madrid.

We want our people to thrive at work and home, and also be able to deliver the best outcomes for our customers and to help each other develop.

Equal Opportunities.

Santander is proud of being an organization where there are equal opportunities regardless of age, gender, disability, civil status, race, religion or sexual orientation. We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible application process for all candidates.


How we’ll reward you.

Your contribution matters, and it’s recognised. You can expect a fair, competitive reward package that reflects the impact you create and the value you deliver.

As well as a competitive salary, you’ll enjoy a benefits package that you can tailor to your needs.

  • Eligible for a discretionary performance-related annual bonus.

  • We put 8% of salary into your pension, even if you don’t contribute yourself. We’ll pay in up to 12.5% of salary, if you contribute as well, and you can take some of our contribution in cash if you prefer.

  • 30 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, which increases to 31 days after 5yrs service, with the option to purchase up to 5 contractual days per year.

  • Company funded individual private medical insurance.

  • Voluntary healthcare benefits at discounted rates such as private medical insurance for your family, dental insurance, and health assessments.

  • Protection for you and your family, with company-funded death-in-service benefit and income protection insurance, and the option to take advantage of discounted rates for additional life assurance and critical illness cover.

  • Share in Santander’s success by saving or investing in our share plans.

Learn more about our benefits and family friendly policies

title: Project Finance Associate I
description:
What We're Looking For

At HNTB, you can create a career that is meaningful to you while building communities that matter to all of us. For more than a century, we have been delivering solutions for some of the largest, most complex infrastructure projects across the country. With our historic growth, it is an exciting time to join our team of employee-owners.

This opportunity entails being responsible for maintaining project-related financial data in HNTB's project management system, ensuring alignment with current client contracts, including change orders, subconsultant agreements, and approved unauthorized work. The Project Finance Associate supports the project finance team to ensure billing compliance with contractual documents. Responsibilities include coding project costs, such as subconsultant expenses, expense report receipts, and vendor invoices, with appropriate project accounting codes in accordance with standard procedures and contractual requirements to ensure proper entry into HNTB's project management system.

What You’ll Do:

  • Accurately updates the project management system by translating client and project workplan data based on contract and change order review.
  • Facilitates the ability to access and charge to project tasks and phases in the project management system.
  • Ensures project costs are properly coded and allocated by maintaining awareness of project status and adapting financial data as needed due to project changes.
  • Manages cost transfers to and from projects/tasks.
  • Supports the project finance team in reviewing and approving project invoices, updating invoice requirements from contractual documents, verifying billed costs, and ensuring compliance with reporting requirements, including insurance certificates and adherence to client systems and formats.
  • Generates routine internal project financial performance reports for project and office teams.
  • Reviews vendor/subconsultant invoices for accuracy and contractual compliance, including DBE and insurance certificate requirements.
  • Obtains necessary approvals and tracks internal workflow status for timely outcomes.
  • Supports the project team in maintaining client and subconsultant relationships and communicates receivables updates as directed by the finance team.
  • Assists in subcontracting processes throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Supports the proposal process, including gross margin analysis, cost proposal development, alignment with the project management system, and client proposal/estimate formats.
  • Performs other assigned duties.

What You’ll Need:

  • Associate’s degree, or
  • In lieu of education, 2 years of relevant work experience

What You'll Bring:

  • Developing knowledge of HNTB processes and procedures as well as GAAP accounting rules

title: 시니어 소프트웨어 엔지니어
description:
About

[서비스 소개]
What’s Your Favorite?
문토는 더 많은 사람들이 취향을 통해 나를 발견하고 서로 연결될 수 있도록 돕는 관심사 기반 커뮤니티 플랫폼입니다.

영화, 전시, 러닝, 등산, 카페 투어 등 평소 즐기던 취향부터 새로운 관심사까지. 문토는 관심사 기반의 커뮤니티 활동을 통해 많은 사람들이 매일 반복되는 단조로운 생활을 넘어 일상을 보다 풍성하게 채워 나갈 수 있도록 돕습니다.

누군가의 근사한 저녁 시간을 만들고, 취향이 통하는 친구를 선물하고, 새로운 취향을 통해 새로운 세계를 발견하게 하는 것. 우리가 하는 일은 사람들의 매일을 바꾸는 멋진 일입니다.

문토 팀은 고객이 사랑하는 서비스를 만들어가겠다는 지향을 가지고 프로덕트를 만들고 있으며, 관심사 기반 커뮤니티 플랫폼으로 빠르게 성장하고 있습니다.

앞으로도 문토는 더 많은 사람들이 관심사 기반 연결을 통해 일상이 더 풍성해질 수 있도록 돕겠다는 미션에 집중하며, 소셜라이징부터 정보 공유, 마켓플레이스까지 관심사 기반 모든 활동이 가능한 슈퍼서비스로 도약하고자 합니다.

문토와 함께 관심사 기반 커뮤니티 플랫폼의 새로운 이정표를 제시할 동료를 기다립니다

[문토 개발팀의 업무 문화]
• 빠른 실행과 안정성을 함께 추구합니다.
- 문토 개발팀은 빠른 기능 개발뿐 아니라 서비스 안정성, 배포 품질, 운영 리스크 관리도 중요하게 생각합니다.
- 단순히 많이 만드는 것보다, 고객과 비즈니스에 실질적으로 기여하는 개발을 지향합니다.

• 개발과 비즈니스를 연결합니다.
- 개발팀은 기술적 완성도뿐 아니라 제품 성장, 고객 경험, 운영 안정성을 함께 고려합니다.
- 사업 조직과 긴밀히 협업하며 서비스 성장에 필요한 기술적 의사결정을 함께 만들어갑니다.

• AI를 적극적으로 활용합니다.
- 문토는 AI 도구를 개발 생산성을 높이는 핵심 도구로 보고 있습니다.
- 코드 작성, 리뷰, 테스트, 문서화, 디버깅 과정에서 AI 기반 개발 도구를 적극적으로 활용하며, 이를 팀의 표준 업무 방식으로 발전시키고자 합니다.

[동료의 코멘트]
논리적인 사고를 타고난 컴퓨터 친화적 개발자, 근성 하나로 모든 문제를 해결하는 농부 개발자, 유저의 입장에서 먼저 생각하는 역지사지 개발자, 사람 냄새 좋아하는 감성 개발자, 어느 유형이든 해당한다면 문토의 문을 두드려 주세요.

공유하는 것의 힘을 믿습니다. 서로 잘 소통하고 공유하면 더 좋은 프로덕트를 만들 수 있다고 생각합니다. 열린 마음만 가지고 오시면 저희가 먼저 다가갈게요.
나무보다 숲을 보려고 합니다.

좋은 구조의 코드와 시스템에 대해서 함께 고민해 나가고 싶습니다.

Responsibilities

[이런 일을 해요]
입사와 동시에 문토의 핵심 프로덕트를 직접 개발하며, 사업 목표에 맞춰 개발 업무를 실행합니다.
문토의 시니어 소프트웨어 엔지니어는 단순히 기능을 개발하는 역할을 넘어, 서비스 성장 단계에 필요한 기술적 문제를 해결하고 개발 프로세스, 시스템 안정성, 개발 생산성을 함께 개선하는 역할입니다.
문토는 AI 기반 개발 방식을 적극적으로 도입하여 작은 팀의 개발 속도와 안정성을 높이고 있습니다.
개발 실무에서 탄탄한 역량을 발휘하며, 향후 개발팀 리드로 성장하고자 하는 분을 찾습니다.

1. 사업 목표와 개발 실행의 연결
• 경영진이 정한 사업 목표와 우선순위를 개발 계획, 업무 및 일정으로 구체화합니다.
• 개발팀의 업무 우선순위와 리소스를 정리하고 실행 과정을 관리합니다.
• 진행 상황과 당면한 이슈, 일정 변경 가능성을 경영진과 유관 부서에 투명하게 공유합니다.
• 기술적 대안을 제시하고, 결정된 방향이 실제 제품 결과로 이어지도록 책임집니다.

2. 문토 핵심 프로덕트 개발 및 운영 (핸즈온 중심)
• 문토 웹사이트와 앱의 신규 기능 개발, 운영 및 유지보수에 직접 참여합니다.
• 백엔드, 프론트엔드, 모바일 앱, 외부 SDK 및 데이터 연동 구조를 이해하고 기술적 판단을 내립니다.
• 팀이 해결하기 어려운 기술 이슈나 장애가 발생하면 직접 문제 해결에 참여합니다.
• 신규 기능 개발뿐 아니라 성능 개선과 서비스 안정성도 함께 책임집니다.

3. 개발 품질 및 협업 개선
• 설계와 코드 리뷰를 통해 개발 품질을 높입니다.
• 장애, 배포, 외부 연동 및 데이터 이슈에 대응합니다.
• 동료 개발자의 문제 해결을 지원하고 기술적 경험을 공유합니다.
• 프로젝트의 일정과 업무 조율을 경험하며 개발팀 리드에게 필요한 책임 범위를 단계적으로 넓혀갑니다.

4. AI 기반 개발 워크플로우 혁신
• AI를 활용한 End-to-End 시스템 설계·구축을 실행합니다.
• AI를 활용해 개발, 리뷰, 테스트, 문서화, 디버깅 등 개발 전 과정을 혁신합니다.
• 새로운 AI 기술과 도구를 직접 학습하고 실험하여 실제 업무에 적용합니다.
• 조직 차원에서 AI를 활용한 개발 워크플로의 구조적 혁신을 만듭니다.

[문토 기술 스택]
• 백엔드: Node.js, NestJS, Prisma
• 프론트엔드: TypeScript, React, Next.js
• 모바일: Flutter, Dart
• DB: PostgreSQL, Redis, MongoDB
• 인프라: AWS EC2, ECS, S3, CloudFront, RDS, Lambda
• 코드 관리: GitHub
• 배포: Github Actions, Docker, Fastlane
• AI 개발 도구: Claude Code

Requirements

• 5년 이상의 소프트웨어 개발 경험이 있으신 분
•백엔드(서버) 중심으로 프론트·인프라·데이터까지 넘나들며 풀스택 엔지니어링 역량으로 문제를 끝내는 분
• AI·에이전트 기반 개발 도구로 실제 개발 워크플로우를 개선해본 경험이 있으신 분
• 개발 그 자체를 좋아하고, 직접 코드를 쓰며 문제를 해결하는 것을 즐기는 분
• 명확한 목표를 향해 몰입해 실행하고 끝까지 완수하는 실행력과 오너십이 강한 분

Preferred

• 초기 프로덕트에서 매스 프로덕트까지의 서비스의 빠른 성장을 경험해보신 분
• 팀의 리더로서 리더십 경험이 있으신 분
• 빠르게 성장하는 B2C 플랫폼 서비스에서의 스케일업 경험이 있으신 분
• 개발자 커뮤니티 전반에 대한 높은 이해와 관심, 활발한 참여와 기여가 있으신 분
• 비즈니스 임팩트를 기준으로 기술 우선순위를 판단해 본 경험이 있으신 분

Benefits

[효율적으로 일해요]
• 고사양 개인 업무 장비를 제공해요.
• 당이 떨어지지 않도록 다양한 간식과 음료를 제공해요.
• 다양한 효율적인 업무툴을 사용해요.

[함께 성장해요]
• 업무에 필요한 외부 교육비를 지원해드려요.
• 업무에 필요한 도서를 구입해드려요.

[즐겁게 일해요]
• 문토 소셜링에 참가시 참가비를 지원해드려요.
• 문토 소셜링 참가시 2시간 조기 퇴근을 할 수 있어요.
• 팀원들의 생일에 소정의 선물을 드려요.
• 명절에 선물을 드려요.


[근무조건]
• 근무시간 : 주 5일제, 월~금 오전 9시~오후 6시
• 근무형태 : 정규직 (수습기간 3개월/ 3개월간 수습 기간을 거친 후, 근무 평가를 통해 본 채용 여부를 결정합니다. )
• 근무장소 : 역삼역 스퀘어736 (2호선 역삼역 3번출구 도보 3분)

[지원방법 및 절차]
• 지원서 제목은 '[포지션명] 본인 이름'으로 통일해주세요.
• 이력서, 자기소개서, 포트폴리오를 첨부해 주세요.
• 이력서와 자기소개서는 필수 서류입니다. 필수 서류 중 하나라도 누락된 경우 서류 심사를 진행하지 않으니, 꼭 제출해주시기 바랍니다.
• 서류 검토 후 적합한 분에 한하여 개별 연락 드리며, 인터뷰를 통해 선발합니다.
• 선착순, 접수순으로 검토합니다. 채용 완료시 공고가 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.


[문토에서 일해야 하는 7가지 이유]
1. 사람들의 일상을 바꾸는 멋진 일을 하고 있습니다.
성수동 카페투어부터 마피아 게임 파티까지. 문토는 다양한 커뮤니티 서비스를 통해 보다 많은 사람들이 매일 반복되는 단조로운 생활을 넘어 일상을 보다 풍성하게 채워나갈 수 있도록 돕습니다.
누군가의 근사한 저녁 시간을 만들고, 취향이 통하는 친구를 선물하고, 새로운 취향을 통해 새로운 세계를 발견하게 하는 것. 우리가 하는 일은 사람들의 매일을 바꾸는 멋진 일입니다.

2. 서비스에 진심인 멋진 팀원들이 있습니다.
서비스에 대한 애정을 가지고 진심을 다해 고민하는 멋진 팀원들이 모여있습니다.
각 분야에서 전문성을 쌓은 실력있는 팀원들과 함께 즐겁게 일하며 성장할 수 있습니다. 최고를 지향하는 최고의 팀원들과 함께 서로를 통해 배우고 인사이트를 얻으며 회사와 함께 압축적으로 성장하는 경험을 할 수 있습니다.

3. 함께 성장하는 건강한 조직 문화를 가지고 있습니다.
(미션 드리븐 컴퍼니) 서비스 미션에 깊이 공감하는 사람들이 모여 원팀으로 하나의 목표를 가지고 일하고 있습니다. 모두가 하나의 목표를 가지고 함께 달리는 벅찬 경험을 할 수 있습니다.
(팀워크 지향) 단단한 팀워크의 힘을 믿는 팀입니다. 우리는 위대한 일은 결코 혼자 할 수 없다는 사실을 압니다. 뛰어난 개인의 역량에 의존하기보다는 서로가 서로의 부족함을 채우며 팀으로 일하고 성장하는 사람들이 모여있습니다.
(성장 지향) 오늘보다 내일 더 나은 사람이 되고 싶은 사람들이 모여 일합니다. 문토 팀원들은 무엇이든 가능하다고 생각하며 한계 없이 도전하고 실행합니다. 변화와 도전을 두려워하지 않는 열정 넘치는 팀원들이 함께 일하고 있습니다.
(성과 지향) 결과로 이야기하는 성과 지향 팀입니다. 회사는 목표 달성을 위한 리소스와 권한을 최대한 지원하며 팀원은 높은 책임감과 자율성을 바탕으로 목표를 달성합니다. 목표를 달성하기 위해 우선순위에 집중하며, 불필요한 일을 최대한 배제합니다.

4. 남다르게 성장하고 남다르게 보상받을 수 있습니다.
역량 있는 팀원이 마음껏 역량을 발휘하고 남다르게 성장할 수 있도록 기회가 열려있습니다.
누구나 아이디어를 내고 기획에 참여할 수 있으며, 성과를 만들어낸 팀원에게는 그에 걸맞는 보상을 드리고 있습니다.

5. 성장성과 재무적 안정성을 동시에 추구합니다.
아무리 좋은 서비스도 재무적 안정성이 뒷받침되지 않으면 지속될 수 없습니다.
문토는 투자금에 의존하지 않는 거래액 기반 성장을 통해 전년 대비 연매출 8배 성장을 이뤄냈으며, 월 흑자를 달성하며 재무적 안정성을 다져나가고 있습니다.

6. 플랫폼 성장에 진심인 좋은 투자자가 있습니다.
문토는 2023년 4월 52억 규모의 시리즈 A 투자 유치를 완료했으며, 누적 투자 유치 금액은 총 72억원입니다.
프리 시리즈 A부터 투자에 참여했던 국내 탑티어 투자사인 IMM인베스트먼트(오늘의집, 아이디어스, 스타일쉐어, 마이리얼트립 투자), 대교인베스트먼트(아이디어스, 와디즈 투자), 본엔젤스파트너스(오늘의집, 배달의민족 투자)를 비롯해 제트벤처캐피탈(일본 LINE과 야후재팬의 모회사인 Z홀딩스의 기업주도형 벤처캐피탈)과 중소기업은행이 투자에 참여했습니다.

7. 큰 꿈을 가지고 있습니다.
문토는 글로벌 No.1 관심사 플랫폼이 되어 사람들의 일상을 바꾸겠다는 큰 꿈을 가지고 있습니다.
카카오톡이 메신저를 통한 연결을 통해 사람들의 라이프스타일을 바꾸고, 당근마켓이 이웃간의 중고 거래를 통해 동네 이웃의 생활 방식을 바꾼 것처럼, 문토 또한 관심사 기반 연결을 통해 사람들의 라이프스타일을 바꿔나가고자 합니다.
문토는 소셜라이징부터 정보 공유, 여가 상품 커머스까지 확장하여 관심사에 기반한 모든 활동이 가능한 슈퍼 서비스로 도약하고자 합니다.

멋진 도전을 함께 할 좋은 동료분들을 기다리겠습니다!

title: Principal Statistician - Early Phase
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Principal Statistician - Early Phase based in Netherlands.

As a Principal Statistician specializing in early-phase clinical development, you will provide strategic statistical expertise throughout the full lifecycle of clinical studies, from protocol development to clinical study reporting. You will act as a key scientific partner, supporting study design, statistical analysis, regulatory activities, and high-quality data-driven decision-making. Working with multidisciplinary global teams, you will contribute to innovative healthcare solutions while mentoring statisticians and ensuring excellence across project delivery. This role offers the opportunity to influence complex clinical programs, collaborate with experts across functions, and make a meaningful impact on the development of new therapies.

Accountabilities

  • Serve as a senior statistical expert supporting clinical studies across all phases of development, from protocol design through clinical study report (CSR) completion.
  • Provide statistical leadership on assigned projects, including study design, analysis strategies, randomization approaches, and interpretation of clinical trial results.
  • Develop, review, and oversee Statistical Analysis Plans (SAPs), including specifications and mock-up tables, listings, and figures.
  • Support the creation and review of analysis datasets, statistical programming specifications, and clinical trial documentation.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams including clinical, data management, programming, regulatory, and project management stakeholders to ensure successful study delivery.
  • Conduct quality control reviews of statistical deliverables to ensure accuracy, consistency with analysis plans, and compliance with applicable standards.
  • Mentor and support biostatistics colleagues by sharing expertise, providing training, and contributing to professional development initiatives.
  • Lead complex studies, integrated analyses, regulatory submissions, and interactions with regulatory agencies when required.
  • Support Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) and Data Monitoring Committee (DMC) activities, including statistical input and review.
  • Contribute to business development activities through proposal support, budgeting input, and participation in client discussions.

    • Requirements

    • Graduate degree in Biostatistics, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative discipline.
    • Extensive experience in clinical trials, biostatistics, or a comparable research environment, with demonstrated ability to lead complex projects.
    • Strong understanding of statistical methodology, clinical trial design, analysis techniques, and relevant regulatory guidelines such as ICH standards.
    • Experience supporting the complete statistical lifecycle of clinical studies, including protocol development, SAP creation, analysis, and CSR preparation.
    • Proficiency in R programming and experience applying statistical programming techniques in clinical research environments.
    • Experience reviewing or supporting regulatory submissions is highly desirable.
    • Strong ability to communicate complex statistical concepts clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
    • Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and work effectively in a global, remote environment.
    • Experience mentoring colleagues or providing statistical guidance to junior team members is an advantage.

      • Benefits

      • Fully remote working opportunity from Europe with flexible work arrangements.
      • Opportunity to contribute to meaningful clinical research programs that support the development of new therapies.
      • Collaboration with international teams of scientific and healthcare experts.
      • Career development opportunities through training, mentorship, and exposure to diverse therapeutic areas.
      • Access to a global environment focused on innovation, knowledge sharing, and professional growth.
      • Opportunity to work on complex clinical studies and gain experience across different stages of drug development.
      • Inclusive workplace culture that values collaboration, diversity, and individual contributions.

description:
About Acrisure

A global fintech leader, Acrisure empowers millions of ambitious businesses and individuals with the right solutions to grow boldly forward. Bringing cutting-edge technology and top-tier human support together, we connect clients with customized solutions across a range of insurance, reinsurance, payroll, benefits, cybersecurity, mortgage services – and more.

In the last twelve years, Acrisure has grown in revenue from $38 million to almost $5 billion and employs over 19,000 colleagues in more than 20 countries. Acrisure was built on entrepreneurial spirit. Prioritizing leadership, accountability, and collaboration, we equip our teams to work at the highest levels possible.

Job Summary:

Acrisure is seeking a Workers’ Compensation Claims Examiner. This role is responsible for managing lost time workers’ compensation claims from assignment through resolution while ensuring timely, accurate, and compliant claim handling.

The adjuster will investigate claims, evaluate liability and exposure, manage litigation and medical activity, maintain reserves, and support claim resolution strategies. This position is ideal for a claims professional who is comfortable managing multiple priorities, navigating complex claims issues, and working in a fast-paced environment.

This is a fully remote position focused on Alabama Workers Compensation Claims. Workers’ compensation claims experience is required for this role. Candidates should have experience handling workers’ compensation claims and exposure to lost time claim management.

Responsibilities

  • Manage a desk and caseload of workers’ compensation claims in an efficient and professional manner

  • Investigate claims thoroughly, including coverage, liability, and exposure analysis

  • Evaluate claim exposure and maintain accurate and timely reserves

  • Manage litigation activity and coordinate with defense counsel as needed

  • Evaluate claims for settlement and negotiate resolutions with claimants and attorneys

  • Monitor and manage medical treatment activity and claim progression

  • Maintain accurate, timely, and organized claim documentation within the claims system

  • Ensure claim payments are processed accurately and timely

  • Support timely and compliant claim resolution strategies

  • Maintain communication with employers, injured workers, attorneys, medical providers, and clients throughout the claims process

  • Participate in required training and maintain knowledge of assigned state workers’ compensation statutes

  • Perform additional duties and projects as assigned

Requirements

  • Workers’ compensation claims handling experience required

  • Lost time workers’ compensation claims experience beneficial

  • Exposure to litigation management and settlement negotiations beneficial

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

  • Analytical mindset with attention to detail and sound decision-making ability

  • Clear verbal and written communication skills

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team environment

  • Professional and customer-focused approach when working with clients and claimants

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and ability to learn new systems

Education and Licenses

  • High school diploma or equivalent required

  • Bachelor’s degree beneficial

  • Adjuster licensing beneficial or ability to obtain licensing as required

  • Leadership and/or management experience in a retail store environment

title: Program Technician I/II
description:
Statement of Purpose

Under the direct supervision of the Program Director/Supervisor, the Program Technician I supports program activities in running smoothly by providing direct monitoring and assistance to patients, assisting clinical and administrative staff, and maintaining the integrity of facility operations. The Program Technician helps uphold a structured, recovery oriented setting by monitoring patient activities, facilitating adherence to program rules, conducting drug testing procedures, and maintaining accurate documentation.

Major Tasks, Duties, and Responsibilities

  • Monitor patient activities and complete scheduled rounds, patient checks, etc. to ensure safety, support program compliance, and support treatment progress.

  • Complete patient belonging and living area searches within program policy and protocol to support safety.

  • Aids patients in becoming accustomed to program routine, including but not limited to orientation of new patients.

  • Participate as a support in the intake, treatment, and discharge process including gathering client signatures, filing client documentation, and supporting with data entry as needed.

  • Assures facility and patient living quarters meet cleanliness and repair standards, including assurance of patient completion of activities of daily living.

  • Perform toxicology testing, take and record vitals as needed, chart relevant information

  • Signs patients in and out of facility for passes, etc. as approved by treatment team and/or program management.

  • Enforce rules and regulations to ensure the smooth and orderly operation of the program.

  • Inventories and orders supplies as needed, with approval of program management, for carrying out job duties.

  • Prepares written reports, shift documentation, etc. as needed and assigned.

  • May accompany patients to activities inside the program or in the community, including but limited to serving as support when a patient has an appointment off premises.

  • Observes patient behavior and report any issues, concerns, or changes to treatment team and/or program management.

  • Provides administrative support to counseling, administrative, clerical, or other program staff as needed.

  • Reports the need for facility and vehicle maintenance and repair to appropriate staff

  • Ensure compliance with regulatory and accreditation standards, including but not limited to DMH, DHCS, SAPC, HIPAA, 42 CFR Part 2, CARF, etc.

  • Respond to behavioral crises, medical emergencies, suicidal ideation, overdose including administration of anti-overdose medications as needed, or acute intoxication safely, within scope of practice

  • Report and record any changes observed in client condition or behavior, including unusual incidents. Identify, report, and assist with the management of emergencies.

  • Participate in safety programming to promote client and staff safety. Maintain health and safety standards of facility.

  • Participate in treatment team meetings, case conferences, and program planning.

  • Contribute to agency quality assurance and improvement initiatives.

  • Maintain professional boundaries and standards. Treat clients with respect, care, and concern. Comply with confidentiality requirements at all times.

  • Maintain familiarity with BHS policies and procedures and other applicable regulations; perform job duties accordingly. Represent BHS well in all contacts.

  • Courteously answer phones, appropriately directing calls and taking messages. Facilitate client external communication as approved by supervisor.

  • Attend meetings and trainings, and participate in committees as assigned.

  • Other duties as assigned.

Program Technician Competencies and Performance Expectations

  • Ability to complete the above major tasks, duties and responsibilities

  • Ability to demonstrate professional judgment and decision-making, including ability to recognize and seek out supervision and/or consultation when required

  • Ability to recognize and report the symptoms associated with substance use and co-occurring disorders (i.e., mental health, medical health, etc.)

  • Ability to identify and respond appropriately to a crisis within scope of practice including but not limited to overdose, behavioral challenges, contraband protocol, emergency codes, etc.

  • Ability to meet productivity standards as assigned

  • Ability to recognize personal biases within diverse populations. Maintain cultural sensitivity at all times.

  • Ability to adhere to professional standards

Prerequisite Qualifications

The following are the qualifications required to perform the essential functions of this position.

Qualifications may be subject to modification based on the Americans with Disabilities Act.

Bilingual abilities may be required within certain BHS programs.

High school diploma or equivalency, or education may be substituted for up to one year of relevant work experience, training, or lived experience complying with BHS policies & procedures.

Well-organized person with basic clerical and alphanumeric filing skills. Preferred background includes human service, and communication skills.

Ability to operate required computer programs for position, including but not limited to Microsoft Office Suite, electronic timekeeping system, electronic learning management system, upon hire or demonstrated competency developed within 90 days of employment.

Obtain First Aid and CPR certification within 90 days of employment and maintain current thereafter.

Must have a valid California driver license and liability insurance if driving a personal vehicle on BHS premises.

Able to stand, bend, stoop, squat and reach for purpose of performing duties such as handling materials stocked on shelves, filing and handling and sorting mail. Routinely lift and move items weighing up to twenty-five pounds; is expected to ask for assistance and use dolly or cart and any heavy items. Vision, hearing, manual dexterity, and eye-hand coordination are adequate for recordkeeping, writing, and using telephones, computers, and office machinery. Able to move about the facility and other off-site locations.

Complete annual TB, maintain in good standing.

The above statements reflect the general duties considered necessary to describe the principal functions of the job as identified and shall not be considered as a detailed description of all the work requirements which may be inherent in the position.

Statement of Purpose

The Program Technician II performs program support that may include core functional areas i.e. crisis intervention, client education, referral, reports and record keeping, and consultation as a team member. May collect, analyze and record specimens for drug testing and other assigned duties.

Major Tasks, Duties, and Responsibilities

Following is a general listing of the job duties inherent in this position. The employee will also perform other tasks and special projects as assigned or required.

  • Aids clients in becoming accustomed to program routine.
  • Answers the phone and assists callers as needed.
  • Assists clients with finding information and filling out forms as needed.
  • Assures facility and client living quarters meet cleanliness and repair standards.
  • Attends staff meetings and in-service trainings as assigned.
  • Monitor medication lines
  • Collects samples, including urine, breath, perspiration, and hair for purposes of drug testing.
  • Analyzes laboratory findings and checks the accuracy of the results.
  • Analyzes samples of biological material for chemical content or reaction.
  • Enters data from analysis of medical tests and clinical results into computer for storage.
  • Operates, calibrates and maintains equipment used in quantitative and qualitative analysis.
  • Sets up, cleans, and maintains laboratory equipment.
  • Signs clients in and out of facility for passes, etc. as approved by counseling staff.
  • Completes scheduled rounds and random inspections to ensure that clients and facilities are safe and secure.
  • Complies with BHS health and safety policies
  • Conveys respect for cultural and lifestyle diversities of clients and staff.
  • Demonstrates ethical and appropriate behavior.
  • Enforces rules and regulations to ensure the smooth and orderly operation of the program.
  • Establishes and monitors quality assurance programs and activities to ensure the accuracy of laboratory and other program results.
  • Inventories and orders supplies needed for carrying out job duties.
  • Maintain records and prepares reports as directed.
  • Maintains familiarity with BHS policies and procedures and other applicable regulations. Performs job duties accordingly.
  • May accompany clients to activities inside the program or in the community..
  • May serve as support when a client has an appointment off premises.
  • Observes client position holders to see that their duties are completed adequately; reports any issues to counseling staff.
  • Observes clients and reports unusual behavior to counseling staff.
  • Participates in committees as assigned.
  • Provides administrative support to counseling staff.
  • May facilitate educational groups, (i.e. health and wellness, life skills)
  • Crisis intervention, recognizes emergency situations and takes appropriate action, including recognizing and summoning assistance when necessary.
  • Reports the need for facility maintenance and repair to appropriate staff
  • Represents BHS well in all contacts.
  • Works as a team member in performing job duties and assignments

Program Technician Competencies and Performance Expectations

  • Engage in behavior which supports a program setting.
  • Develop an understanding of drug and alcohol dependency, mental health, 12 Step programs, confidentiality, professional boundaries, and co-dependency.
  • Collect, analyze, report and document laboratory specimens in strict accordance with protocol.
  • Communicate clearly and effectively with clients, staffs, and others as needed.
  • Keep work, file, and storage areas well organized.
  • Maintain records and files in such a way that authorized staff can retrieve needed items without difficulty.
  • Communicate clearly with clients, staff, and others.

Prerequisite Qualifications

Following are the qualifications required to perform the essential functions of this position. Qualifications may be subject to modification based on the Americans with Disabilities Act.

Bilingual abilities may be required within certain BHS programs.

A combination of education, training and work experience equivalent to the following:

  • High school diploma or equivalency and enrolled in AOD school or registered, 2-years work experience.
  • Education may be substituted for up to one year of the work experience.

Well-organized person with basic clerical and good alphanumeric filing skills. Prefer job background which includes people contact, both face-to-face and by telephone. Data entry and word processing experience or will train on the job with the requirement that employee demonstrates a learning curve resulting in computer skills adequate for this position within three months of hire.

Obtain First Aid and CPR certification within 90 days of employment and maintain current thereafter.

Must have a valid California driver license and liability insurance if driving personal vehicle on BHS premises.

Able to stand, bend, stoop, squat and reach for purpose of performing duties such as handling materials stocked on shelves, filing and handling and sorting mail. Routinely lift and move items weighing up to twenty-five pounds; is expected to ask for assistance and use dolly or cart and any heavy items. Vision, hearing, manual dexterity and eye-hand coordination adequate for recordkeeping, writing, and using telephones, computers, and office machinery. Able to move about the facility and other off-site locations.

The above statements reflect the general duties considered necessary to describe the principal functions of the job as identified and shall not be considered as a detailed description of all the work requirements which may be inherent in the position.

title: Sr Director, Insights & Analytics, Neuropsychiatry/Women’s Health
description:
About This Role

The Sr Director, Insights and Analytics Lead, will support the Neuropsychiatry/Women’s Health franchise by objectively defining and evaluating brand performance, enabling data-driven decisions, and proactively delivering actionable insights. This position offers an extraordinary opportunity to innovate and evolve Biogen’s industry-leading portfolio, improving patient outcomes for millions. Responsibilities include insights and analytics, including primary marketing research, secondary analytics, forecasting guidance, and competitive intelligence.

As the key partner to commercial and marketing leadership, you will help identify & address the most important business problems facing the franchise. This role will partner directly with North America Leadership team members and Heads of Marketing, as well as functional leaders such as IT, to ensure a thorough understanding of our business insight needs, our data landscape, and how we leverage data to answer business questions efficiently and agilely

Additionally, this role will lead the development of performance narrative and generation of insights supporting US brand / franchise strategy in collaboration with the franchise lead, brand lead, and (as appropriate) Global stakeholders.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead and manage the relationship with Franchise Leadership Team
  • Drive insights agenda: Scope, lead, and deliver cross-functional projects across core insights functions, including market research, forecasting support, competitive intelligence, brand analytics, and field analytics
  • Deliver high quality ad hoc analyses to leadership that offer clear recommendations in support of brand strategy
  • Proactively provide actionable insights to key stakeholders for both short term resource allocation decision and long-term strategy development
  • Collaborate with Advanced Analytics and Orchestration team and other Business Intelligence and Operations (BIO) teams to support initiatives to guide brand strategy and execution
  • Lead Integrated Customer Plan (ICP) and Annual Operating Plan (AOP) for CD&I, and provide commercial team with comprehensive performance, target audience, and market insights to support strategy & resource investment
  • Cultivate strong relationships and effective ways of working within MS Marketing team and amongst cross-functional teams (Sales, Marketing, Market Access, Medical, etc.), building consensus/buy-in amongst teams
  • Manage insights spend to allocated budget; pursue novel research methodologies that offer new capabilities and ways to optimize project efficiency
  • Partner effectively with leadership to ensure that key business decisions are based on data/fact-based analysis
  • Drive innovation in analytics and business execution to have impact on the business performance and investment strategy

Who You Are

You are an exceptional leader, passionate about being part of a high-performance team that prioritizes & delivers on the needs of our core stakeholders. You have:

  • High Analytical Horsepower / Skillset – High comfort sourcing, manipulating, analyzing and visualizing data; ability to effectively present and defend analyses. Strong ability to use data and research to diagnose issues and test hypotheses for the commercial team.
  • Project / Deliverable Management Expertise – High proficiency with gathering and synthesizing qualitative and quantitative inputs into synthesized, actionable insights
  • Advanced Strategic Thinking – Able to independently design/identify the ideal approach to answering complex business questions pulling from all available internal/external data sources; able to draft synthesized outputs and drive beyond the raw output of the analysis to actionable insights; anticipates the next question(s) from management
  • Communication – Ability to deliver information & recommendations succinctly in verbal and written communications/deliverables; able to distill complex analyses into meaningful insights and conclusions for executive audiences
  • Executive Presence – High comfort in delivering and defending analyses/ recommendations to senior management
  • High Customer-Orientation – Acts as a service partner to marketing, sales and other functional teams
  • Collaboration – Able to collaborate effectively with various functional partners to probe/ask questions, gather required information for analyses, and participate as a value-added cross-functional partner
  • Deals Well with Ambiguity / Intensity – Operates well in a fast-paced environment driven by senior leadership requests and evolving business needs
  • Independence – Able to manage workload with limited guidance; effective managing to expectations and ability to scope/prioritize work with relatively high independence

Qualifications

Experience Required:

  • Minimum 12+ years relevant experience with a life sciences company or consulting firm supporting the healthcare industry
  • Consulting background strongly preferred
  • Neuropsychiatry/Women’s Health experience preferred
  • Solid understanding of commercial business and industry standard datasets – script (IQVIA, Symphony, etc.), Patient (Specialty Pharmacies/Distributors), and Managed Care (Symphony, etc.).

Job Level: Management

Additional Information

The base compensation range for this role is: $230,000.00-$316,000.00

Base salary offered is determined through an analytical approach utilizing a combination of factors including, but not limited to, relevant skills & experience, job location, and internal equity.

Regular employees are eligible to receive both short term and long-term incentives, including cash bonus and equity incentive opportunities, designed to reward recent achievements and recognize your future potential based on individual, business unit and company performance.

In addition to compensation, Biogen offers a full and highly competitive range of benefits designed to support our employees’ and their families physical, financial, emotional, and social well-being; including, but not limited to:

  • Medical, Dental, Vision, & Life insurances
  • Fitness & Wellness programs including a fitness reimbursement
  • Short- and Long-Term Disability insurance
  • A minimum of 15 days of paid vacation and an additional end-of-year shutdown time off (Dec 26-Dec 31)
  • Up to 12 company paid holidays + 3 paid days off for Personal Significance
  • 80 hours of sick time per calendar year
  • Paid Maternity and Parental Leave benefit
  • 401(k) program participation with company matched contributions
  • Employee stock purchase plan
  • Tuition reimbursement of up to $10,000 per calendar year
  • Employee Resource Groups participation

Why Biogen?

We are a global team with a commitment to excellence, and a pioneering spirit. As a mid-sized biotechnology company, we provide the stability and resources of a well-established business while fostering an environment where individual contributions make a significant impact. Our team encompasses some of the most talented and passionate achievers who have unparalleled opportunities for learning, growth, and expanding their skills. Above all, we work together to deliver life-changing medicines, with every role playing a vital part in our mission. Caring Deeply. Achieving Excellence. Changing Lives.

At Biogen, we are committed to building on our culture of inclusion and belonging that reflects the communities where we operate and the patients we serve. We know that diverse backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives make us a stronger and more innovative company, and we are focused on building teams where every employee feels empowered and inspired. Read on to learn more about Biogen.
