They develop and steward a roadmap of the most critical patient barriers to be addressed, incorporating patient insights, input, and research from stakeholders across CMG and Genentech, and aligning on prioritization decisions in partnership with PX governance bodies and steering committees as appropriate. Through their oversight of the Experience Design team, they have responsibility for ensuring that future-state solutions are aligned with Genentech Patient Experience ambition and strategy, and ensure the organizational conditions exist to design, build, and scale these solutions. WIth a deep knowledge of the patient experience landscape and external trends, they ensure that strategies and initiatives are guided by a future-oriented perspective. This leader then champions and represents the PX vision to CMG and Genentech leadership, proactively driving alignment and securing commitment even when faced with competing, high-stakes organizational priorities.

The Opportunity

PX Strategy & Roadmap

  • Partner with leaders across CMG and based on inputs from DDA Research, PX Business Partners, a deep understanding of the broader market, and other key data sources, steward a comprehensive governance framework to define, steward, and realize the multi-year PX ambition, ensuring the portfolio of initiatives reflects the most critical market shifts, patient needs, and GNE portfolio needs. This includes the identification of opportunities to scale solutions across multiple TAs that are facing similar challenges.

  • Direct the prioritization of the PX backlog, making high-level trade-off decisions about which patient barriers will receive design investment and resource allocation, and aligning those decisions to direction from CMG Patient Experience governance bodies and steering committees as appropriate.

  • Create and maintain a multi-year strategic roadmap for the PX organization that clearly articulates the rationale for work prioritization decisions while ensuring connectivity with TA strategies and roadmaps.

  • Lead PX Business partners to drive an integrated point of view on opportunities across the portfolio, identifying scaled solutions and problems to solve across brands, TAs, and patient populations.

Influence and Inspire to Provide Support to Achieve PX Ambition

  • Engage the Head of PX to align enterprise support for PX vision, strategy, and resourcing needs to execute on planned initiatives.

  • Communicate the strategic value of PX initiatives, priorities, and roadmap in an inspiring and impactful way to gain active support and commitment from senior leaders in CMG and beyond.

  • Represent PX strategies and roadmap in senior leadership forums, including USLT as needed.

  • Identify and secure resourcing to achieve outcomes and key results of PX ambition. Secure enterprise-wide functional commitments, in collaboration with RDT and DDA leadership to ensure the PX roadmap is appropriately resourced.

  • Drive cross-functional pull-through of the PX ambition, ensuring that commercial, medical, and access teams are aligned on a single version of the patient journey, and acting as an escalation point to resolve misalignment of strategic priorities across the PX ambition and roadmap and key stakeholders.

Team Leadership and Performance

  • Ensures the Strategy and Experience organization delivers outcomes in alignment with the patient experience ambition.

  • Leads the Strategy & Governance and Experience Design teams, ensuring that team members have what they need to be successful and motivating the delivery of high-quality, high-impact work.

  • Establish and cultivate an inspiring culture of belonging, engagement, connection to the company and team mission to create a ‘great place to work’ through continuous demonstration of leadership commitments.

  • Synthesize value stories for the USLT, translating PX performance data into a narrative of business impact, patient outcomes, and competitive advantage.


Who You Are

  • You have a Bachelor’s degree required

  • 15+ years of professional industry experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or related industry

  • 5+ years of people leadership experience, with a demonstrated track record as the leader of complex organizations and teams with deep organizational influence and impact

  • Strong leadership presence, storytelling, and communication skills

  • Proven track record of strategic planning execution, and prioritizing and delivering high-impact projects

  • Deep proven track record of interfacing with, presenting to, and earning buy-in from senior leadership to drive strategic alignment across matrixed organizations

  • Ability to manage high-level trade-offs across a diverse portfolio, act as a "system thinker," and lead as an enterprise leader

  • Strong negotiation skills and ability to influence; excellent problem-solving skills; ability to prioritize between competing demands and find the “critical path” needed to progress initiatives"

  • Comfort with technology, and an understanding of how to utilize data and technology to improve patient outcomes

Preferred Qualifications

  • MBA or advanced degree in a related field preferred

Location

title: Software Engineer, Data Infrastructure & Acquisition - Birmingham, United Kingdom
description:
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

We're looking to hire for our Data side of our AI team at Speechify. This role is responsible for all aspects of data collection to support our model training operations. We are able to build high-quality datasets at petabyte-scale and low cost through a tight integration of infrastructure, engineering, and research work. We are looking for a skilled Software Engineer to join us.

What You'll Do

  • Operate and extend the cloud infrastructure for our ingestion pipeline, currently running on GCP and managed with Terraform.

  • Collaborate with others on the AI Team and Speechify Leadership to craft the AI Team's dataset roadmap to power Speechify's next-generation consumer and enterprise products.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science or a related field.
  • 5+ years of industry experience in software development.
  • Proficiency with bash/Python scripting in Linux environments

  • Experience with web crawlers, large-scale data processing workflows is a plus
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks and adapt to changing priorities.
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.

What we offer

  • A fast-growing environment where you can help shape the company and product.
  • An entrepreneurial-minded team that supports risk, intuition, and hustle.
  • A hands-off management approach so you can focus and do your best work.
  • An opportunity to make a big impact in a transformative industry.
  • Competitive salaries, a friendly and laid-back atmosphere, and a commitment to building a great asynchronous culture.
  • Opportunity to work on a life-changing product that millions of people use.
  • Build products that directly impact and support people with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, low vision, concussions, autism, and more.
  • Work in one of the fastest-growing sectors of tech, the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio.

Refer them!

title: Senior Product Manager, Real Time Operations
description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

About Axon

Axon’s mission is simple and bold: Protect Life.

We build technology that helps first responders, security teams, and communities act with speed, clarity, and confidence in the moments that matter most. Our Real-Time Operations (RTO) portfolio, anchored by the Fusus platform, is transforming how law enforcement, enterprise security, and international agencies detect, assess, and respond to threats.

Fusus connects live video, alerts, sensors, and location data into a unified operating picture, accessible on any device. Alerts and presence are the heartbeat of that picture. They determine what demands attention and who is in position to act. We're building intelligent, high-signal alerting and presence experiences that cut through noise and keep operators and responders locked into what matters most.

Your Impact

As Senior Product Manager for Alerts & Presence, you will define and lead the roadmap for how Fusus surfaces the right information to the right people at the right time - making alerts and responder presence the connective tissue of real-time operations.

You'll build the systems that determine what warrants attention, how it's prioritized and routed, and how operators maintain awareness of who is where. This spans alert generation from cameras, sensors, LPR, drones, and third-party sources, as well as the presence layer that tracks responder locations, unit status, and asset proximity.

Your work will enable officers, security teams, and emergency responders around the world to cut through noise, act on what matters, and coordinate with confidence. By making alerts smarter and presence data seamless, your work will help prevent harm, accelerate response, and directly advance Axon's mission to Protect Life.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the Alerts & Presence product roadmap, focused on delivering the right information at the right time to operators and responders
  • Define how alerts are generated, prioritized, routed, and resolved across video, sensors, LPR, drones, and third-party integrations
  • Build presence experiences that give operators real-time visibility into responder locations, unit status, and asset proximity
  • Design fast, intuitive workflows for monitoring incidents, triaging alerts, and coordinating response
  • Partner with engineering and design to ship responsive, low-latency, and reliable alerting and presence features across web and mobile
  • Engage global law enforcement and enterprise users to validate needs and test improvements
  • Align with other product teams to ensure alerts and presence data flow seamlessly across the platform
  • Use metrics and feedback to refine roadmap priorities - reducing alert fatigue, improving time-to-action, and increasing situational awareness
  • Support go-to-market, training, and rollout with cross-functional teams

What Success Looks Like

  • Operators and responders receive timely, high-signal alerts that drive faster, more confident decisions
  • Presence data gives commanders and dispatchers clear visibility into who is where - improving coordination and resource deployment
  • Adoption grows across customer segments with high daily use, strong retention, and positive field feedback
  • Every second saved contributes to safer outcomes for officers, teams, and the public

What You Bring

  • 6–8+ years of product management experience, including 3+ years working on real-time, event-driven, or alerting systems
  • Experience building products where speed, clarity, and reliability directly impact outcomes
  • Strong grasp of alerting frameworks, geolocation and presence systems, real-time data pipelines, and notification design
  • Familiarity with live video, sensor networks, LPR, drone telemetry, and IoT integrations
  • Track record of turning user insights into clear product direction and focused execution
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams through roadmap, design, delivery, and iteration
  • Clear communicator who drives alignment, decisions, and measurable outcomes

Why Axon

  • Shape the future of public-private security collaboration, creating safer outcomes for communities and organizations.
  • Join a mission-driven company with a history of innovation and impact.
  • Work alongside passionate teams building technology that protects lives.

Benefits that Benefit You

  • Competitive base salary and RSUs
  • Pension plan with matching contributions
  • Private health insurance and cash plans
  • 30 days paid holiday plus UK public holidays
  • Enhanced maternity and paternity leave
  • GymPass subscription
  • Life assurance and income protection
  • Career growth, learning support, and wellness resources

Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Important Notes

description:
Step into a career with ASM, where cutting edge technology meets collaborative culture. ​

For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what’s next, at the forefront of innovation and what’s technologically possible. Interested in learning about the openings for nurses on the Cardiovascular Surgical Intensive Care (CSICU) unit at Sentara Heart Hospital? We are hosting an interview day and would love to schedule you.

Up to $20,000 Sign-On Bonus for qualified candidates

Days and Night Shift available

*PLEASE NOTE: This is an invite-only event. For the interview day 9/16/26 please apply for this position & a recruiter will reach out to discuss open positions with you & to schedule for interview times.*

The Registered Nursing (RN) is responsible to perform a competent level of nursing care as demonstrated by the critical thinking model known as the nursing process. The standards of practice (assessment, diagnosis, outcomes identification, planning, implementation, coordination of care- teaching and health promotion and evaluation) along with the standards of professional performance (ethics, culturally congruent practice, communication, collaboration, leadership, education, evidence- based practice /nursing research, quality, evaluation, resource utilization, and environmental health) encompass the actions and foundation of professional nursing. The RN possesses clinical knowledge and skills to meet standards as required by specific clinical areas.

Cardiovascular Surgical ICU Unit Description:

• 20 Bed cardiac surgical ICU

• Nurses handle 1-2 patients on this unit based on acuity level.

• Nurses provide service to any patients that have undergone open heart surgeries such as CABG, Valve repair or replacement, aneurysm repair, TAVR, ablations, Heart Transplantation, and Mechanical Circulatory Support devices including the Total Artificial Heart and Extracorporeal Membrane Oxygenation (ECMO), and various lung surgeries.

• Nurses manage critically ill patients that require intensive hemodynamic monitoring, mechanical ventilation, multiple drug infusions, IABP therapy and CRRT.

Education:
• Associate’s Degree or Diploma in Registered Nursing (required)
• Bachelor of Science Nursing- BSN or MSN (Preferred)

Certification/Licensure:
• Virginia RN License Virginia or Compact/Multi-State Eligible.
• All Direct Care RN's required to have BLS within 90 days of hire.

Experience:

• 1 year of RN Experience required

• 1 year of Intermediate - Stepdown level of care with cardiac knowledge ideal, ED, PCU or 1+ years of Medical/Surgical experience.

Nurse Transition to Practice Program:

At Sentara, we are committed to ensuring our nurses thrive from the very beginning of their journey. To support this, all nurses new to critical care will participate in our comprehensive 12-week Transition to Practice program. This program is designed to blend practical skills with hands-on training, professional development, and mentorship, equipping you with the confidence and expertise needed to excel in your critical care nursing career.

Our Transition to Practice program features a mix of classroom teaching methodologies and a preceptor-based unit orientation. You will engage in 8 sessions that include live simulations, case studies, and problem-based learning. These sessions cover essential topics such as critical care patient assessment and documentation, respiratory and cardiac care, vasoactive medications, hemodynamics and invasive monitoring, neurological care, post-operative and procedural care, GI/renal systems, ACLS mega code, sedation, analgesia, neuromuscular blockade, and effective communication with providers and families.

title: Insomniac - Entertainment Project Manager
description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE YOU?

Do you enjoy dance music? Do you excel at operations project management? Then you’re in luck! We are looking for a highly motivated self-starter who embodies both a passion for dance culture as well as creating memorable experiences. Is this you? Read on…

WHO ARE WE?

Insomniac produces some of the most innovative, immersive music festivals and events in the world. Enhanced by state-of-the-art lighting, pyrotechnics and sound design, large-scale art installations, theatrical performers and next generation special effects, our events captivate the senses and inspire a unique level of fan interaction. The quality of the Headliner experience is our top priority.

Insomniac produces 10,000 concerts, club nights and festivals for seven million attendees annually across the globe. Since its inception, Insomniac's events have taken place in 13 countries across five continents. The company's premiere annual event, Electric Daisy Carnival Las Vegas, is the world’s largest dance music festival and attracts more than 525,000 fans over three days. The company was founded by Pasquale Rotella and has been based in Los Angeles since it was formed in 1993.

THE ROLE

Insomniac Events is seeking a highly motivated and proactive Entertainment Project Manager to join our Entertainment team. We are seeking an Entertainment Project Manager to support the functions of Insomniac’s entertainment department. This position reports to the Entertainment Director. This is not a remote position and will be required in office and on-site various event locations.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Implement all departmental and event protocols set by the Entertainment Director
  • Receive incoming emails, phone calls & correspondence on behalf of the Director as necessary
  • Follow budget directives and ensure that they are kept on track
  • Review and submit final show budgets as requested
  • Set and attend meetings on behalf of the department or Director as needed
  • Process expense reports, Amex reports and petty cash tracking as necessary
  • Advance travel, visas and accommodation needs for Director, staff and performers at each event
  • Complete department site operations, production, credentials, and warehouse advancing for shows
  • Partner with HR to maintain roster, timesheets, discretionary lists & new hire paperwork at all shows
  • Manage payroll for Entertainment Dept staff including Performers, Production Assistants, Glamour team & vendors
  • Liaison with HR and Accounting to ensure all onboarding is accurately turned in, in a timely manner
  • Prepare and organize vendor agreements, creative releases, payment schedules and business forms for the personnel, performers, vendors, machinery, props, and any other items approved by the Entertainment Director
  • Secure and oversee bids from vendors and artists as needed
  • Supervise completion of the production reports, including production status or notes and distribute the report to proper channels daily
  • Department representative for local authorities to secure any legal or safety permits as needed by event staff and performers, to certify compliance with local ordinances
  • Obtain additional insurance requirements for specialty performers that may be required
  • Staff, manage and schedule Entertainment Dept Production Assistants for show days
  • Support sourcing experience staff such as performers, glamour team or management when requested
  • Manage all aspects of Entertainment Department for shows when Entertainment Director is not present
  • Partner with the other Insomniac departments to successfully execute experience requests for events
  • Manage all Entertainment Department assets used by other departments
  • Liaise with the other Insomniac departments to ensure the functionality and safety of stages and installations for entertainment
  • Oversee and assist in the setup and breakdown of the Entertainment Department at all festivals including site, back of house and wardrobe
  • Facilitate and assist load in and set up for Entertainment vendors at events
  • Ensure that a clean, safe, and secure work area is maintained at shows
  • Manage on site dressing room and check in staff, while monitoring breaks and assisting with others as necessary
  • Keep Performers and staff on schedule set by the Entertainment Director at shows
  • Support management of departmental warehouse spaces and assets stored there
  • Responsible for inventory management such as receiving, put away, packing, shipping, and trucking
  • Ensure proper storage, maintenance, and cleaning of department assets such as costumes, props, and equipment
  • Implement systems to manage and prevent inventory loss or damaged
  • Implement systems to help execute warehouse inventory efficiency
  • Manage the performer and inventory Airtable database
  • Assist in the sourcing of new assets and vendors for the department
  • Recruit, hire, train and develop operational support team members
  • Frequent travel will be required (economy)

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5+ years of event coordinating/planning and execution
  • Proficiency in spreadsheets
  • Ability to effectively manage groups of staff
  • Must be motivated with an “Everything is possible” attitude
  • Must be an active problem solver, instilled with a sense of urgency for projects large and small
  • Must be able to stand for four hours at a time and walk long distances.
  • Must be able to lift 20 pounds.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

  • Must be able to tolerate loud noise levels & busy environments
  • May work in drastic temperature climates
  • Must be willing to travel to work events during holidays, evening and weekend hours, as required, to meet deadlines

Applicants for employment in the U.S. must possess work authorization, which does not require sponsorship by Insomniac for a visa.

We aspire to build teams that reflect and support the fans and artists we serve. Every day we aim to promote environments where everyone can be themselves, contribute fully, and thrive within our company and at our events. title: Medical Logistics Planner | TS/SCI
description:
Join our Deloitte AI & Engineering team to transform technology platforms, drive innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and reengineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

Work You'll Do

Serve as the Office of the Force Surgeon (OFS) medical logistics (MEDLOG) subject matter expert supporting MARFORPAC deliberate and contingency planning, focusing on Class VIII posture/sustainment, readiness, allied/partner interoperability, and operational logistics in support of the MARFORPAC Campaign Plan/Order and INDOPACOM-aligned efforts. The role provides continuity across planning cycles by assessing operational requirements, translating MEDLOG doctrine/system realities for planners/action officers, and producing high-quality staff products and recommendations.

Key Responsibilities:

MEDLOG operations support

• Identify and assess operational-level MEDLOG requirements from subordinate/tactical inputs; compare against current/projected capabilities; provide recommendations to OFS leadership and functional staff.

• Monitor unclassified and classified communications to identify emerging MEDLOG requirements/issues/updates.

• Develop and manage Health Service Support (HSS) MEDLOG POA&Ms (Plans of Action & Milestones).

• Review/QA staff products (briefs, action plans, supporting documentation) and provide actionable feedback.

• Participate in working groups (WG), operational planning teams (OPT), synchronization meetings, and cross-functional touchpoints across MARFORPAC/INDOPACOM/adjacent components.

• Maintain operational task visibility by updating OFS Microsoft Teams task trackers/tasking tools.

• Provide weekly activity updates (e.g., quad slides, brief summaries) and elevate issues requiring Force Surgeon/OFS support.

• Provide MEDLOG inputs to annual assessments and campaign/Annex Q-related cycles; support required trip reports when directed.

MEDLOG planning support (Task Two)

• Participate in and inform planning events (WG/OPT/OPLAN/CONOP and emergent planning) by providing coordinated MEDLOG assessments, opinions, and expertise.

• Monitor doctrinal/policy updates (unclassified/classified as applicable) and advise on required adjustments to OFS/MARFORPAC policy, doctrine, or plans.

• Provide MEDLOG-specific inputs for exercise plans and Annex Q products; coordinate planning alignment with sustainment realities and subordinate/adjacent MEDLOG elements.

Reporting, deliverables, and quality

• Produce timely, analytically supported recommendations (e.g., gap/shortfall identification and mitigations; Class VIII status/readiness; program health; allied/partner capability assessments) and brief products when requested.

• Deliver recurring reports (e.g., monthly status and quarterly reports) aligned to government formats/timelines and incorporate leadership feedback.

• Follow OFS/MARFORPAC internal reviews to eliminate errors/omissions and ensure technical accuracy, revise products quickly when non-compliant.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

• Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team

• Effective written and verbal communication skills

• Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product

• Ability to build and sustain professional relationships

• Ability to lead projects or workstreams

• Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment

• Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor

• Ability to meet deadlines

• Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes - is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Industry Solutions clients seek verticalized solutions that transform how they sell products, deliver services, generate growth, and fulfill mission-critical operations. The Industry Solutions offering delivers integrated business expertise with repeatable scaled technology solutions that are specifically engineered for each sector's IndustryAdvantageTM.

Qualifications

Required:

• Bachelor's degree in relevant field such as logistics management, supply chain management, etc.

• Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future

• Active TS/SCI security clearance required

• 6+ years experience supporting military logistics and sustainment operations

• Experience with MEDLOG systems/reporting, including MAXIMO Logistics Command $ Control

• Ability to work independently with minimal oversight on mission-critical/high-visibility work

• Military schooling such as SNCO Academy, Career Level School, Expeditionary Warfare School (EWS), and/or Supply School

Preferred:

• Experience with Global Combat Support System-Marine Corps (GCSS MC) functions.

• Supply chain / logistics certifications (one or more): ASCM/APICS CSCP or CPIM, ISM CPSM, SOLE CPL (or equivalent).

• Healthcare/medical logistics credential (one or more): AHRMM CMRP (or equivalent medical materiel/readiness credential).

• Prior relevant MOS experience such as USMC MOS 0491, USN LS NEC, Army MOS 68J, or USAF AFSC 4A131.

• Professional certifications i.e. PMP (Project Management Professional) or equivalent.

• Additional PME/JPME (Joint Professional Military Education) that strengthens joint/coalition planning effectiveness (helpful given the joint/interoperability focus) .

• Possess applicable Navy AQD(s) OR completion of USMC Ground Supply Officer School.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $113,300 to $188,900.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

title: Director, Field Medical/Medical Science Liaison -Mountain
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director, Field Medical/Medical Science Liaison - Mountain based in United States.

This role serves as a strategic scientific leader responsible for advancing medical initiatives within an assigned territory and strengthening relationships with leading healthcare experts.
The position focuses on translating complex cardiovascular science into meaningful clinical conversations and supporting innovation in patient care.
You will collaborate with medical, clinical, and research teams to build trusted partnerships with key opinion leaders and academic institutions.
This opportunity combines scientific expertise, field engagement, and strategic influence within a rapidly evolving healthcare environment.
The ideal candidate will help shape medical strategy, support clinical research efforts, and identify emerging needs across cardiovascular disease areas.
The role offers the opportunity to make a direct impact by connecting scientific advancements with healthcare professionals and patients.

Accountabilities:

The Director, Field Medical/Medical Science Liaison leads scientific engagement activities across a defined territory, serving as a trusted medical resource for healthcare professionals and internal teams. This role requires strong cardiovascular expertise, strategic relationship building, and the ability to communicate complex scientific information effectively.

  • Develop and maintain peer-to-peer relationships with cardiologists, heart failure specialists, researchers, and other key healthcare experts.
  • Conduct high-level scientific discussions on disease states, mechanisms of action, clinical trial results, real-world evidence, and emerging therapies.
  • Execute local medical strategies by identifying opportunities for collaboration with academic centers, research institutions, and healthcare networks.
  • Present and interpret complex cardiovascular data, including preclinical research, Phase I–IV clinical studies, and biomarker findings.
  • Gather and communicate actionable medical insights from external experts to support broader medical strategies and decision-making.
  • Support medical congress activities and scientific engagement initiatives at major cardiovascular conferences.
  • Provide clinical trial support by partnering with Medical Affairs and Clinical Operations teams on enrollment, feasibility, site support, and investigator relationships.
  • Facilitate protocol education and provide scientific guidance while ensuring compliance with applicable regulations and internal procedures.
  • Support investigator-initiated studies and research collaborations when appropriate.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of field activities and insights through CRM systems.
  • Ensure all scientific interactions follow regulatory standards, ethical guidelines, and company policies.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate brings advanced scientific expertise, strong communication capabilities, and experience within cardiovascular medicine, clinical research, or medical affairs. The role requires the ability to build credibility with external experts while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.

    • MD, PharmD, PhD, or equivalent advanced scientific degree required.
    • Minimum of 3 years of experience in cardiovascular Medical Affairs, clinical research, or a related scientific field.
    • Prior Medical Science Liaison experience strongly preferred.
    • Deep knowledge of cardiology, cardiovascular clinical trials, treatment landscapes, and evolving medical guidelines.
    • Expertise in areas such as heart failure, cardiomyopathies, hypertension, valvular heart disease, ASCVD, lipid disorders, thrombosis, anticoagulation, cardiometabolic disease, or rare cardiovascular conditions.
    • Strong scientific communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
    • Ability to translate complex clinical data into clear, meaningful discussions with healthcare professionals.
    • Experience collaborating with healthcare providers, researchers, and cross-functional internal teams.
    • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities independently.
    • Willingness and ability to travel approximately 60%–70%, including overnight and regional travel.

      • Benefits:

      • Competitive annual salary range of $257,000 - $335,000 USD, with compensation based on experience, skills, and location.
      • Remote-based position with territory-focused field engagement.
      • Opportunity to contribute to innovative cardiovascular research and medical advancement.
      • Collaboration with experienced scientific, clinical, and healthcare professionals.
      • Exposure to cutting-edge clinical development programs and emerging therapies.
      • Professional growth opportunities within a science-driven environment.
      • Opportunity to build meaningful relationships with leading healthcare experts and researchers.

title: Field Superintendent
description:

As a leader at Groundworks, you’ll take responsibility for people, performance, and results while being supported by the strength of an award-winning organization. We empower our leaders with the tools, training, and autonomy to run their business effectively—and through our employee ownership program, your impact is tied to shared, long‑term success. If you’re motivated by accountability, development, and leading high‑performing teams, Groundworks offers a platform to grow your career and your influence.

The Superintendent leads and oversees all field operations related to foundation repair, basement waterproofing, crawl space encapsulation, and concrete lifting projects. This role ensures projects are executed safely, on time, within budget, and to the company’s high-quality standards, maintaining Groundworks’ reputation for reliable and professional foundation solutions.

title: (Fixed Term) Manufacturing Associate I
description:
The Role:

Joining Moderna means advancing mRNA science to transform medicine. Work with exceptional global teams on a broad pipeline and build a career that makes a real difference for patients.

Step into a hands-on manufacturing role where you'll help produce mRNA vaccines that make a meaningful difference to patients around the world. Working in a highly digital, cGMP-regulated production environment, you'll combine scientific thinking, technical expertise and operational excellence to ensure the safe, compliant and reliable manufacture of commercial products. This is an opportunity to continuously learn, embrace new technologies—including exposure to digital and Generative AI-enabled ways of working—and contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement.

Here's What You'll Do:

  • Operate mRNA vaccine production equipment in accordance with current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP), approved Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and manufacturing documentation.

  • Execute manufacturing operations safely while consistently adhering to Moderna's health, safety and environmental procedures and guidelines.

  • Follow gowning procedures and maintain excellent housekeeping standards to ensure a compliant, safe and inspection-ready manufacturing environment.

  • Partner closely with Quality Assurance colleagues to complete production documentation required to support the timely disposition of commercial batches.

  • Participate in investigations relating to manufacturing incidents and deviations, performing root cause analysis (RCA) and supporting the implementation of effective Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA).

  • Apply operational performance tools and collaborate with colleagues to achieve operational Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).

  • Respond quickly to routine equipment, process and digital system issues, troubleshooting effectively to minimise operational disruption.

  • Proactively identify and escalate compliance, quality, health and safety concerns to the Team Lead or Supervisor.

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date training records and associated documentation.

  • Perform routine basic equipment maintenance, including lubrication, basic mechanical checks and filter changes using hand tools.

  • Participate in multiple projects and continuous improvement initiatives that enhance manufacturing performance, quality, safety and operational efficiency.

  • Contribute ideas that improve processes, embrace new manufacturing technologies and support ongoing digital innovation across the production environment.

  • Collaborate effectively within a fast-paced, cross-functional matrix organisation, building strong partnerships across Manufacturing, Quality and Operational teams.

  • Demonstrate flexibility to work off-hours and overtime when business needs require, supporting manufacturing plans aligned with commercial demand.

What You'll Bring

  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to operate complex manufacturing equipment in a regulated pharmaceutical or biotechnology environment.

  • A scientific mindset with the curiosity and capability to rapidly learn new mRNA manufacturing technologies.

  • Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to producing safe, high-quality products in full compliance with cGMP requirements.

  • Digital confidence and the ability to work effectively within a highly automated manufacturing environment, with enthusiasm for adopting emerging digital technologies and AI-enabled tools.

  • A collaborative approach, with the ability to work effectively as an individual contributor while contributing positively to team success.

  • Strong problem-solving skills, enabling effective troubleshooting of equipment, process and digital issues.

  • A continuous improvement mindset, with the ability to identify opportunities to enhance operational performance and manufacturing excellence.

  • Flexibility, adaptability and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced manufacturing environment.

The key Moderna Mindsets you'll need to succeed in the role:

  • We obsess over learning. We don’t have to be the smartest we have to learn the fastest.

  • We behave like owners. The solutions we’re building go beyond any job description.

Here’s What You’ll Need (Basic Qualifications)

  • 1+ years of experience in a GMP manufacturing environment

  • A university degree with a specialization in pharmaceutical production technology or equivalent

  • Experience with filtration and chromatography, and cold chain management a plus

  • Experience in audit / inspection preparation, understanding Health authority and regulatory guidelines

  • Ability to collaborate fluidly with peers, leadership and cross-functional support groups required

  • Excellent written, oral communication, and organizational skills required.

  • Ability to maintain attention to detail while executing multiple tasks with minimal supervision

  • Demonstrated commitment to Moderna's values of Bold, Collaborative, Curious, and Relentless, embodying these values in the workplace

24 /7 Fixed shift Pattern:

What is a 2-2-3 work Schedule

  • The 2-2-3 or the Panama schedule is a slow rotation cycle of 28 days where each employee works in a 12 hour shift every day.

  • The schedule usually involves 4 teams who work for 2 days, then get 2 rest days, followed by 3 days of work.


Pay & Benefits


At Moderna, we believe that when you feel your best, you can do your best work. That’s why our benefits and well-being resources are designed to support you—at work, at home, and everywhere in between.

  • Competitive healthcare, plus voluntary benefit programs to support your unique needs
  • A holistic approach to well-being with access to fitness, mindfulness, and mental health support
  • Family building benefits, including fertility, adoption, and surrogacy support
  • Generous paid time off, including vacation, bank holidays, volunteer days, sabbatical, global recharge days, and a discretionary year-end shutdown
  • Savings and investments to help you plan for the future
  • Location-specific perks and extras

The benefits offered may vary depending on the nature of your employment with Moderna and the country where you work.


About Moderna

Since our founding in 2010, we have aspired to build the leading mRNA technology platform, the infrastructure to reimagine how medicines are created and delivered, and a world-class team. We believe in giving our people a platform to change medicine and an opportunity to change the world.


By living our mission, values, and mindsets every day, our people are the driving force behind our scientific progress and our culture. Together, we are creating a culture of belonging and building an organization that cares deeply for our patients, our employees, the environment, and our communities.


We are proud to have been recognized as a Science Magazine Top Biopharma Employer, a Fast Company Best Workplace for Innovators, and a Great Place to Work in the U.S.


As we build our company, we have always believed an in-person culture is critical to our success. Moderna champions the significant benefits of in-office collaboration by embracing a 70/30 work model. This 70% in-office structure helps to foster a culture rich in innovation, teamwork, and direct mentorship. Join us in shaping a world where every interaction is an opportunity to learn, contribute, and make a meaningful impact.


If you want to make a difference and join a team that is changing the future of medicine, we invite you to visit modernatx.com/careers to learn more about our current opportunities.


Moderna is a smoke-free, alcohol-free, and drug-free work environment.


Moderna is a place where everyone can grow. If you meet the Basic Qualifications for the role and you would be excited to contribute to our mission every day, please apply!


Moderna is committed to equal opportunity in employment and non-discrimination for all employees and qualified applicants without regard to a person's race, color, sex, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, ancestry or citizenship, ethnicity, disability, military or protected veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, marital or familial status, or any other personal characteristic protected under applicable law. title: Loads & Dynamics Engineer
description:
About Radiant

Radiant is an El Segundo, CA-based startup building the world’s first mass-produced, portable nuclear microreactors. The company’s first reactor, Kaleidos, is a 1-megawatt, fail-safe microreactor that can be transported anywhere power is needed and run for up to 5 years without refueling. Portable nuclear power with rapid-deploy capability can replace similar-sized diesel generators and provide critical asset support for hospitals, data centers, remote sites, and military bases. Radiant’s unique, practical approach to nuclear development leverages modern software engineering to rapidly deliver safe, factory-built microreactors that use existing, well-qualified materials. Founded in 2020, Radiant is on track to test its first reactor at the Idaho National Laboratory this summer, with initial customer deliveries beginning in 2028.

About the Role

Radiant is seeking a Loads & Dynamics Engineer to own and execute structural loads, vibration, and dynamic analyses for complex mechanical systems associated for Kaleidos, the world's first portable microreactor and supporting hardware. You will play a critical role in ensuring structural integrity and survivability across all phases of the product lifecycle, including manufacturing, transportation, handling, deployment, and operational environments.

This role requires a hands-on engineer who is comfortable working in ambiguous, fast-paced environments and collaborating closely with structures, mechanical design, thermal, nuclear, and test teams.

Responsibilities & Duties:

  • Develop and own static, dynamic, and transient loads for reactor systems, support structures, and transport configurations.

  • Perform structural dynamics analyses, including modal, random vibration, shock, sine vibration, and fatigue assessments.

  • Implement explicit dynamics simulations to model nonlinear reactor response under transient seismic and transportation event cases.

  • Define and analyze transportation and handling environments, including shock and vibration from road, rail, air, or sea transport.

  • Generate load cases and environments to support structural sizing, design margins, and verification plans.

  • Conduct finite element analyses (FEA) using tools such as ANSYS, Abaqus, or similar tools.

  • Collaborate with design engineers to influence hardware architecture, material selection, and joint design.

  • Support test planning and correlation, including shaker tests, modal surveys, and structural verification testing.

  • Develop and maintain analysis documentation, reports, and requirements for internal reviews and regulatory interfaces.

  • Contribute to failure investigations, root cause analyses, and design improvements

  • Help establish best practices for loads, dynamics, and structural verification within a growing engineering organization.

Required Qualifications & Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related field.

  • 2+ years of experience in loads, dynamics, or structural analysis for complex mechanical systems.

  • Strong fundamentals in structural mechanics, dynamics, and vibration.

  • Experience with finite element modeling and analysis of metallic and composite structures.

  • Proficiency with industry-standard FEA tools (e.g., ANSYS, Abaqus, Nastran).

  • Familiarity with design allowables, safety factors, and margin-of-safety methodologies.

  • Ability to work cross-functionally and communicate analysis results clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Desired Qualifications & Skills:

  • Experience in aerospace, launch, defense, nuclear, or heavy industrial hardware environments.

  • Dynamics modeling software experience (LD-Dyna, Abaqus explicit, or other).

  • Background in shock and vibration testing and test-article correlation.

  • Knowledge of fatigue, fracture mechanics, and bolted joint analysis.

  • Experience defining or interpreting environmental specifications and requirements.

  • Master’s degree or PhD in a relevant engineering discipline.

  • Familiarity with nuclear, spaceflight, or safety-critical system requirements.

Additional Requirements:

  • Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as necessary to accomplish our mission.

  • Must work 100% onsite at El Segundo HQ.

Benefits and Perks

  • Stock: Substantial incentive stock plan for all full-time employees.

  • Medical: 100% up to base silver level plan for employee + 50% dependents, offers up to Platinum plans.

  • One Medical: Sponsored memberships for employees and their dependents.

  • Vision: 100% top tier plan coverage + 50% for dependents.

  • Dental: 100% top tier plan coverage, orthodontia extra, 50% for dependents.

  • Voluntary life, accident, hospital, critical illness, commuter and FSA/HSA are offered as employee contributed benefits.

  • 8-weeks of paid parental leave for all parents. Additional paid pregnancy leave for CA employees.

  • Daily catered lunch. Free snacks and drinks.

  • Flexible PTO policy. Remote workday allocation.

  • Company and team-bonding events, happy hours and in-person camaraderie.

  • Beautiful El Segundo headquarters close to the Pacific Ocean.

Total Compensation and Benefits
Radiant compensates people for impact and invests in those who continue to raise the bar. Radiant’s new hire compensation package includes base salary, substantial equity grants, and comprehensive health benefits. Total compensation and level are determined through a rigorous evaluation of interview performance, experience, education, and qualifications, and are designed to support continued growth as scope, responsibility, and impact expand at Radiant.

title: Production Operative - Grade 1
description:
Bring more to life.

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?

At Leica Biosystems, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

At Leica Biosystems, we’re not just shaping the future of cancer diagnostics — we’re transforming lives. Our mission of “Advancing Cancer Diagnostics, Improving Lives” is the driving force behind everything we do. As a global leader with the most comprehensive portfolio spanning from biopsy to diagnosis, we empower clinicians with innovative, reliable solutions so they can give patients timely, accurate answers when they need them most. When you join Leica Biosystems, you’re not just taking a job; you’re becoming part of a passionate team that knows every moment matters when it comes to cancer. You’ll help develop diagnostic solutions that turn anxiety into answers, and aid the acceleration of next-generation, life-changing therapies. Surrounded by a diverse and collaborative global community, you’ll be inspired each day to stretch, grow, and make an impact.

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

The Production Operative is responsible for assisting in the manufacture and packaging of finished products to regulated requirements and in line with customer needs. title: Member of Technical Staff, Translational Medicine
description:
Member of Technical Staff, Translational Medicine

We're seeking a Member of Technical Staff for Translational Medicine to be Latch's expert on human disease and clinical evidence.

About the Role

Own the translational endpoints in our long-horizon therapeutics and disease benchmarks. Make sure every claim Latch makes stands up to scrutiny from a board-certified geneticist, a regulator, or a treating physician. Build the partnerships that get clinical data in the door and the translational capability to use it in a meaningful way.

What You'll Do

  • Own translational endpoints across our therapeutics and disease benchmarks

  • Serve as the clinical authority for internal R&D teams across omics, therapeutics, and biosecurity

  • Build partnerships with patient cohorts, nonprofits, health systems, and biotechs to source clinical data for training and evaluating agents

  • Negotiate data use agreements and stand up consent, de-identification, and compliance workflows for clinically sensitive data

  • Translate real drug programs and trial designs into benchmark tasks agents can be scored against

  • Build a function beyond yourself

Requirements

  • MD with residency completed

  • Has defined clinical endpoints for real drug programs

  • Was part of at least one clinical trial at any phase as a physician or investigator. You can describe the molecule, patient population, dose rationale, safety profile, and regulatory or safety board feedback

  • Can identify and reason about disorders of human development caused by genetic mutations

  • Strong communicator

Competencies

  • Translational judgement — You know what an endpoint has to do to survive review

  • Data rights — You have negotiated data use agreements and understand consent and de-identification cold

  • Partnerships — You have secured data or research partnerships with patient groups, nonprofits, academics, health systems, or biotechs. You know where clinical data lives and how to get access

  • Clinical genetics — Depth in Mendelian and developmental disease

  • Compliance — You can build the function, not just follow it

  • AI — You are resourceful in leveraging AI tools across clinical and scientific domains

Nice to Have

  • Rare disease or gene therapy experience

  • Molecular pathology background

  • Experience building datasets for model training or evaluation

Interview advice

Be able to walk through one molecule end to end. The mechanism, population, dose rationale, endpoint selection, what the regulators said, and what you did.

Compensation & Logistics

  • $250-$400k total comp, based on clinical and technical depth

  • Variable compensation + equity + stock options

  • 100% premium covered Blue Shield platinum health plan ($0 deductible / $0 out-of-pocket)

  • Free meals (lunch and dinner)

  • Waterfront office in China Basin, San Francisco

  • Full-time, in-person

Location: San Francisco, CA. In-person.

title: Principal Statistician - Early Phase
description:

You will act as a key scientific partner, supporting study design, statistical analysis, regulatory activities, and high-quality data-driven decision-making. Working with multidisciplinary global teams, you will contribute to innovative healthcare solutions while mentoring statisticians and ensuring excellence across project delivery. This role offers the opportunity to influence complex clinical programs, collaborate with experts across functions, and make a meaningful impact on the development of new therapies.

Accountabilities

  • Serve as a senior statistical expert supporting clinical studies across all phases of development, from protocol design through clinical study report (CSR) completion.
  • Provide statistical leadership on assigned projects, including study design, analysis strategies, randomization approaches, and interpretation of clinical trial results.
  • Develop, review, and oversee Statistical Analysis Plans (SAPs), including specifications and mock-up tables, listings, and figures.
  • Support the creation and review of analysis datasets, statistical programming specifications, and clinical trial documentation.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams including clinical, data management, programming, regulatory, and project management stakeholders to ensure successful study delivery.
  • Conduct quality control reviews of statistical deliverables to ensure accuracy, consistency with analysis plans, and compliance with applicable standards.
  • Mentor and support biostatistics colleagues by sharing expertise, providing training, and contributing to professional development initiatives.
  • Lead complex studies, integrated analyses, regulatory submissions, and interactions with regulatory agencies when required.

    • Experience supporting the complete statistical lifecycle of clinical studies, including protocol development, SAP creation, analysis, and CSR preparation.

title: Power Studies Engineer (PSCAD)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Power Studies Engineer (PSCAD) based in Canada.

This role offers the opportunity to contribute to the engineering of advanced electrical power systems supporting hyperscale and AI-driven data centers across North America.
The successful candidate will perform complex power system studies focused on reliability, resiliency, and performance optimization.
Working within a multidisciplinary environment, you will collaborate with engineering teams, utilities, and project stakeholders on mission-critical infrastructure.
You will leverage advanced modeling tools and industry expertise to solve complex electrical challenges where uptime and system stability are essential.
This position provides exposure to cutting-edge technologies, large-scale infrastructure projects, and innovative engineering solutions.
The role is fully remote within Canada, with occasional travel required based on project needs.
It is an opportunity to make a measurable impact while advancing expertise in power systems engineering and AI data center infrastructure.

Accountabilities:

As a Power Studies Engineer, you will be responsible for analyzing, modeling, and optimizing complex electrical systems to support reliable and resilient mission-critical facilities. You will contribute technical expertise throughout project lifecycles, from system analysis and design coordination to commissioning support and stakeholder collaboration.

  • Perform advanced power system studies, including load flow, short circuit, protective device coordination, arc flash, grounding, power quality, harmonic analysis, transient analysis, and reliability assessments.
  • Develop and maintain electrical system models using PSCAD, ETAP, SKM PowerTools, EasyPower, or similar power system analysis platforms.
  • Conduct electromagnetic transient (EMT) studies to evaluate system behavior during switching events, faults, utility disturbances, and significant load variations.
  • Analyze the impact of high-density AI and mission-critical loads on utility systems, emergency generation, UPS infrastructure, and facility electrical networks.
  • Support utility interconnection studies and coordinate technical requirements with utility providers.
  • Evaluate redundancy strategies, contingency scenarios, system reliability, and overall electrical resiliency.
  • Prepare technical reports, engineering calculations, documentation, and recommendations for clients and project teams.
  • Collaborate with electrical design teams on medium-voltage systems, substations, standby generation, UPS systems, and utility infrastructure.
  • Participate in design reviews, coordination meetings, commissioning activities, and technical discussions with stakeholders.
  • Review engineering deliverables to ensure technical accuracy, quality, and compliance with applicable standards.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate is an experienced power systems professional with strong analytical capabilities and hands-on experience performing complex electrical studies. You should have a solid understanding of utility infrastructure, mission-critical facilities, and advanced power system modeling tools.

    • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering from an accredited institution.
    • 8–15 years of experience in power systems engineering, utility engineering, substations, transmission and distribution, industrial facilities, renewable energy, mining, or mission-critical infrastructure.
    • Demonstrated experience performing power system studies, including transient, harmonic, grounding, load flow, short circuit, protective coordination, and arc flash analysis.
    • Required proficiency with PSCAD.
    • Experience with ETAP, SKM PowerTools, EasyPower, DIgSILENT PowerFactory, CYME, or similar engineering software.
    • Strong knowledge of electrical power systems, substations, protective relaying, utility infrastructure, and reliability concepts.
    • Experience with utility interconnections and medium-voltage electrical systems.
    • Experience with underground duct bank ampacity and heat studies using Neher-McGrath methodology is an asset.
    • Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) registration in Canada, or eligibility to obtain registration, is an asset.
    • Knowledge of Canadian Electrical Code (CEC), CSA standards, IEEE standards, utility requirements, and applicable provincial regulations.
    • Familiarity with U.S. electrical standards, including NEC, NFPA, and IEEE requirements, is an asset.
    • Strong technical writing, communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
    • Ability to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams and communicate technical recommendations to clients.
    • Legal authorization to work in Canada.

      • Benefits:

      • Fully remote work environment within Canada.
      • Opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge hyperscale and AI data center projects.
      • Exposure to advanced power system analysis, digital twins, BIM technologies, and innovative engineering solutions.
      • Competitive salary package.

      • Paid vacation and retirement savings programs where applicable.

title: Counsel, Healthcare Regulatory & Privacy
description:
Who We Are


Verily Health is a data platform and technology company purpose-built to power AI-enabled precision health solutions that accelerate research and improve care for individuals and communities. Uniquely positioned at the intersection of technology, data science, and healthcare, Verily transforms multimodal health data into insights, models, and actions that make healthcare more personalized, predictive, and precise.

Description

Verily is looking for a Counsel, Healthcare & Privacy to serve as a broad-based legal advisor across our provider-facing healthcare business, with deep expertise in healthcare privacy. Reporting to the Deputy General Counsel - Enterprise, this role will partner closely with teams across the company to navigate the complex regulatory landscape at the intersection of healthcare delivery, technology, and data privacy — helping Verily build innovative, compliant solutions that improve health outcomes. This is a high-impact opportunity for a healthcare attorney who thrives on variety, enjoys being a hands-on business partner, and wants to bring deep privacy expertise to bear on real-world healthcare and digital health challenges.

Responsibilities

  • Privacy program: Serve as day-to-day advisor on privacy laws and continuous improvement of privacy programs based on up-to-date knowledge of relevant data privacy and security regulations and industry guidelines across global markets, including the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (“HIPAA”), the California Consumer Privacy Act (“CCPA”), and the EU General Data Protection Regulation (“GDPR”).

  • Commercial transactions: Advise on all potential healthcare regulatory issues which can arise in negotiations and contracts with health systems, plans/payors, and other B2B arrangements such as, provider agreements, professional services arrangements, management services organization (MSO) structures, physician relationship compliance (Stark Law, Anti-Kickback Statute, fee-splitting/corporate practice of medicine considerations), privacy, security, and financial terms.

  • Compliance program: Advise on healthcare regulatory requirements such as scope-of-practice rules, healthcare fraud and abuse, and reimbursement/coding considerations as they intersect with Verily's products and services with particular focus on commercial and marketing practices.

  • Incident management: Partner with the data security team to expeditiously and thoroughly manage incidents (both data privacy and security) as well as any escalations from customers and investigations/inquiries from regulators.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

  • J.D. from an accredited law school and active bar membership in good standing.

  • 6 or more years of relevant legal experience, in a law firm or in-house at a healthcare provider, medical device, life sciences, or a health tech company.

  • Substantive experience advising on provider-side healthcare regulatory and compliance matters (contracting, practice management, fraud & abuse/regulatory compliance, and marketing practices).

  • Strong working knowledge of HIPAA and hands-on experience advising on state privacy laws (e.g., CCPA/CPRA or similar state frameworks).

  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex regulatory requirements into clear, practical, business-friendly guidance.

  • Experience working directly with cross-functional teams (product, engineering, compliance) in a fast-paced, tech-enabled environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with digital health products, including familiarity with the FDA regulatory framework for software-as-a-medical-device (SaMD).

  • Comfort level with development of AI offerings designed to be used in healthcare settings and/or actual usage of AI in healthcare settings.

  • Familiarity with additional state health data privacy laws beyond CCPA/CPRA (e.g., Washington My Health My Data Act, Texas HB 300/TMPRA, etc.).

title: Software Engineer, Data Infrastructure & Acquisition - Nottingham, United Kingdom
description:
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

We're looking to hire for our Data side of our AI team at Speechify. This role is responsible for all aspects of data collection to support our model training operations. We are able to build high-quality datasets at petabyte-scale and low cost through a tight integration of infrastructure, engineering, and research work. We are looking for a skilled Software Engineer to join us.

What You'll Do

  • Be scrappy to find new sources of audio data and bring it into our ingestion pipeline
  • Operate and extend the cloud infrastructure for our ingestion pipeline, currently running on GCP and managed with Terraform.
  • Collaborate closely with our Scientists to shift the cost/throughput/quality frontier, delivering richer data at bigger scale and lower cost to power our next-generation models.
  • Collaborate with others on the AI Team and Speechify Leadership to craft the AI Team's dataset roadmap to power Speechify's next-generation consumer and enterprise products.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science or a related field.
  • 5+ years of industry experience in software development.
  • Proficiency with bash/Python scripting in Linux environments
  • Proficiency in Docker and Infrastructure-as-Code concepts and professional experience with at least one major Cloud Provider (we use GCP)
  • Experience with web crawlers, large-scale data processing workflows is a plus
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks and adapt to changing priorities.
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.

What we offer

  • A fast-growing environment where you can help shape the company and product.
  • An entrepreneurial-minded team that supports risk, intuition, and hustle.
  • A hands-off management approach so you can focus and do your best work.
  • An opportunity to make a big impact in a transformative industry.
  • Competitive salaries, a friendly and laid-back atmosphere, and a commitment to building a great asynchronous culture.
  • Opportunity to work on a life-changing product that millions of people use.
  • Build products that directly impact and support people with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, low vision, concussions, autism, and more.
  • Work in one of the fastest-growing sectors of tech, the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio.

title: Staff ML - GenAI Engineer, Voice & Speech
description:
Weave is looking for a Staff Engineer to join the Machine Learning Team specialised in voice and audio modalities, where you will be at the forefront of enabling product innovation and building AI-powered applications. In this role, you will help design how teams across Weave build out AI-powered features, serving as a technical leader who bridges the gap between sophisticated machine learning and practical, customer-facing products.

You will be joining a team of talented developers that share a common interest in distributed backend systems, data, scalability, and continued development. You will get a chance to apply these and other skills, to new and ongoing projects to make machine learning more approachable, data more available, and easier to discover and use by helping design how teams build out AI-powered features at Weave.

Our teams are cross-functional agile teams composed of a product owner, backend and frontend devs and DevOps. Teams are highly autonomous with the ownership and ability to act in Weave’s best interest.

Above all, your work will impact the way our customers experience Weave while working closely with a highly skilled team to accomplish varying goals and cultivate our phenomenal culture.

The Machine Learning Team's mission is to enable product innovation by making it painless for developers to build AI-powered applications that require access to large sets of data. Machine learning is challenging, but we are striving to democratize access to the tools and technology that powers it so teams can buildcutting-edgee features safely and responsibly without a PhD in Data Science. As a Machine Learning Engineer on the team, you’ll be building models for new products with emerging technologies, at scale. We handle data for hundreds of millions of people daily.

  • This is a fully remote opportunity in India with the expectation to overlap with India and US business hours.s

  • Reports to: Manager, Machine Learning

What You Will Own

  • Design and develop machine learning infrastructure, tooling, and models to help teams deliver world-class experiences.

  • Help product and development teams understand the data lifecycle and the inherent experimental nature of machine learning.

  • Build internal products and platforms to enable teams to incorporate AI into their features and customer-facing products.

  • Consult with teams to help them understand common patterns, anti-patterns, and tradeoffs of machine learning. Guide them through creating excellent customer experiences end to end.

  • Build scalable, resilient services to support data integration, event processing, and platform extensions.

  • Contribute to the continued evolution of product functionality that services large amounts of data and traffic.

  • Write code that is high-quality, performant, sustainable, and testable while holding yourself accountable for the quality of the code you produce.

  • Coach and collaborate inside and outside the team. You enjoy working closely with others - helping them grow by sharing expertise and encouraging best practices.

  • Work in a cloud environment, considering the implementation of functionality through several distributed components and services.

  • Work with our stakeholders to translate product goals into actionable engineering plans.

What You'll Need to Accomplish the Job

  • High integrity, team-focused approach, and collaboration skills to build tight-knit relationships across Weave with various roles and stakeholders.

  • Responsive person with a strong bias for action.

  • 15+ years of experience in Machine Learning or AI, with a focus on or expertise in audio and voice GenAI solutions at scale

  • Deep expertise with modern ML tools and techniques such as LLMs, RAG, Prompt Engineering, Fine-tuning, and specifically high-scale audio/voice models and LLM evaluations

  • Experience moving and storing TBs of data or100 Ms to 110 Brecords.

  • Experience building and deploying ML-driven B2B multi-tenant applications in production environments at scale for external products and customers.

  • Experience with common ML technologies such as Python, Jupyter, Workflow Engines (Dagster, MLFlow, KubeFlow, etc), DVC, Triton Server, LLMs, Postgres, and others.

  • Experience with modern ML tools and techniques such as LLMs, RAG, Prompt Engineering, Fine Tuning, LLM evaluations, multi-modal models, and others.

  • Experience with data labelling or annotation for audio or text use cases.

  • Understanding of distributed systems and building scalable, redundant, and observable services.

  • Expertise in designing systems for distributed data sets and services.

  • Experience building solutions to run on one or more of the public clouds (e.g., AWS, GCP, etc.).

  • Experience providing stable, well-designed libraries and SDKs for internal use.

  • Self-driven and a thirst for learning in a quickly changing industry.

  • Demonstrated track record of delivering complex projects on time and experience working in enterprise-grade production environments.

  • Demonstrated capacity for leadership or mentorship.

  • Strategic thinker with a strong technical aptitude and a passion for execution.

What Will Make Us Love You

  • A background with data analysis, visualisation, and presentation.

  • 14+ years of experience in engineering and systems with strong proficiency in coding and system design.

  • Experience with low-latency natural language models and pipelines at scale.

  • Experience with real-time audio models and voice use cases such as transcription, ASR pipelines with interruption detection, audio alignment, and speech synthesis.

  • Experience with emerging technologies such as Model Context Protocol (MCP).

  • Proficient understanding of containers, orchestrators, and usage patterns at scale. Experience with Kubernetes or GKE and the Operator Pattern (GCP), specifically, a plus.

  • Experience with highly sensitive data such as PHI (HIPAA) and PII data.

  • Experience with automation and container-based workflow engines.

  • Experience with GitOps, IaC, and configuration-driven systems.

  • A preference for open source solutions.

  • A track record of clean abstractions and simple-to-use APIs.

  • A desire to advance the state of the art with new and innovative technologies.

  • Enjoys working in a greenfield environment using rapid prototyping.

  • Enjoys working with open-ended, evolving problems and domains.

Employment with Weave is contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, conducted in accordance with applicable laws.
