Overview:

Sentara RMH Medical Center is hiring an Echocardiographer for the Cardiac service line non-invasive lab. This is a full time, day shift position in Harrisonburg, Va.

Sign on Bonus of up to $20,000 for qualified candidates.

Hours: Monday – Friday, day shift, with call every 7th week to include the weekend. The echocardiographer is off the preceding Friday and following Monday of their call weekend. The Echocardiographer must live within a 30-minute drive of the hospital for call purposes.

An Echocardiographer, also known as a cardiac sonographer, specializes in performing diagnostic ultrasound examinations of the heart. These professionals work closely with cardiologists to evaluate heart structures, functions, and blood flow, aiding in the diagnosis and treatment of cardiovascular conditions.

Performs two-dimensional echocardiograms, Doppler echocardiograms, transesophageal echocardiograms and pharmacological stress echocardiograms to evaluate heart and vessel abnormalities for the evaluation of heart disease and blood flow abnormalities. Completes the technologist report in the structured report application. Graduate of an accredited echocardiography program (or equivalent education) in accordance with IAC Guidelines.

The Sentara RMH Medical Center echocardiography lab is considered high volume with close to 9,500 procedures performed annually. The lab works closely with our invasive cardiology (structural heart, electrophysiology, diagnostic/interventional cath) and cardiothoracic surgery services. Each Team member is expected to perform about 7 exams per day. Specific exams include: adult 2D and 3D transthoracic and transesophageal echo, myocardial strain, contrast (DEFINITY), agitated saline (bubble study), exercise stress echo and dobutamine stress echo. Preliminary reports are generated in ProSolv (Structured Report SW Application). Clinical equipment include state of the art Philips Epic ultrasound systems and EPIC (electronic medical record). Both inpatient and outpatient echo services are located on the Sentara RMH Medical Center main campus within the non-invasive cardiology lab.

Education

  • High School Diploma required with experience and certification required, Associate Degree preferred

  • Graduate of an accredited echocardiography program (or equivalent education) in accordance with IAC Guidelines.

title: Product Owner, College Pads
description:
About StarRez


StarRez is the global leader in student housing software, providing innovative solutions for on and off-campus housing management, resident wellness and experience, and revenue generation. Trusted by 1,400+ clients across 25+ countries, StarRez supports more than 4 million beds annually with its user-friendly, all-in-one platform, delivering seamless experiences for students and administrators. With offices in the United States, Australia, the UK, and India, StarRez blends the robust capabilities of a global organization with the personalized care and service of a trusted partner.

About College Pads
College Pads is transforming the way students navigate the transition from on-campus to off-campus life. Our platform enables universities to support their students by streamlining the process of finding and securing off-campus housing. By working closely with higher education institutions, we offer a trusted tool for students to connect with property managers and rental listings, helping to foster a foundation for wellbeing and success. As of January 2025, College Pads is part of StarRez.


The Role
StarRez is seeking a Product Owner to join the College Pads rebuild team in the UK, helping lead a 0→1 product build through to market launch.

This is not a typical PO role. You’ll be working on a greenfield product with ambitious timelines, high visibility, and real impact, partnering closely with a US-based Product Manager and cross-functional teams in the UK and India.

You’ll play a critical role in translating product vision into execution, driving day-to-day delivery, ensuring the team ships high-quality product at speed and owning the backlog.

You’ll operate in a fast-moving, AI-first environment, helping the team move quickly, stay aligned, and iterate toward product-market fit and launch readiness.

Role Details

  • Work Location: Remote (UK)
  • Travel: 5% (The percentage of travel is an estimation and may vary based on business needs.)
  • Reporting Structure: This role reports to the Senior Director, Product Engineering.

What You’ll Do

  • Own delivery from zero to one: Translate product vision into clear, actionable work, owning day-to-day execution, sprint planning, backlog, and launch readiness
  • Turn strategy into shipped product: Partner closely with the US-based Product Manager to break down priorities into deliverable increments that drive real progress toward launch
  • Prioritise ruthlessly: Make clear decisions about what matters most, balancing customer value, business impact, speed, scope, and risk
  • Drive outcomes, not just output: Ensure the team is focused on delivering features that impact acquisition, conversion, engagement, and business outcomes, not just completing tickets
  • Keep the team moving fast: Remove blockers, clarify requirements, and maintain momentum in a high-urgency environment
  • Work iteratively: Ship in small increments, gather feedback quickly, and continuously refine based on real usage
  • Partner with Engineering & Design: Align on scope, trade-offs, and sequencing to balance speed, quality, and impact and launch goals
  • Operate AI-first: Use AI tools to improve overall team efficiency, accelerate backlog creation and refinement, and streamline documentation
  • Maintain clarity in ambiguity: Bring structure to evolving priorities, ensuring the team always knows what matters most and why, and what can wait


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience as a Product Owner, Product Analyst, or similar role
  • Strong experience in B2B2C or B2C products
  • Experience working on 0→1 or rebuild products in high ambiguity and fast iteration
  • Strong backlog management and prioritisation skills
  • Proven ability to drive delivery and make sound trade-off decisions in fast-paced, cross-functional teams
  • Experience translating high-level product direction into clear, actionable requirements
  • Strong collaboration with Engineering, Design, and Product stakeholders
  • Clear communicator who can align teams and surface trade-offs effectively
  • Comfortable working with a distributed team
  • A mindset focused on outcomes, customer value, and business impact, not just output

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in property technology or ILS-style products
  • Experience in lead-based, conversion focused environments
  • Background in scale-ups or high-growth environments
  • Familiarity with agile delivery in fast-moving teams
  • Experience using AI tools to improve product delivery workflows

Reasons to join our Team:

  • Opportunity to be a part of a well-established, high-performance company that has been in business for over 30+ years
  • A supportive team environment with emphasis on learning and development opportunities
  • Our Promise: You will learn, grow, and be appreciated for your impact and contributions.
  • Z-Factor: Our most celebrated value, you will work with a team of caring, high-performing, and passionate people who have fun supporting our vision, innovation, and continuous improvement.

Even if you don't have all of the Preferred Qualifications listed above, but feel you have what it takes to succeed in the role, we would love to hear from you!

We are proud of our diverse workforce and are dedicated to creating a safe and welcoming environment for all employees. People from various ethnicities, ages, genders, and abilities are encouraged to apply.

Notice to external Recruiters and Recruitment Agencies:

StarRez will not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies, headhunters, or any other third parties for this role through this website or directly to any employee. StarRez and any of our subsidiaries will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company. In addition, we ask that you do not reach out to any employee with regards to this position, or any other positions, now, or in the future.

StarRez is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Principal Statistician - Early Phase
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Principal Statistician - Early Phase based in Switzerland.

As a Principal Statistician specializing in early-phase clinical development, you will provide strategic statistical expertise throughout the full lifecycle of clinical studies, from protocol development to clinical study reporting. You will act as a key scientific partner, supporting study design, statistical analysis, regulatory activities, and high-quality data-driven decision-making. Working with multidisciplinary global teams, you will contribute to innovative healthcare solutions while mentoring statisticians and ensuring excellence across project delivery. This role offers the opportunity to influence complex clinical programs, collaborate with experts across functions, and make a meaningful impact on the development of new therapies.

Accountabilities

  • Serve as a senior statistical expert supporting clinical studies across all phases of development, from protocol design through clinical study report (CSR) completion.
  • Provide statistical leadership on assigned projects, including study design, analysis strategies, randomization approaches, and interpretation of clinical trial results.
  • Develop, review, and oversee Statistical Analysis Plans (SAPs), including specifications and mock-up tables, listings, and figures.
  • Support the creation and review of analysis datasets, statistical programming specifications, and clinical trial documentation.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams including clinical, data management, programming, regulatory, and project management stakeholders to ensure successful study delivery.
  • Conduct quality control reviews of statistical deliverables to ensure accuracy, consistency with analysis plans, and compliance with applicable standards.
  • Mentor and support biostatistics colleagues by sharing expertise, providing training, and contributing to professional development initiatives.
  • Lead complex studies, integrated analyses, regulatory submissions, and interactions with regulatory agencies when required.
  • Support Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) and Data Monitoring Committee (DMC) activities, including statistical input and review.
  • Contribute to business development activities through proposal support, budgeting input, and participation in client discussions.

    • Requirements

    • Graduate degree in Biostatistics, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative discipline.
    • Extensive experience in clinical trials, biostatistics, or a comparable research environment, with demonstrated ability to lead complex projects.
    • Strong understanding of statistical methodology, clinical trial design, analysis techniques, and relevant regulatory guidelines such as ICH standards.
    • Experience supporting the complete statistical lifecycle of clinical studies, including protocol development, SAP creation, analysis, and CSR preparation.
    • Proficiency in R programming and experience applying statistical programming techniques in clinical research environments.
    • Experience reviewing or supporting regulatory submissions is highly desirable.
    • Strong ability to communicate complex statistical concepts clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
    • Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and work effectively in a global, remote environment.
    • Experience mentoring colleagues or providing statistical guidance to junior team members is an advantage.

      • Benefits

      • Fully remote working opportunity from Europe with flexible work arrangements.
      • Opportunity to contribute to meaningful clinical research programs that support the development of new therapies.
      • Collaboration with international teams of scientific and healthcare experts.
      • Career development opportunities through training, mentorship, and exposure to diverse therapeutic areas.
      • Access to a global environment focused on innovation, knowledge sharing, and professional growth.
      • Opportunity to work on complex clinical studies and gain experience across different stages of drug development.
      • Inclusive workplace culture that values collaboration, diversity, and individual contributions.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Windows/Desktop Applications - Cardiff, United Kingdom
description:
Mission

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies

What You'll Do
  • Lead the design, architecture, and development of native Windows desktop applications using Windows App SDK, WinUI (or related UI frameworks), C#, XAML, and — when needed — C++.
  • Define and enforce best-practices for Windows desktop development across the codebase: code architecture, performance, memory usage, responsive UI, cross-version compatibility (Windows 10/11+), and maintainability.
  • Drive accessibility efforts: integrate and validate support for accessibility APIs (e.g. Microsoft UI Automation or other relevant Windows accessibility frameworks), ensure UI controls, focus management, keyboard navigation, screen-reader support, and usability for users with disabilities.

title: Product Quality Engineer – Reliability & Environmental Qualification
description:
Job Description

Agilent inspires and supports discoveries that advance quality of life. We provide life science, diagnostic and applied market laboratories worldwide with instruments, services, consumables, applications and expertise. Agilent enables customers to gain the answers and insights they seek—so they can do what they do best: improve the world around us. Information about Agilent is available at .

The Santa Clara Site Quality Engineering Services (QES) organization provides quality leadership, testing, and qualification services for local R&D groups as part of New Product Introduction programs, as well as select manufacturing sites worldwide. This role sits within the Product Quality (Environmental) Team.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead product quality evaluations by reviewing design intent, customer use conditions, risk areas, and qualification evidence to determine whether products meet defined quality and reliability expectations.

  • Develop and document test plans that define objectives, acceptance criteria, sample requirements, test methods, environmental stresses, transportation conditions, operational conditions, and reporting expectations.

  • Coordinate and support test execution, including setup verification, data collection, deviation documentation, issue escalation, and cross-functional communication of test status and risks.

  • Evaluate test reports and qualification results for completeness, traceability, technical accuracy, acceptance criteria alignment, and clear conclusions that support design release or corrective action decisions.

  • Define and communicate basic design quality requirements for transportation and operational environments, including handling, vibration, temperature, humidity, installation, and normal-use conditions.

  • Interface with Manufacturing Quality to assist in defining, maintaining, and improving process control points that support product quality, manufacturability, and reliability.

  • Set and communicate reliability requirements and targets at system/subsystem/component levels; facilitate Design FMEA sessions to drive reliable design choices and improve verification test programs.

  • Specify reliability validation plans using physics-of-failure; provide guidance on sample size and test durations for accelerated life testing, and apply reliability statistics (e.g., Weibull, MLE, Bayesian methods, Monte Carlo).

  • Analyze usage and environmental conditions (lab/field) to refine requirements and test methods; drive reliability assessments in design reviews and clearly communicate risk through each phase of development and post-release.

  • Work with Design Engineers to create/interpret/validate numeric models of fielded and in-test products; leverage CAE/ECAD/MCAD data in 3D finite element reliability models.

  • Provide reliability design guidelines, apply lessons learned, and enable proactive health monitoring to grow reliability and minimize field failures.

  • Develop Reliability Demonstration Tests (RDT) and Ongoing Reliability Tests (ORT); contribute to structural/environmental qualifications and analyze results (MTBF, MTTR, Availability, AFR) to drive improvements.

Qualifications

  • BS or MS in a relevant engineering field, or equivalent scientific degree with demonstrated experience in reliability engineering, product qualification, or technical product development.

  • 8+ years in hardware development, reliability, or compliance, with experience leading execution of processes/projects and communicating technical topics to interdisciplinary audiences.

  • Proficiency with the standard office suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint).

  • Practical understanding of accelerated testing methods, governing equations, and physics of failure; applied statistics and reliability statistics (e.g., Weibull).

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Expertise in analytical instrumentation, including GC/MS, LC/MS, Liquid Handling Robotic systems.

  • Experience in scientific instrumentation and vacuum system design, development, and troubleshooting.

  • Leadership in cross-functional reliability and quality improvement programs.

  • Strong background in product lifecycle support, including quality review processes and continuous improvement.

  • Advanced knowledge of mass spectrometry theory and applications for complex systems.

  • Excellent communication skills for diverse technical audiences and cross-disciplinary collaboration.

title: STEM DEPARTMENT CHAIR
description:
Full-Time Founding Leadership Position · Reports to the Principal · Master’s degree required in Education, Educational Leadership, Science, Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field; doctorate preferred · Illinois Professional Educator License in high school math and science preferred and National Board Certification a major plus · 3+ years of successful teaching experience required · Some form of leadership experience is required; Department, administration, or instructional leadership preferred · College-preparatory, independent, Jewish day or faith-based school experience is a plus · Being Jewish is not a requirement for this role · Fewer years but exceptional craft? We hire for mastery, not seat time.

Are you an accomplished educator and academic leader passionate about teaching and learning in STEM? Do you want the opportunity to shape and lead a world-class STEM program that prepares students for college, leadership, innovation, and impact? Are you passionate about cultivating intellectual curiosity, academic excellence, problem-solving, research, and innovation in the lives of young people? If so, Davis School Chicago wants to hear from you.

The Dream Team

Davis School Chicago is a proudly Jewish, college-preparatory high school opening in fall 2027 in downtown Chicago, in a state-of-the-art building at the heart of a great city for learning. Every adult at Davis is an educator and a culture-builder. We hold two expectations at the same time: deep human warmth and uncompromising intellectual excellence. High health and high results, never one at the cost of the other. This is a summary of the characteristics that describe our dream team. Please read the full Profile of the Ideal Davis Educator and more information about our opportunities before you apply.

To thrive here you are:

  • Warm and intellectually formidable. Genuinely kind and seriously bright. We hire for intellectual horsepower; only sharp minds grow students to their full potential.

  • You bring the room to life. Passion people feel, loud or quiet, with the range to teach, support, and lead.

  • A builder who owns it. Startup grit, a real growth mindset, open about mistakes, gives the gift of feedback, and the drive to create what doesn’t exist yet.

  • Teach how to think, not what to think. Rigor, evidence, and a love of hard questions, including the controversial ones. Students reach their own conclusions.

  • Rooted in tradition, built for what’s next. Ancient wisdom and modern tools, AI included, aimed at today's problems.

  • Unapologetically Jewish. Israel has a right to exist; that is not up for debate. Everything else is fair game, including spirited debate about Israel’s actions. You’re excited to help build a proudly Jewish, pro-Israel school.

What Davis Needs

Davis is hiring a rigorous, inventive STEM Chair to build our mathematics, science, and engineering program from its first course map, and to teach in it every day. As a founding leader, the Chair is a member of the team opening a school from scratch. Therefore, the person needs to be a builder-leader: someone who can take a bold founding vision and turn it into a living school, then run a department in that school at a level of excellence every student, parent, and teacher can feel.

Who Thrives in This Role

  • Warm, Relational, and High-Performing – Kind, emotionally intelligent, intellectually rigorous, and committed to excellence.

  • A Teacher First – Leads from the classroom and teaches every day.

  • A Rigorous Problem-Solver – Models mathematical and scientific thinking students can feel.

  • An Entrepreneurial Builder – Thrives in ambiguity, solves problems, and creates programs, systems, and traditions from the ground up.

  • A Curious and Courageous Thinker – Embraces learning, evidence, critical thinking, and meaningful debate.

  • Rooted and Forward-Looking – Honors tradition while embracing innovation, technology, and AI.

  • Committed to Jewish Life and Community – Values Jewish identity, the diversity of Jewish thought, and meaningful engagement in Jewish life.

  • A Collaborative Culture-Builder – Balances accountability, care, and results while elevating everyone around them.

The Role

The STEM Department Chair is the academic and instructional leader of the STEM Department and serves as a key member of the school’s academic leadership team. Reporting to the Principal, the Chair provides vision, leadership, supervision, and support for faculty and curriculum across the STEM disciplines, including mathematics, science, engineering, and computer science.

This is a founding seat. Build a STEM program respected for academic excellence, and make Davis a destination for exceptional STEM education. The STEM Chair will establish a cohesive departmental vision, cultivate a culture of professional excellence, and develop an innovative, college-preparatory curriculum that reflects Davis School Chicago’s mission and values. The Chair will champion interdisciplinary learning, evidence-based instructional practices, student-centered pedagogy, and authentic assessment while helping to build a signature STEM program recognized for intellectual rigor and academic distinction.

This is a teaching chair, and the balance evolves by design. In the launch years, the Chair carries a substantial teaching load while building the department from scratch. As the school grows, the role carries increasing dedicated time for curriculum development, classroom observation and coaching, and professional development planning — the steady state Davis is building toward.

1. Academic Vision and Department Leadership

  • Develop and articulate a compelling vision for STEM education that aligns with the school’s mission, strategic priorities, and educational philosophy.

  • Lead the design, implementation, evaluation, and continuous improvement of a vertically aligned STEM curriculum across mathematics, science, engineering, and computer science.

  • Exercise founding-level design authority: architect the STEM course sequence from first principles — integrated, accelerated, and other ambitious models are welcome — provided the result meets or exceeds AP frameworks and prepares students for the most selective colleges.

  • Ensure curricular coherence, rigor, and relevance across all grade levels and disciplines.

  • Promote interdisciplinary learning experiences that connect STEM with the humanities, Jewish studies, arts, and real-world issues.

  • Monitor emerging research, best practices, and innovations in STEM education and integrate them into departmental programs.

  • Evaluate emerging trends in artificial intelligence, engineering, computer science, sustainability, and innovation education.

  • Analyze student achievement data and assessment outcomes to strengthen teaching and learning.

  • Build a culture that values scientific inquiry, creativity, innovation, problem-solving, and intellectual curiosity.

  • Build the department around the accomplished-practice standards for mathematics and science teaching (National Board for Professional Teaching Standards), including their signature commitments: students reason and think mathematically, investigate and explore patterns, and work with equipment and resources as similar as possible to those used by practicing scientists.

  • Build relationships with universities, research institutions, technology organizations, healthcare systems, and industry partners and develop signature STEM experiences that distinguish Davis School Chicago among leading college-preparatory schools.

  • Serve as an ambassador for STEM education within the school and broader community.

  • Showcase student achievement through competitions, presentations, exhibitions, and public events.

2. Faculty Leadership and Professional Growth

  • Recruit, hire, onboard, mentor, supervise, and evaluate department faculty.

  • Foster a collaborative professional culture focused on continuous growth, reflective practice, and instructional excellence.

  • Serve as an instructional coach, providing regular feedback and support to teachers.

  • Lead department meetings, professional learning initiatives, curriculum reviews, and collaborative planning sessions.

  • Support teachers in implementing innovative instructional strategies and meaningful assessments.

  • Encourage faculty leadership and cultivate opportunities for professional growth and advancement.

  • Promote a culture of accountability, collegiality, and shared responsibility for student success.

  • Facilitate weekly common planning time centered on student work, so the department's collaboration is about what students actually produce.

  • Run a peer observation and coaching cycle focused on one targeted instructional area at a time.

  • Co-lead the school's instructional leadership team

  • Lead a department that is both high-health and high-results, never one at the cost of the other.

3. Teaching and Learning Excellence

  • Model exemplary teaching and instructional leadership.

  • Support faculty in creating engaging, student-centered classrooms that challenge students academically while nurturing student voice and agency.

  • Ensure curriculum and instruction prepare students for success in selective colleges and universities.

  • Master the Advanced Placement frameworks that anchor the STEM sequence — AP Calculus, AP Statistics, AP Biology, AP Chemistry, AP Physics, and AP Computer Science — and design a program that meets or exceeds them. At Davis, top AP scores are the byproduct of rich, rigorous instruction, never of test-prep culture.

  • Promote inquiry-based learning, mathematical reasoning, laboratory research, and project-based experiences, including immersive and experiential approaches where they deepen mastery.

  • Partner with faculty to develop authentic assessments that measure student growth and mastery.

  • Advance the effective integration of educational technology and emerging instructional tools.

4. Student Experience and Community Engagement

  • Collaborate with faculty and school leaders to create enriching student experiences inside and outside the classroom.

  • Support and develop co-curricular STEM programs including robotics, mathematics competitions, science research, coding, engineering, and innovation initiatives.

  • Champion portfolio-worthy student work — original research, engineering projects, publications, and competition results — that gives students distinctive evidence of their abilities for college admissions.

  • Partner with college counseling to support students pursuing STEM majors and careers.

  • Partner with families to support student growth and academic success.

  • Serve as a visible and engaged presence in the life of the school community.

  • Help cultivate a culture of belonging, respect, dialogue, and intellectual engagement.

5. Strategic Planning and School Leadership

  • Serve as a key thought partner to the Principal and academic leadership team.

  • Participate in school-wide strategic planning and institutional initiatives.

  • Contribute to accreditation, assessment, and school improvement efforts.

  • Assist in developing and managing departmental budgets, laboratories, makerspaces, equipment, and technology resources.

  • Ensure compliance with safety standards, risk management policies, and laboratory protocols.

  • Coordinate department scheduling, course offerings, and staffing needs.

  • Ensure compliance with applicable reporting, accreditation, and regulatory requirements.

  • Help establish traditions, signature programs, and distinguishing features of the Davis STEM program.

Qualifications

  • Education: Master’s degree in Education, Educational Leadership, Science, Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field required; doctorate preferred.

  • Licensure: Illinois Professional Educator License preferred (high school math and science) with National Board Certification highly preferred.

  • Experience: 3+ years of successful STEM teaching experience required. College-preparatory, independent, Jewish day or faith-based school experience is a plus.

  • Leadership: Some form of leadership experience with adults is required; instructional leadership preferred.

Core Competencies

  1. Instructional Leadership: coaching, observation, and common planning time centered on student work.

  2. Curriculum and Assessment: rigorous, coherent, college-preparatory design across the STEM disciplines.

  3. Talent and Team: a high-health, high-results department culture.

  4. Teaching: daily classroom excellence.

Compensation and Benefits

The anticipated annual salary range for this position is $77,543–$137,099, based on the school’s established Faculty Salary Schedule. In addition, this leadership role carries a leadership differential of $4,000–$8,000, determined by years of leadership experience. Placement within the salary range is determined by a combination of relevant leadership experience and educational attainment, including Bachelor's, Master's, Master's + additional graduate credits, Education Specialist (Ed.S.), and Doctoral (Ed.D./Ph.D.) degrees, in accordance with the school’s step-and-lane compensation structure. Final compensation will be determined consistent with the school’s compensation philosophy, internal equity, and established salary schedule. In addition to base salary, the position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package that includes paid time off, holiday pay, medical insurance, and a 401(k) plan with employer match.

How We Hire

Our process is thorough and we believe that hiring is a dual decision-making process; you are vetting us as much as we are vetting you. Our process includes focused conversations with the people you would work with, a battery of assessments we use for your development as much as for selection, and interview rounds both in-person and virtually. We move quickly, and we tell you where you stand.

Is this you?

This isn’t for everyone. If it’s you, it may be the best work of your life. Read the full Profile of the Ideal Davis Educator, then apply.

title: Security Guard
description:
Job Description:

Job Description:

Do you enjoy working in a fast-paced, safety-obsessed aviation environment?

As an Aircraft Security Guard, you will be responsible for a wide range of functions to maintain positive control of the aircraft at all times and ensure the safety of the air crew members and cargo.


Alliance Ground International (AGI) is one of the largest independently owned ground handling companies providing services to 100+ airlines in 61 airports across the U.S. and Canada. We are the home to over 12,000 team members supporting over 1.5B Kilos and over 400K departures. Our Ground division has a strong reputation in aviation ground services. We are committed to providing the highest quality service and continuing our outstanding safety track record. As we continue to grow, we only look for the best in the industry.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Monitor and maintain controlled access of the aircraft entrance and its surroundings.

  • Screen individuals and their belongings prior to aircraft boarding or airport operation area entry.

  • Search aircraft for unauthorized material and/or personnel.

  • Transport pilots to and from the aircraft to their destinations.

  • Inspect items, using x-ray viewing equipment, to determine whether items contain objects that warrant further investigation.

  • Maintain working knowledge of all emergency policies, procedures and regulations

  • Report all suspicious items or activity to management to determine the correct course of action.

  • Maintain security of cargo and any company equipment. Observe that cargo has not been tampered with or that pilferage has not taken place. Report incidents to supervisor as needed.

  • Maintain work area in clean condition, reporting damaged or broken equipment as needed.

  • Complete paperwork and forms connected with work assignments pertaining to procedures and enter data into company's information system as required.

  • Follow company procedures and protocols to ensure we are always operating in a safe and responsible manner.

  • Complete all training when required by company, airport governing authority, or customer when required.

  • Be on time, be prepared, and be safe. Be willing to work flexible hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays.

Safety, Security and Compliance:

All AGI Team members have a responsibility and duty while at work to:

  • Take reasonable care for the health, wellbeing, safety, and security of themselves and of others who may be affected by their actions or omissions while at work.

  • Cooperate with their manager / supervisor to allow them to perform or comply with any legal requirements imposed on the company.

  • Not intentionally or recklessly interfere with or misuse anything provided by the company in the interests of health, wellbeing, safety, security or welfare reasons.

  • Inform their manager / supervisor of any work situation, equipment, or activity that represents a serious or immediate danger to health, wellbeing, safety, and security.

  • Report any hazards, near misses, incidents, accidents, or dangerous occurrences to their manager / supervisor, who will then follow the procedures contained in company and carrier Safety and Security procedures.

  • Carry out work in accordance with information and training provided and any specific health, wellbeing, safety, and security rules or procedures.

  • Fully understand AGI Health & Safety and Security policies.

  • Attend training courses as may be required by AGI.

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to walk and stand on a frequent basis and for extended periods.

  • Must be able to be alerted to moving vehicles or aircraft and use radio equipment to communicate with crew and airport authorities.

  • Must be able to work in extreme weather conditions around jet and machinery noises.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Professional presentation: Must have a well-groomed appearance and customer service-oriented attitude.

  • Good communication skills: Security Guards must be able to communicate information and instructions verbally and/or via radio equipment effectively in a professional manner with the flight crew, gate agents, and other ground crew.

  • Problem-solving skills: Security Guards must be able to assess security concerns and follow reporting procedure to reduce risk of security breaches.

  • Time management skills: Security Guards must be able to manage their time effectively to complete tasks efficiently in a fast-paced environment.

Qualifications:

  • Possess a high school diploma, GED, or work experience equivalent.

  • Possess a valid driver’s license with a clean driving record.

  • If work location is in the United States, must have authorization to work in the United States as defined by the Immigration Reform Act of 1986. If work location is in Canada, must have authorization to work in Canada as defined by the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act (IRPA) of 2001.

  • Must complete ramp and SIDA training to obtain airport authority identification security.

  • If required by customer or role access, be able to secure a Customs Seal through the respective governing agency.

  • Must obtain Security Guard Card within 90 day probation period.

  • Preferred Qualifications - One+ year of relevant experience.

AGI offers a comprehensive benefit package for all employees, including paid vacation and medical / dental / vision for full-time qualified employees as well as medical coverage for part time employees. AGI also provides free uniforms and free on-the-job training to all employees.

Additional benefits include company-matched 401(k) program, company-paid employee assistance program, voluntary life insurance, and travel discounts on car rentals, hotels, and cruises to name a few.

The successful AGI team member brings their “A” game every day with energy and enthusiasm, respect for their team, and the highest regard for safety!

title: Product Line Director - EW Systems
description:
Worker Type

Regular

Job Description

Job Summary

AV is growing and we are seeking an experienced Product Line Director (PLD) for the AV EW (Electronic Warfare) Systems group. The PLD will be responsible for overall product line ownership, assist with management of production programs, assist with program execution, and lifecycle management across the AV EW Systems portfolio. This role serves as the business and execution lead for AV EW Systems programs, partnering closely with the AV EW leadership, chief engineering team and business development team to drive the technical roadmap while ensuring disciplined execution from concept development through production, fielding, and sustainment.

The PLD is responsible for program performance, cost, schedule, risk, and customer satisfaction, and acts as the primary interface between customers, AV EW senior leadership and chief engineering team. This position plays a critical role in scaling EW System capabilities into operational systems for U.S. Government customers.

Position Responsibilities:

Product Line & Program Leadership -

  • Responsible for end-to-end execution of the AV EW Systems product line across all phases of the program lifecycle: capture, development, integration, production, fielding, and sustainment.
  • For programs associated with the AV EW Systems group the PLD is responsible for cost, schedule, technical performance, and delivery commitments.
  • Partner with the AV EW leadership and chief engineering team to align technical roadmap, architecture decisions, and capability evolution with customer requirements and business strategy.
  • Lead cross-functional integrated product teams (IPTs) including engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, quality, contracts, and finance.

Financial & Program Control -

  • Develop, manage, and execute program budgets, EACs, forecasts, and margin performance.
  • Ensure disciplined program controls, risk management, and change management across contracts.
  • Drive affordability, scalability, and producibility initiatives aligned with customer acquisition strategies.
  • Support pricing strategies, proposal development, and negotiation for new programs, follow-ons, and production options.

Customer & Stakeholder Engagement -

  • Act as a senior customer interface for AV EW Systems programs with U.S. Army, NNSA, U.S. Air Force, and other DoD and interagency stakeholders.
  • Support customer engagements including design reviews, program reviews, test events, fielding activities, and operational demonstrations.
  • Translate evolving customer CONOPS and mission needs into executable program plans and product enhancements.
  • Represent the AV EW Systems product line in internal and external executive-level forums.

Execution, Production & Sustainment -

  • Drive transition from development to production, including supply chain readiness, manufacturing scale-up, and quality assurance.
  • Oversee sustainment planning, field support, spares, upgrades, and lifecycle cost reduction efforts.
  • Ensure alignment with modular open systems approaches (MOSA) and long-term sustainment strategies.
  • Support deployed systems with responsiveness and operational urgency.

Required Skills & Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Physics, Business, or a related field (advanced degree preferred).
  • 10+ years of experience in defense programs, product line management, or program management.
  • Demonstrated experience leading SIGINT/Cyber/EW/C-U systems developments.
  • Strong working knowledge of EACs, program financials, earned value concepts, and execution metrics.
  • Experience working directly with U.S. Army, NNSA, U.S. Air Force, and/or other government customers.
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams delivering complex, mission-critical systems.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, execution-driven environment.
  • Currently posses and is able to maintain an active U.S. Top Secret security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Masters or PhD degree in Hardware or Software Engineering Disciplines or related fields.
  • Advanced knowledge of wireless technology
  • Advanced knowledge of SIGINT/Cyber/EW/C-UAS systems
  • Advanced knowledge of Digital Signal Processing
  • Advanced knowledge of Firmware/Embedded Signal Processing
  • Familiarity with Artificial Intelligence Machine Learning (AI/ML) and application to EW systems
  • Proven track record of delivering larger Department of War (DoW) programs (+$10M)
  • Familiarity with DoW acquisition pathways, OTAs, rapid capability offices, and transition-to-program-of-record efforts
  • Currently posses and is able to maintain an active U.S. Top Secret/SCI security clearance.

Physical Demands:

  • Occasionally required to stand.
  • Occasionally required to walk.
  • Occasionally required to sit.
  • Continually required to talk or hear.

Environmental Conditions Critical to Performance:

  • Occasionally/Frequently/Continually works around fumes, airborne particles, or toxic chemicals.
  • Occasionally/Frequently/Continually exposed to outside weather conditions.
  • Occasionally/Frequently/Continually exposed to extreme heat or cold (non-weather).
  • While performing the duties of this job, the noise level in the work environment is usually very quiet
  • The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds and/or move up to 50
  • Specific vision abilities required by this job include: close vision; distance vision; color vision; peripheral vision; depth perception and ability to adjust focus.
  • Occasionally/Frequently/Continually required to taste or smell.
  • Occasionally/Frequently/Continually exposed to wet and/or humid conditions (non-weather).

Special Requirements

Experience Strategy & Delivery Execution

    • Experience capability maps
    • Value streams and customer journeys

  • Identify experience and capability gaps and recommend solutions that balance customer value, delivery feasibility, and business impact.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Serve as a day-to-day experience strategy partner for Product Delivery teams supporting Group Specialty lines of business.

  • Ensure alignment to enterprise standards, accessibility requirements, and brand guidelines.

Decision Rights & Scope

  • Owns execution-level experience strategy and delivery outcomes for assigned Group Specialty initiatives.
  • Makes recommendations on prioritization, sequencing, and design within defined strategic guardrails.
  • Escalates enterprise-level trade-offs, architectural conflicts, and strategic shifts to the Principal.

This role is a feeder to the Principal, Experience Strategy & Transformation position, building depth in strategic execution, delivery leadership, and business architecture to support broader enterprise accountability.

  • Experience working with Microsoft collaboration and productivity tools.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in healthcare, insurance, financial services, or other regulated industries.

description:
The Opportunity

At APA, our purpose is to secure Australia’s energy future. We’re not doing it alone. We’re doing it with our customers and communities as Australia’s energy infrastructure partner, a role our unique experience and expertise positions us to play.

Service Management Team Lead

Are you an experienced Service Management leader who thrives on driving operational excellence, resilience, and continual improvement? We're seeking a leader to mature Technology's Service Management capabilities.

About the Role

As the Service Management Team Lead, you'll lead and govern Technology's Service Management function, driving service excellence, operational resilience, and customer-focused outcomes. You'll play a pivotal role in strengthening service maturity, improving operational performance, and ensuring critical technology services are reliable, recoverable, and aligned to business needs.

What You'll Do

  • Lead, coach and develop the Service Management team, fostering a high-performing, customer-focused and continually improving culture.
  • Govern and continually improve Technology's core Service Management practices, including Incident, Major Incident, Change Enablement, Problem, Request, Knowledge, Configuration, Service Continuity and Service Level Management.
  • Lead enterprise Major Incident response, coordinating cross-functional teams, facilitating management and technical bridges where required, and providing clear communications to senior stakeholders.
  • Govern Technology's Disaster Recovery and Service Continuity capabilities, including recovery planning, testing, operational readiness, and resilience governance.
  • Establish, maintain, and promote Service Management standards, processes and operating procedures, ensuring consistent adoption across Technology and where appropriate across the enterprise.
  • Drive service performance, operational health and continual improvement through reporting, insights, trend analysis, and stakeholder feedback.
  • Partner with Technology teams, business stakeholders, vendors, and managed service providers to improve service quality, resilience and operational effectiveness.

What You'll Bring

  • Extensive experience leading Service Management functions within a complex enterprise environment.
  • Strong knowledge of ITIL-based Service Management practices and governance.
  • Proven experience leading Major Incident Management and coordinating enterprise response during critical operational events.
  • Demonstrated experience governing Disaster Recovery, Service Continuity, and organisational resilience.
  • Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and executive communication skills.
  • Experience developing and managing high-performing teams and embedding a culture of continual improvement.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills, with a focus on measurable business outcomes.
  • Experience with ServiceNow or a comparable enterprise IT Service Management platform.
  • Experience managing vendors and managed service providers.

Desirable

  • ITIL 4 Managing Professional or Strategic Leader certification.
  • Knowledge of ISO 20000, ISO 22301 or similar governance frameworks.
  • Exposure to Agile, Lean and/or project delivery environments.

Working at APA

At APA, we’re committed to fostering a safe and inclusive workplace where you can achieve your best.

We offer targeted career development programs designed to accelerate your career, competitive remuneration, employee benefits, flexible working arrangements, and wellbeing initiatives are all part of what we’ll offer you. Our inclusive parental leave policy offers 18 weeks of leave, including superannuation, to support parents at work and in life.

We employ around 2,000 people across Australia and are committed to building a high-performing, customer-focused organisation where everyone feels safe, valued, and trusted to perform at their best.

We are APA

At APA, we’re taking on one of Australia’s greatest challenges:​ the energy transition.​ We’re not doing it alone. We’re doing it as Australia’s energy infrastructure partner, a role our unique experience and expertise positions us to play.​

​

We proudly own, operate and manage a diverse $20 billion portfolio of assets which deliver essential services to communities and customers across Australia. And we own more than 15,000 kilometres of gas pipelines which deliver energy to households and businesses across every corner of Australia.

As the partner of choice in delivering infrastructure solutions for the energy transition, we’re focused on bundled remote grid energy solutions, electricity and gas transmission, and future energy, including hydrogen and carbon capture and storage.

Our customer focused approach means we understand our customers and offer them reliable, innovative, and cost-effective energy solutions that support their decarbonisation ambitions.

We are committed to securing Australia’s energy future by delivering infrastructure solutions for Australia’s energy transition and supporting the decarbonisation ambitions of our customers and communities.

Join our team and be part of securing Australia’s energy future. We’d love to hear from you.

title: Senior Security Software Engineer
description:
About House Rx

House Rx is a healthcare technology company transforming how specialty medications are managed and delivered within physician practices. We operate in a highly regulated environment where security, reliability, and operational excellence matter every day. We're looking for a hands-on Senior Corporate IT Engineer to own and scale the technology that supports our workforce. This role spans endpoint management, identity and access, SaaS administration, automation, security, and the employee lifecycle.

About the Role

House Rx is hiring a Senior Security Software Engineer to help us build, review, and harden security-sensitive software and infrastructure.

This role sits within Security & IT and will focus on secure code review, production hardening of internal tooling, and cloud/network security coverage. As we scale AI-assisted development, HITRUST readiness, clinic connectivity, and internal systems, we need a senior engineer who can move across code, infrastructure, and security risk with strong, independent judgment. This is someone who can dig deeply into another engineer's work, review it rigorously, push back where needed, and set the technical direction for how we secure what we build.

What You'll Do

  • Build and harden internal security-sensitive tooling alongside engineering and operations teams
  • Dig deeply into engineers' code and review security-sensitive pull requests, especially for systems that may touch PHI
  • Design and enforce security gates and guardrails across the SDLC, including automated CI/CD checks, pre-merge review requirements, and policy-as-code, so insecure or AI-generated code is caught before it ships
  • Support application security reviews across platform and internal tooling
  • Review security-relevant Terraform, cloud, firewall, routing, VPN, IPSec, VPC, and clinic connectivity changes
  • Improve visibility into our security posture across AWS, GCP, clinic networks, and internal applications
  • Help prepare engineering teams for HITRUST and customer security expectations

What We're Looking For

  • Passion for AI safety and the role security engineering plays in building trustworthy AI systems
  • At least 6+ years of software engineering experience implementing and maintaining security-relevant systems in production, including reviewing and raising the bar on other engineers' code
  • Strong programming skills in Python or at least one systems language
  • Experience contributing to cloud security controls
  • Strong understanding of web application security and secure SDLC practices
  • Familiarity with AWS and/or GCP
  • Experience with Terraform or infrastructure-as-code
  • A track record of reviewing PRs and giving clear, practical, and influential security feedback that other engineers act on
  • Working knowledge of authentication, authorization, logging, secrets management, and data protection
  • Strong judgment around sensitive data, especially in healthcare or regulated environments

Nice to Have

  • Healthcare, HIPAA, HITRUST, or SOC 2 experience
  • Experience securing AI-assisted development workflows
  • Experience with Python, TypeScript, Node.js, or similar stacks
  • Experience with Auth0, Okta, Kubernetes, EKS, RDS, or private cloud networking
  • Experience with SAST, SCA, secret scanning, IaC scanning, or software supply chain security

Why this role matters

House Rx is moving quickly. We are building more tooling, expanding our cloud and clinic network footprint, and using AI to accelerate development. This role helps us keep pace without letting security review, secure architecture, or production hardening become bottlenecks.

You will help us ship faster, safer, and with more confidence.

In particular, we offer:

  • Flexible work hours and flexible paid time off
  • Work remotely
  • Generous parental leave
  • Comprehensive healthcare, vision and dental benefits
  • Competitive salary and equity stake
  • We’re backed by forward-thinking investors committed to transforming healthcare, including Bessemer Venture Partners, First Round Capital, LRV Health, Khosla Ventures, Maverick Ventures, 1984.vc, and Character

The base salary range for this role is $160,000 - $190,000 plus meaningful equity stake

This range represents the low and high end of the anticipated base salary. Actual compensation will depend on experience, knowledge, and skills. Packages also include equity, flexible paid time off, and benefits.

More About House Rx

Together, we build and maintain impactful solutions through our pharmacy management system and data insights platform. These tools enable our internal teams, pharmacists, care coordinators, and clinical operations to streamline medication access, while helping external healthcare providers and clinics deliver better patient care.

Our engineering work presents exciting technical challenges as we balance user-facing features with robust internal systems. We release updates daily, requiring thoughtful prioritization and technical excellence while maintaining high quality. This iterative approach means we're constantly delivering meaningful improvements to our healthcare platform.

We're a fun, thoughtful, supportive, and down-to-earth group focused on doing some of the best work of our lives. We know software is built by people, and we're committed to taking care of both the people we work with and the patients whose lives we touch through our technology.

title: Principal System Quality Engineer
description:

title: Claims Handling Representative (Remote)
description:
At Globe Life, we are committed to empowering our employees with the support and opportunities they need to succeed at every stage of their career. We take pride in fostering a caring and innovative culture that enables us to collectively grow and overcome challenges in a connected, collaborative, and mutually respectful environment that calls us to help Make Tomorrow Better.

Role Overview:

Could you be our next Claims Handling Representative? Globe Life is looking for a Claims Handling Representative to join the team!

The role is responsible for the prompt and accurate processing of supplemental accident and health claims within established deadlines, while adhering to department procedures and guidelines to ensure compliance with HIPAA, insurance laws and regulations, and state-specific policy and benefit contract provisions. The position involves reviewing medical records and documentation to analyze and apply policy benefits, limitations, and exclusions, as well as maintaining phone correspondence with medical facilities, providers, policyholders, and agents. Additionally, this role supports various department functions, projects, and assignments as directed.

This is a remote/work-from-home position.

What You Will Do:

  • Process all health and accident claims promptly and daily by required deadlines, including reviewing claims documents, medical records, provider bills, receipts, and invoices to apply or deny benefits.
  • Ensure claims are processed accurately and in accordance with company guidelines, department policies and operating procedures, and in compliance with HIPAA, insurance laws and regulations, and state-specific policy and benefit contract provisions.
  • Contact medical facilities, providers, legal entities, policyholders, and agents to obtain necessary documents required to process claims.
  • Apply knowledge of underwriting health questions and medical terminology related to policy applications, waiting periods, and pre-existing conditions.
  • Review system notes and documents to thoroughly explain and provide details on claims status, benefit payments, denials, appeal decisions, and any information needed for pending claims.
  • Handle customer and agent inquiries, issues, and complaints with timely research, follow-up, and resolution in a professional and courteous manner.
  • Ensure customer and agent needs are met on every interaction, and document all phone calls, issues, and correspondence in system notes and the claim file.
  • Meet quality assurance requirements, key performance metrics, and productivity standards.
  • Cross-train with other operational departments on functions that affect claims, including premium deductions, multiple policy limits, cash value, return of premium, and money-back maturity processes.
  • Create written correspondence to clearly communicate with policyholders, including special letters as needed, and complete authorization forms for new claims and medical records requests.
  • Research and correct claims processing errors in a timely manner.
  • Process and respond promptly to miscellaneous customer and agent requests, including mailing of claim forms, information release authorization testimonials, itemized benefits lists, faxes, and issuing of duplicate policies.
  • Communicate pertinent information or issues promptly to the Team Leader, Supervisor, and/or Manager.
  • Identify and recommend areas of improvement for processes, procedures, and system enhancements.
  • Develop an understanding of the processes within the Underwriting, Customer Service, Billing, and Corporate Services departments.
  • Complete training as required by auditors, compliance teams, and state regulations.
  • Assist with various department functions, projects, and assignments as directed.

What You Can Bring:

  • High School Diploma or equivalent.
  • Minimum of 3–5 years of prior phone, customer service, and office experience.
  • Previous experience in a claims service environment preferred; medical terminology or medical office background desirable.
  • Bilingual skills a plus.
  • High level of quality focus on providing excellent customer service with the ability to process a high volume of claims efficiently and accurately.
  • Critical problem-solving, decision-making, and analytical skills with strong attention to detail.
  • Excellent verbal, written, and communication skills with strong organizational and research abilities.
  • Ability to work well under pressure, manage multiple tasks with competing deadlines, both independently and as a team player.

Applicable To All Employees of Globe Life Family of Companies:

  • Reliable and predictable attendance of your assigned shift.

  • Ability to work full time and/or part time based on the position specifications.

How Globe Life Will Support You:

Looking to continue your career in an environment that values your contribution and invests in your growth? We've curated a benefits package that helps to ensure that you don’t just work, but thrive at Globe Life:

  • Competitive compensation designed to reflect your expertise and contribution.

  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance plans because your well-being is fundamental to your performance.

  • Robust life insurance benefits and retirement plans, including company-matched 401k and pension plan.

  • Paid holidays and time off to support a healthy work-life balance.

  • Parental leave to help our employees welcome their new additions.

  • Subsidized all-in-one subscriptions to support your fitness, mindfulness, nutrition, and sleep goals.

  • Company-paid counseling for assistance with mental health, stress management, and work-life balance.

  • Continued education reimbursement eligibility and company-paid FLMI and ICA courses to grow your career.

  • Discounted Texas Rangers tickets for a proud visit to Globe Life Field.

Opportunity awaits! Invest in your professional legacy, realize your path, and see the direct impact you can make in a workplace that celebrates and harnesses your unique talents and perspectives to their fullest potential. At Globe Life, your voice matters.

title: Set Designer
description:
About High Scale

We’re High Scale — a future-focused, data-obsessed agency revolutionizing video advertising on TV and social media. Think Amazon’s obsession with customer experience meets SpaceX’s fearless ambition—that’s the DNA behind everything we do.

Our 120-person team of creatives, strategists, and innovators produces thousands of high-impact campaigns weekly for the world’s leading lifestyle, fashion, beauty, and DTC brands. With 50,000 sq. ft. of DTLA studios and a global influencer network, we're redefining how performance marketing and creative production come together to help brands grow.

We move fast, think creatively, and believe that every detail matters. From a thoughtfully styled living room to a striking product display, our sets play a critical role in bringing stories to life. If you're passionate about design, love transforming concepts into immersive environments, and enjoy working in a collaborative, high-energy production environment, you'll thrive at High Scale.

Why This Role Matters

The right set doesn't just create a beautiful background—it creates an experience.

As a Set Designer, you'll transform creative concepts into visually compelling environments that elevate our productions and strengthen our clients' brands. Every wall, prop, color palette, and furniture choice contributes to the story we're telling and influences how audiences connect with the content.

Working closely with Producers, Creative Strategists, Directors, Cinematographers, and Art Department teams, you'll design and build sets that are visually impactful, production-friendly, and optimized for commercial advertising across television and social media.

Whether it's a luxury beauty campaign, a cozy home setting, a modern kitchen, or a bold lifestyle concept, your creativity and attention to detail will help produce content that captures attention and drives results.

What You'll Do

Design Creative Set Concepts

Translate creative briefs into visually engaging set designs that align with each brand's identity.

Develop mood boards, color palettes, layouts, and styling concepts for commercial productions.

Collaborate with creative teams to ensure every set enhances the intended story and marketing objective.

Present design concepts and recommendations during pre-production planning.

Build & Style Production Sets

Source furniture, props, décor, and materials that bring creative concepts to life.

Prepare, assemble, and style sets for studio and on-location productions.

Ensure every set is camera-ready and visually polished before filming begins.

Adapt set designs quickly to accommodate production changes and creative feedback.

Collaborate Across Production Teams

Work closely with Producers, Directors, Gaffers, Cinematographers, Stylists, and Production Assistants throughout each shoot.

Coordinate with production schedules to ensure sets are completed on time.

Support efficient transitions between multiple productions while maintaining exceptional quality.

Manage Set Inventory & Resources

Maintain an organized inventory of furniture, props, décor, and production materials.

Research and source new design elements that expand the studio's creative capabilities.

Monitor budgets while making thoughtful purchasing recommendations.

Ensure studio spaces remain organized, functional, and production-ready.

Drive Creative Innovation

Stay current with design trends across interiors, retail, fashion, lifestyle, beauty, and social media content.

Continuously introduce fresh visual ideas that elevate production quality.

Identify opportunities to improve workflows, maximize reusable assets, and increase production efficiency.

Who You Are

Experienced Set Designer

3+ years of experience in Set Design, Production Design, Visual Merchandising, Interior Styling, Event Design, or a related creative field.

Experience designing sets for commercial advertising, television, digital media, photography, or branded content is highly preferred.

A strong portfolio showcasing a range of creative environments is required.

Strong Design Eye

You have an exceptional understanding of composition, color theory, spatial design, textures, and visual storytelling.

You know how to create environments that look incredible both in person and through the camera lens.

You understand how lighting, camera angles, and product placement influence design decisions.

Creative Problem Solver

You enjoy transforming ideas into reality while balancing creativity, practicality, timelines, and budgets.

You're resourceful and can create premium-looking environments using both custom-built and sourced materials.

You adapt quickly when creative direction evolves during production.

Highly Organized

You can manage multiple projects, production timelines, and design assets simultaneously.

You maintain organized inventories, documentation, and design resources.

You're proactive in anticipating production needs and ensuring everything is prepared before shoot day.

Thrives in a Fast-Paced Studio Environment

You enjoy collaborative creative work where every day presents a new challenge.

You take ownership of your projects, contribute ideas freely, and are always looking for ways to raise the visual standard of every production.

You believe great design isn't finished until every detail has been thoughtfully considered.

Perks & Benefits

Design Sets Seen by Millions
Bring creative concepts to life for leading lifestyle, beauty, fashion, wellness, and DTC brands across TV and social media.

Work in a World-Class Studio
Create within our 50,000 sq. ft. production facility alongside talented creatives, producers, cinematographers, and designers.

Creative Freedom & Variety
Every project presents a new opportunity to design unique environments across a wide range of industries and brand aesthetics.

Career Growth
Expand your expertise in production design, art direction, creative strategy, and commercial content creation as High Scale continues to grow.

A Culture Built Around Creativity
Join a collaborative team that values craftsmanship, innovation, curiosity, and people who are excited to push creative boundaries.

High Scale is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity because exceptional creativity is fueled by different perspectives, experiences, and ideas. If you're passionate about designing environments that inspire, captivate, and tell unforgettable stories, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Network Engineer
description:
Are you passionate about the chance to bring your IT experience to a world-class organization that is leading the way in both content and technology to serve and protect our citizens home and abroad? Do you have the Network Engineering skills necessary to build and maintain virtualized and containerized environments? If you’re a team player with attention to detail and excellent customer service, then Thomson Reuters Special Services (TRSS) is looking for you!

About the Role
As a Network Engineer, you will work as part of a small, agile team to maintain, secure, and optimize our complex network infrastructure. You will collaborate with IT, DevOps, and security teams to ensure our systems remain reliable, performant, and compliant with industry standards. As a Network Engineer, you will also contribute to a variety of areas including:

  • Maintaining, upgrading, configuring, and securing network equipment and software.

  • Ensuring compliance with security guidelines (SOC2, STIG, NIST, etc.).

  • Troubleshooting connectivity and bandwidth issues.

  • Documenting network configurations, processes, and changes and participate in cross‑training.

  • Coordinating with the IT team on infrastructure initiatives.

  • Participating in establishing and enforcing security compliance policies.

  • Performing after-hours maintenance and support when required.

About You

You’re a good fit for the role of Network Engineer if you have/are:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field. Equivalent experience will be considered in lieu of a degree.

  • Minimum 5 years of network engineering experience.

  • Industry certifications preferred.

  • Strong knowledge of TCP/IP and the OSI model.

  • Experience with AWS networking (Transit Gateway, VPCs, Route53).

  • Familiarity with automation tools (Terraform, Ansible).

  • GitHub experience.

  • Cisco networking platforms (Nexus NX‑OS, Catalyst IOS).

  • Cisco and Palo Alto firewall platforms (Firepower FTD/FMC, PAN‑OS).

  • VMware vSphere networking (distributed switches).

  • Networking for containerized environments.

  • Wireless networking (Wi‑Fi design, security, troubleshooting).

  • High availability networking (LACP).

  • IPsec site‑to‑site VPNs with IKEv2 across different vendors.

  • Remote VPN and SDP solutions (ZTNA).

  • Network and performance monitoring.

  • Network OS patching, updates, hardening.

  • Linux, Apache, Tomcat administration.

  • Scripting (PowerShell, Linux shell).

  • Understanding of programming concepts to support DevOps teams.

title: Senior Clinical Specimen Acquisition Specialist
description:
Senior Clinical Specimen Acquisition Specialist – Job Description

Bring more to life.

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?

Within Danaher the work our diagnostic businesses do saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

We’re accelerating the development of cutting-edge diagnostics to solve some of the world’s most pressing health challenges. Across our diagnostics operating companies we are driving innovation through partnerships with top academic institutions and leading players in biopharma and translational research. We’re bringing the best minds together to accelerate innovation and unlock the full potential of the latest scientific advances. Together, we’re expanding access to precision diagnostics for millions of people worldwide - and we’re using our unmatched global scale and proven playbook to make it happen, from hospital labs to mobile clinics. By helping providers, patients, and families get faster, more precise diagnostic results, we’re improving treatment options and saving lives. Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

The Senior Clinical Specimen Acquisition Specialist is responsible for efficient clinical specimen procurement by coordinating specialized vendors and ensuring specimens meet study requirements, quality standards, and delivery timelines through rigorous documentation practices, cross‑functional collaboration, and continuous improvement of specimen procurement processes.

This position reports to the Senior Manager Global Clinical Procurement and is part of Danaher Diagnostic’s Clinical Center of Excellence (CCOE) organization and will be fully remote.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Procurement of Clinical Specimens: Identify and coordinate specimen vendors for clinical Specimen procurement, aligning their capabilities with study requirements. Manage all necessary documentation, track timelines, order statuses, and deliveries, while maintaining comprehensive records of communications and shipments.
  • Compliance & Documentation Support: Follow SOPs related to Specimen handling, chain of custody, and data integrity to ensure full compliance with applicable regulatory requirements (e.g., FDA, IRB policies). Ensure Specimen documentation is complete, properly labeled, and aligned with procurement or collection protocols. Support audit readiness through accurate filing of logs, consent documentation, shipment records, and system-generated reports.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Clinical Development teams to align specimen inclusion and exclusion criteria, data needed and other specimen requirements. Will coordinate with the Biobank/Biorepository teams for timelines and ensure smooth transfer of Specimens. Participate in cross-functional meetings and contribute to Specimen tracking updates and inventory status reports. Help resolve day-to-day issues related to Specimen documentation, storage capacity, or vendor coordination.
  • Contribute to Process Improvements: Share observations and suggestions for improving workflows and documentation related to prospective Specimen collection. Participate in team discussions focused on optimizing Specimen procurement practices across studies.

The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Biomedical Sciences, Public Health, or related field
  • 2+ years of experience in biospecimen procurement, clinical research coordination, specimen logistics, or biorepository operations.
  • Experience working with clinical sites, specimen vendors, biobanks, CROs, or academic institutions.
  • Experience with specimen tracking, chain of custody, sample accessioning, and inventory management systems.
  • Understanding of biospecimen types, storage requirements, and quality considerations.

It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

  • Working knowledge of GCP, FDA, ICH-GCP, IRB, and related regulatory requirements.
  • Strong organizational and documentation skills, with attention to detail in tracking Specimens and verifying paperwork.
  • The ability to prioritize tasks, follow SOPs, and work independently in a time-sensitive, regulated environment.

It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

  • Knowledge of regulatory and ethical standards related to clinical Specimen handling, such as GCP, FDA 21 CFR Part 11, ICH-GCP, and IRB/ethics requirements.

  • Strong organizational and documentation skills, with attention to detail in tracking Specimens and verifying paperwork.

  • The ability to prioritize tasks, follow SOPs, and work independently in a time-sensitive, regulated environment.

Within Danaher Diagnostics, we offer a broad array of comprehensive, competitive benefit programs that add value to our lives. Whether it’s a health care program or paid time off, our programs contribute to life beyond the job. Check out our benefits at Danaher Benefits Info.
