title: Senior InfoSec GRC Analyst
description:
Register Here!

Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the role:

At Camunda, hundreds of enterprises trust us to orchestrate their most critical business processes, and that trust is something we earn every single day. As our Senior InfoSec GRC Analyst, you will join a small, senior, and highly collaborative InfoSec team that lives our FAITH values (Focus, Ambition, Integrity, Talent and Humor) in everyday work. You will own the governance, risk, and compliance side of our security practice: keeping our ISMS healthy, driving our ISO 27001 and SOC 2 audit cycles, reviewing the security requirements our customers put in front of us, and replacing manual compliance work with automation wherever we can. It is a role with real ownership and plenty of cross functional contact, from Legal and Procurement to IT and our PreSales and PostSales teams, and your work will show up directly in how confidently customers adopt Camunda.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Own and continuously improve Camunda's Information Security Management System (ISMS), spotting gaps, closing them, and making measurable improvements rather than just keeping documents current.

  • Drive our security audit cycle for ISO 27001, SOC 2, and future frameworks with minimal supervision, working directly with external auditors and internal control owners to keep evidence, findings, and timelines on track.

  • Review the information security requirements in customer contracts, redline what we cannot realistically meet, and give our negotiators clear, practical recommendations they can act on.

  • Lead responses to complex customer security questionnaires and act as a trusted point of contact for InfoSec topics coming from PreSales, PostSales, and customer security teams.

  • Run and improve our GRC tooling, adding automation and continuous monitoring so compliance evidence is collected once and reused, not rebuilt every audit season.

  • Take ownership of emerging InfoSec compliance topics such as the Cyber Resilience Act and the AI Act: perform gap analysis, translate requirements into concrete work, and partner with Legal, IT, Procurement, and Engineering to get them implemented.

What You Bring:

  • Hands on experience implementing and maintaining ISO 27001 and/or SOC 2 certifications, including managing external audits from evidence gathering through to closing findings.

  • Substantial experience across information security, risk management, and compliance, with a clear focus on Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC), ideally gained in a SaaS or cloud software company.

  • Practical experience reviewing information security requirements in customer contracts and leading responses to security questionnaires, with the judgement to tell a real risk apart from a negotiable clause.

  • Experience working with GRC tools, compliance automation, and continuous monitoring, and a genuine preference for automating repetitive work instead of absorbing it.

  • Strong project management and collaboration skills, so you can move several workstreams forward at once across InfoSec, Legal and Compliance, IT, Procurement, and the field teams, and explain security topics clearly to technical and non technical colleagues alike.

  • Ability and/or willingness to use our product

Nice-to-haves:

  • Some software development or scripting ability, including comfort building small tools or automations with AI assisted coding.

  • Experience planning and running business continuity or disaster recovery testing.

  • Familiarity with newer regulatory frameworks such as the Cyber Resilience Act, the AI Act, or NIS2.

  • Experience working in a fully remote, async first organisation.

title: Propulsion AIT Engineer
description:
At NewOrbit Space, our mission is to engineer the lowest orbiting satellites on Earth to rapidly advance global connectivity and insight.

We are currently building satellites that can operate at an altitude of just 200 km - one-third that of conventional satellites.

Your role

You will be the technical process owner for the AURA X propulsion AIT programme, responsible for turning qualification requirements and engineering intent into a complete library of test procedures, test plans, and assembly instructions.

You will work alongside the Propulsion Design and Test Engineers, report into the Lead AIT Engineer, and partner closely with the Technical Programme Manager to ensure delivery. You will own the procedural and logistical backbone of the propulsion qualification campaign - from first-article assembly through to system-level acceptance testing.

This is a mid-level role for someone who can translate system knowledge into rigorous, operator-ready documentation, and then execute those procedures hands-on. Qualification strategy and test logic are defined by the Technical Programme Manager; your role is to take that framework and build the detailed technical processes that make it executable - and then run them.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the writing, review, and maintenance of all assembly instructions, work instructions, and build procedures - from component level through to integrated module on the propulsion system.

  • Write and own test plans and test procedures for propulsion campaigns, including pressure test, proof test, leak test, functional flow test, and performance characterisation.

  • Maintain the AIT schedule for the propulsion system, interfacing with test facilities and ensuring all GSE is available for each test in the plan.

  • Ensure that all equipment is kept calibrated.

  • Develop and maintain hazardous operations procedures for all pressurised system activities, in line with safety requirements defined for the programme.

  • Write propellant handling and loading procedures.

  • Execute test and assembly procedures hands-on, operating test rigs and instrumentation and recording results to programme traceability standards.

  • Maintain the propulsion procedure library - version control, review cycles, and configuration management of all procedural documents.

  • Support integration of the propulsion system into the satellite structure, contributing assembly procedures for the integration sequence.

  • Manage non-conformances on propulsion hardware - raising NCRs, supporting dispositions with the propulsion design team, and updating procedures where needed.

  • Perform goods in inspection of incoming components, against purchase orders, drawings, and certificates of conformance.

  • Coordinate with technicians ensuring tasks are understood and completed in line with the schedule.

  • Support environmental test campaigns involving the propulsion system, contributing test procedures and witnessing campaigns.

  • Support satellite AIT activities.

Fundamental Requirements

  • 3+ years' experience writing test procedures, assembly instructions, or work instructions for mechanical, fluidic, or propulsion hardware in a flight or high-reliability environment.

  • Practical hands-on experience executing the procedures you write - comfortable on the bench as well as at the desk.

  • Experience with pressurised systems - sufficient to write safe, compliant procedures and execute them competently.

  • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, schematics, and system documentation to produce accurate procedural content.

  • Good documentation discipline - understands version control, review processes, and what traceability means in a flight programme context.

  • ESD-aware working practices and understanding of contamination control requirements.

  • Strong safety mindset around pressurised and hazardous operations.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience in a space, aerospace, defence, or other high-reliability industry environment.

  • Familiarity with pressure testing methods (proof, leak, burst, flow) and the standards that govern them.

  • Experience with vacuum chamber operation and maintenance.

  • Experience with electric propulsion systems or vacuum test environments.

  • Familiarity with ECSS standards or equivalent quality and workmanship frameworks.

  • Experience handling xenon or other inert propellants, including loading and facility operations.

  • Background in mechanical AIT as well as propulsion - comfortable contributing to wider satellite integration activities.

Personality

  • Writes procedures the way a good operator would want to receive them - clear, unambiguous, and complete.

  • Equally at home writing documentation and getting hands-on with hardware.

  • Safety-conscious around pressurised and hazardous systems without needing to be prompted.

  • Collaborative - works closely with design engineers to extract the technical content needed for good procedures, and communicates problems early.

  • Comfortable in a fast-moving programme where procedures are living documents that evolve with the hardware.

Why NewOrbit Space?

  • Pioneering Space Technology – You'll contribute to launching groundbreaking technology into space. Your work on our revolutionary ion propulsion system and ULEO satellite platform will redefine satellite operations and disrupt traditional LEO operations.

  • Unmatched Ownership and Impact – You'll experience a level of ownership that's rare in the space industry. You will participate in the full lifecycle of satellite technology.

  • Equity and Competitive Salary – You'll receive not just a competitive salary but also company ownership stakes. Your dedication and hard work are rewarded with a share in the technology you help build, ensuring you're a part of our collective success.

  • Comprehensive Benefits Package – Including private health insurance with dental and optical coverage, annual healthcare check-ups etc.

  • Hybrid Work - A hybrid setup with one dedicated remote day per week.

  • Visa Sponsorship & Relocation Support - We provide a relocation package and sponsor your visa if you’re joining us from abroad.

title: Direct Care Worker - Phoenix Group Home
description:
About Us:

NestVillage LLC provides compassionate, person centered residential support for individuals with diverse needs. We believe every person deserves to be treated with respect, supported with dignity, and understood with empathy. If you lead with heart and integrity, you'll feel right at home here.


Job Summary:

The Direct Care Worker supports individuals with developmental disabilities in a group home setting, ensuring their health, safety, and overall quality of life. This role provides hands-on assistance with personal care, daily living activities, and health-related needs under the direction of licensed nursing staff. Direct Care Workers foster a supportive, respectful environment that promotes independence, skill-building, and community participation while maintaining compliance with agency, state, and federal standards.


Key Responsibilities:

Resident Care & Support:

  • Assist residents with activities of daily living (ADLs) such as bathing, dressing, toileting, feeding, and mobility assistance.
  • Monitor residents’ health, behavior, and overall well-being; promptly report concerns to supervisors.
  • Administer prescribed oral medications and provide basic health-related support such as changing dressings or checking vital signs, following established care plans.
  • Offer companionship, conversation, and engagement in recreational, educational, and social activities.
  • Support residents in learning and practicing life skills that encourage independence.

Home Environment & Daily Operations:

  • Prepare and serve meals according to residents’ dietary needs and preferences.
  • Assist with household upkeep, including laundry, cleaning, and organization, to maintain a safe, comfortable living space.
  • Accompany residents to medical appointments, community outings, or recreational activities, providing transportation and support as needed.

Communication & Documentation:

  • Accurately document care provided, changes in condition, and daily activities in compliance with agency policies.
  • Collaborate with families, healthcare professionals, and team members to ensure coordinated, person-centered care.
  • Follow all safety protocols, care plans, and state licensing requirements for group home operations.


Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or GED required; relevant training or certification (e.g., CNA, HHA, DSP) preferred.
  • CPR/First Aid certification
  • Valid Fingerprint Clearance Card
  • Experience working with individuals with developmental disabilities, especially in a residential or group home setting, is preferred.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build trust and rapport with residents.
  • Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record and ability to transport residents.
  • Three Professional References Required


Schedule & Availability Requirements
This is a full-time position. Applicants must be available to work at least four (4) days per week, and availability must include at least one weekend day. Shifts range from 6 to 12 hours depending on agency needs, employee preference, and availability. Flexibility in scheduling is essential to ensure adequate coverage and continuity of care for residents.


Work Environment:

Group home setting with close interaction with residents and staff. This role requires physical activity including lifting, assisting with mobility, and responding to emergencies. Flexible scheduling is necessary, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.


Benefits:

  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance
  • 401k Retirement Plan

title: Chemistry and Biochemistry Faculty
description:
The Department of Chemistry & Biochemistry at Calvin University invites applications for a tenure-track faculty position in Biochemistry beginning August 2027 (pending administrative approval). We seek a teacher-scholar who is passionate about undergraduate education, collaborative research with students, and the integration of Christian faith with the study of biochemistry. The successful candidate will join a collegial department committed to innovative teaching, meaningful scholarship, and mentoring students within an intentional Christian liberal arts community.

REQUIREMENTS

The department seeks candidates who demonstrate a strong commitment to excellence in both undergraduate teaching and research in biochemistry.

Successful candidates will establish an active research program that engages undergraduate students and is competitive for external funding. Applicants must hold a Ph.D. in biochemistry or a closely related discipline by the start of the appointment. Postdoctoral research and previous teaching experience are preferred. Rank is open and will be commensurate with qualifications and experience.

The university seeks applicants with vibrant Christian faith who are dedicated to integration of that faith with their field of study.

The university will prioritize candidates with broad interdisciplinary interests, demonstrated commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion, ability to integrate questions of meaning, significance, and ethics into all course content, and deep commitment to engaging students beyond the classroom.

FACULTY RESPONSIBILITIES

The successful candidate will teach undergraduate courses in biochemistry, including Calvin’s core biochemistry sequence:

  • BCHM 321 – Principles of Biochemistry
  • BCHM 322 – Metabolism and Metabolic Disease

Depending on expertise and interests, the successful candidate may also contribute to innovative upper-level electives such as:

  • BCHM 323 – Venom
  • BCHM 324 – Proteins Gone Awry

Additional opportunities exist to teach general chemistry, courses for non-science majors, and advanced courses (Forensics, Evolving Complexity, Molecules in the Spotlight, Chemistry & Sustainability, etc.). Visit our course website for a current list of classes offered.

Faculty members typically teach 24 semester hours per academic year (2 lecture and 2 labs per semester). In addition to excellent teaching, faculty are expected to maintain an active scholarly agenda, mentor undergraduate researchers, pursue external funding, and contribute through departmental, university, professional, and community service.

As members of Calvin University's academic community, faculty are expected to embrace the university's educational mission as a Christian liberal arts institution in the Reformed tradition, affiliated with the Christian Reformed Church. Candidates will be asked to affirm their commitment to this mission (see Educating for Shalom and Faculty Expectations) Calvin provides numerous faculty development opportunities to foster growth in these commitments.

FACULTY RESOURCES

The Department of Chemistry and Biochemistry provides excellent facilities for faculty-student collaborative research. Available instrumentation includes:

  • Microscopy: spinning disk confocal, fluorescence, and atomic force microscopy (AFM)
  • Gel documentation system
  • Spectroscopy: UV-Vis, FTIR, fluorescence, atomic emission, variable-temperature circular dichroism (CD), plate readers
  • Structural analysis: 500 MHz gradient-shimmed multinuclear NMR, 80 MHz benchtop NMR
  • Chromatography and mass spectrometry: LC-MS, GC-MS, HPLC, ion chromatography
  • Thermal Analysis: microcalorimetry (ITC/DSC) and standard DSC
  • Protein purification: AKTA Start system, French pressure cell, floor centrifuges and shakers
  • Supercomputer with CPU and GPU nodes

Calvin University supports faculty scholarship through internal grants, course releases, sabbaticals, summer research stipends, travel funding, undergraduate research opportunities, and a variety of interdisciplinary Centers and Institutes that foster collaboration across the university.

ABOUT THE DEPARTMENT

The Department of Chemistry and Biochemistry consists of 10 full-time faculty members who are committed to excellence in undergraduate teaching, collaborative research, and student mentoring. The department is ACS accredited and offers undergraduate degrees in chemistry and biochemistry.

Faculty and students pursue a wide range of research programs supported by external funding from organizations including the National Science Foundation (NSF), National Institutes of Health (NIH), Research Corporation, and the American Chemical Society Petroleum Research Fund (ACS PRF).

Faculty work closely with undergraduate researchers in a collaborative and supportive environment that values outstanding teaching, meaningful scholarship, and long-term mentoring relationships.

To learn more about the Department of Chemistry and Biochemistry, including its faculty, students, curriculum, and research programs, please visit the department's website.

ABOUT CALVIN UNIVERSITY

Calvin University is a top-ranked national university that equips students to think deeply, to act justly, and to live wholeheartedly as Christ’s agents of renewal in the world. Approximately 3,600 Calvin students study the liberal arts and select from a broad range of majors and professional programs, including a growing portfolio of graduate level offerings.

The university is located in Grand Rapids, Michigan, in a thriving metropolitan region of approximately one million people situated equidistant from Chicago and Detroit. Furthermore, the West Michigan region is ranked by Forbes as the #1 place to raise a family. For more information, please visit http://www.calvin.edu/go/facultyopenings.

Calvin is building a tradition of diversity and accessibility and welcomes applications from persons whose personal characteristics will further that commitment. Calvin does not discriminate in the employment of individuals on the basis of race, color, national or ethnic origin, disability, sex, or age. Calvin University is an educational agency of the Christian Reformed Church and, in compliance with Title VII and other applicable law, reserves the right to give preference in employment based upon religion.

TO APPLY

Complete the online application process and attach the following:

  • Cover letter that specifically addresses the requirements and responsibilities of the position, including your interest in teaching and scholarship at a Reformed Christian University
  • Curriculum vitae
  • Undergraduate and graduate transcripts
  • Research statement (2-3 pages) describing plans for a research program involving undergraduate students
  • Teaching philosophy statement (~ 1 page)
  • Statement (1-2 pages) describing how your Christian faith informs your teaching and scholarship
  • Three letters of recommendation, submitted directly to the department chair, Dr. David Benson, david.benson@calvin.edu

FAITH and EDUCATIONAL COMMITMENT

1. Commitment to the educational mission of Calvin as a Christian liberal arts university affiliated with the Christian Reformed Church.

2. A commitment to the Christian faith and to the integration of faith, learning, and student development.

DIVERSITY COMMITMENT

Demonstrated awareness and commitment to effectively establishing relationships and positive communication across multiple dimensions of diversity including, but not limited to, race, gender, physical limitations, class, or religious perspectives.

  • Direct experience with GCP and knowledge of AWS, Azure, or other cloud providers
  • Efficiency in ideation and implementation, prioritizing tasks based on urgency and impact
  • Preferred: Experience with Docker and containerized deployments
  • Preferred: Proficiency in deploying high availability applications on Kubernetes

What We Offer

  • A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive
  • Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity
  • The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry
  • Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture

title: Product Quality Expert
description:
We are Polestar. We are detail obsessed, performance focused and determined to make the most advanced and exciting electric cars the world has ever seen. We blaze our own trail, one without compromise. We don’t believe in shortcuts. We innovate constantly and we are relentless in our pursuit of the best. We’re expanding, and we need people who share our vision and want to be part of something different.

Let us describe the challenge we offer

In this role you will be fully focused on the quality of Polestar products. You will assure that Polestar have the right focus to immediately identify any potential quality defect by using all possible sources of information and secure fast solutions.

Except from internal Polestar cooperations, you will also work in close collaboration with Volvo Cars and Geely in the areas of Product Quality, Product Compliance, Manufacturing, Research & Development, and Customer Service.

What you'll do

As a member of the Global Manufacturing Quality team, you will:

  • Be an expert in customer perceived and experienced product quality, both detection of issues as severity assessment according to Polestar Quality standards.

  • Represent Polestar Quality towards our suppliers and business partners in quality related processes and matters.

  • Be the interface between Polestar’s global quality teams, the aftermarkets and the plant’s Quality improvement teams, handling internal and external quality escalations, non-conformities and deviation according to agreed processes and working methods.

  • Drive and participate in the investigation, symptom analyze, problem description and data collection of customer quality and compliance problems arising, support the root cause analyze and solution development within the agreed problem-solving processes until interim and permanent containment actions are implemented at customers, logistic flows, in plant or at suppliers.

  • Manage and calibrate the plants quality KPI’s, the plant’s consumer product audits and other decided product validation activities for Polestar products.

  • Collect, analyze and report market quality data as input to the quality improvement processes. Start investigations where required.

  • Perform product and process audits where and when required independent or with business partners and report the found non-conformities to Polestar management and related business partners and suppliers.

  • Represent Mfg. Quality team in Polestar Programs working together with the Program Quality teams to support flawless launches of new models.

Who you are

To be a great fit for this role, we are looking for you with positive attitude and a great passion for the EV industry. You have interest in the area of connectivity, exceptional communication skills, and a curious and analytical mindset. You have the ability to work professionally and building strong and sustainable relationships in a fast-paced and global environment. Also, you are a great team player and thrive in completing tasks efficiently and independently with a high-driving spirit.

To be successful in this position we believe you have:

  • University master’s degree in engineering or equivalent through experience, with a strong interest in product engineering and manufacturing.

  • Minimum 7 years of automotive Quality, Manufacturing, Supplier Quality Management or R&D experience.

  • Good knowledge about customer quality, quality systems, data analyze & problem solving and manufacturing and launch processes.

  • Excellent communication and coordination skills.

  • Fluent in Chinese and English. At Polestar, you will be working in a cross-functional and international team, with English as a natural language for written and spoken communication.

  • Fluent in MS Office applications and data reporting tools like Excel, Word, PowerPoint and PowerBi.

  • Have a holistic view and high degree of courage, integrity and business ethics。

At Polestar, you will be part of a cross-functional and international team, with English as a natural language for written and spoken communication. Since Polestar’s in a scale-up phase you thrive by working in a fast-paced environment.

People at Polestar

We know that a change is needed. We also know that each one of us can help bring about that change. Our commitment to becoming climate-neutral by 2040 is just as important to us as being inclusive, diverse, and innovative. Together, we are creating, collaborating and experimenting to usher in a new era of sustainable mobility.

We are an electric performance brand, determined to improve the society we live in.

Is this you? If you are interested in joining the Polestar crew, don't wait with submitting your application. We apply a continuous selection process and the job post will be open until the position is filled.

Are you ready for the journey? Which is electric by the way...

title: Software Engineer 1- (Full Stack Developer)
description:
At U.S. Bank, we’re on a journey to do our best. Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions, enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed in the right ways, all more confidently and more often—that’s what we call the courage to thrive. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.

As a wholly owned subsidiary of U.S. Bank, Elavon is committed to building the platforms and ecosystems that help over 1.5 million customers around the world to achieve their financial goals—no matter what they need. From transaction processing to customer service, to driving innovation and launching new products, we’re building a range of tailored payment solutions powered by the latest technology. As part of our team, you can explore what motivates and energizes your career goals: partnering with our customers, our communities, and each other.

Job Description

This position will be responsible for the analysis, design, testing, development and maintenance of best in class software experiences. The candidate is a self-motivated individual who can collaborate with a team and across the organization. The candidate takes responsibility of the software artifacts produced adhering to U.S. Bank standards in order to ensure minimal impact to the customer experience. The candidate will be adept with the agile software development lifecycle and DevOps principles.

Essential Responsibilities:
  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable full-stack applications using React, Java, and Spring Boot.
  • Build responsive user interfaces with React, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and Microfrontend architecture.
  • Develop and support REST APIs and microservices using Java, Spring MVC, and Spring Boot.
  • Design and optimize database solutions using Oracle, SQL Server, and MySQL.
  • Deploy and support cloud-native applications on AWS.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and DevOps processes using Jenkins, GitLab, Docker, and Kubernetes.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams in an Agile/Scrum environment.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize application performance and reliability.

Basic Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent work experience
- Two to three years of relevant experience

Required Skills/Experience
  • Strong Full Stack Development experience with Java, Spring Boot, React, and JavaScript.

  • Proficiency with Oracle, SQL Server, and MySQL databases.
  • Experience developing and deploying applications on AWS Cloud.
  • Knowledge of CI/CD, Jenkins, GitLab, Docker, and Kubernetes.
  • Experience designing scalable, high-performance web applications.
  • Strong problem-solving, troubleshooting, and debugging skills in Agile environments.

This role requires working from a U.S. Bank location three (3) or more days per week.

title: Technical Product Manager | NDA
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Technical Product Manager | NDA based in Spain.

As a Technical Product Manager, you will lead the development of reusable, client-facing technology solutions that combine business value with advanced enterprise platforms. You will take ownership of turning complex business needs into scalable products, guiding solutions from initial definition through MVP delivery and future expansion. Working closely with engineers, architects, and senior stakeholders, you will manage product strategy, execution, and delivery within a fast-paced consulting environment. This role offers the opportunity to shape innovative AI and data-driven solutions while creating assets that can be reused across multiple client engagements. You will play a key role in bridging business objectives and technical capabilities to deliver impactful solutions at scale.

Accountabilities

  • Translate business opportunities and client needs into clear product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and actionable delivery plans.
  • Own the product lifecycle, including backlog management, sprint planning, prioritization, roadmap definition, and delivery cadence.
  • Lead the development of reusable enterprise solutions built on advanced data and AI platforms, ensuring they are technically feasible, commercially valuable, and scalable.
  • Collaborate closely with engineers, solution architects, and business stakeholders to manage technical dependencies, integrations, workflows, APIs, and solution design decisions.
  • Drive delivery within a fast-paced environment by managing risks, scope, timelines, and priorities while maintaining high-quality outcomes.
  • Facilitate stakeholder reviews, sprint demos, and decision-making sessions to ensure alignment across technical and business teams.
  • Define future product development opportunities and support the creation of demonstrations, documentation, and commercial enablement materials.

    • Requirements

    • 8+ years of experience in technical product management, enterprise technology consulting, solution delivery, or a related field.
    • Proven experience leading the end-to-end delivery of enterprise software, data, AI, or platform-based solutions.
    • Experience taking technical products from initial use-case definition through MVP, proof of concept, or production deployment.
    • Strong understanding of agile product delivery practices, including backlog ownership, sprint planning, prioritization, acceptance criteria, and stakeholder management.
    • Experience working directly with engineering teams and architects on technical solution design, integrations, APIs, and complex technology dependencies.
    • Ability to deliver impactful MVPs, prototypes, or accelerators within short and intensive project timelines.
    • Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business language.
    • Experience managing senior stakeholders in consulting, professional services, or complex enterprise environments.
    • Ability to work independently, take ownership, and operate effectively in a dynamic environment.
    • Availability to start quickly and commit full-time during the initial engagement period.

      • Benefits

As a Quantum Solutions Architect, you will play a key role in helping organizations explore, adopt, and maximize the value of quantum computing technologies. You will act as a trusted technical advisor, working closely with customers, sales teams, and internal stakeholders to design solutions, deliver impactful demonstrations, and guide complex technical discussions. This role combines deep technical expertise with customer engagement, allowing you to translate advanced quantum concepts into practical business applications. You will work with organizations across industries, supporting innovation in areas such as finance, healthcare, automotive, logistics, and research.     • Ability to understand complex technical challenges and translate them into practical solutions for customers.
    • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain advanced concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
    • Experience working independently in remote environments while collaborating effectively with distributed teams.

title: Senior Admissions Adviser
description:
Te Whiwhinga mahi | The opportunity

We are currently seeking a Senior Admissions Adviser within Admissions. This is an exciting opportunity for a confident and experienced professional who can not only deliver on the operational requirements of the role but also contribute to the continuous improvement of Admissions processes, systems, and procedures in partnership with Admissions Team Leaders.

The successful candidate will play a key role in reviewing current practices, identifying opportunities for improvement, and leading initiatives through to implementation. A strong analytical mindset is essential, with the ability to interpret data, prepare reports, identify trends, and use insights to support informed decision-making and drive service enhancements. Advanced Excel skills and experience working with business systems, databases, and reporting tools will be highly valued.

You will take a lead role in the review, approval, and ongoing maintenance of application and admission-related information published on the University website, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and alignment with policy and regulatory requirements.

As a senior member of the team, you will also champion training and capability development across Admissions, ensuring practices are aligned with the University's strategic objectives and contributing to the achievement of agreed KPIs and service delivery targets. You will bring a continuous improvement mindset, a strong aptitude for working with systems and technology, and the ability to use data and reporting to identify efficiencies, improve processes, and enhance the applicant experience.

This role will be primarily based in the City Campus but will need to be flexible to work across different faculties, across campuses, and will need someone who is agile and forward-thinking.

This is a full-time, 37.5 hours per week on a fixed-term contract until the end of 2027. The salary range for this role is $73,400 - $77,000 per annum, depending on experience and qualifications.

For more detailed information, please refer to the Position Description.

He kōrero mōu | About you

You will be highly motivated with excellent communications skills, ideally you will have experience working with policies and regulations, as well as managing successful stakeholder relationships at all levels, and working effectively in an area of high-volume workload.

Essential:

  • Experience in reporting and analysis.
  • Experience in continuous improvement.
  • Advanced knowledge and experience using Microsoft Tools.
  • Advanced knowledge and experience using PeopleSoft.
  • Significant experience in the use of the National Academic Recognition Information Centre (NARIC) databases and the Australian National Office of Overseas Skills Recognition (NOOSR) databases.
  • Subject matter expertise around the New Zealand secondary school qualifications and admission requirements.
  • Subject matter expertise in establishing qualification equivalence, assessing academic attainment and applying those outcomes against set guidelines and criteria.
  • Understanding of global English language proficiency assessments and their relevance in the New Zealand context.
  • Demonstrated skills and experience in working collaboratively with a diverse range of stakeholders and cross-functional teams, and supporting change
  • Kia Whakamana i te Tangata Acknowledging, maintaining and restoring the mana and tapu of individuals, whānau and communities.

Preferred:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent tertiary qualification.

The University of Auckland is New Zealand's leading University and maintains significant computational, laboratory, and analytic facilities. Auckland is frequently rated as one of the world's most liveable cities.

The University is committed to providing an excellent working environment through the following:

  • Flexible employment practices (including working from home and flexible hours)

title: Software Engineer, Platform - Leeds, United Kingdom
description:
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

The responsibilities of our Platform team include building and maintaining all backend services, including, but not limited to, payments, analytics, subscriptions, new products, text to speech, and external APIs.

This is a key role and ideal for someone who thinks strategically, enjoys fast-paced environments, is passionate about making product decisions, and has experience building great user experiences that delight users.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

Our interview process involves several technical interviews and we aim to complete them within 1 week.

What You'll Do

  • Design, develop, and maintain robust APIs including public TTS API, internal APIs like Payment, Subscription, Auth and Consumption Tracking, ensuring they meet business and scalability requirements
  • Oversee the full backend API landscape, enhancing and optimizing for performance and maintainability
  • Collaborate on B2B solutions, focusing on customization and integration needs for enterprise clients
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to align backend architecture with overall product strategy and user experience

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • Proven experience in backend development: TS/Node (required)
  • Direct experience with GCP and knowledge of AWS, Azure, or other cloud providers
  • Efficiency in ideation and implementation, prioritizing tasks based on urgency and impact
  • Preferred: Experience with Docker and containerized deployments
  • Preferred: Proficiency in deploying high availability applications on Kubernetes

What We Offer

  • A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products
  • A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive
  • Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity
  • The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry
  • Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture
  • The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more
  • An active role at the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio – a rapidly evolving tech domain

title: MSW Internship
description:
IOA is on the forefront of revolutionary healthcare models, reshaping the way people can age in place. Our innovative models transform lives, enhance communities, and save healthcare systems millions of dollars. Rather than focusing on archaic outdated design, we strive to consistently question the “status-quo” and create new and more innovative ways to help aging adults and adults with disabilities maintain their quality of life.

With over 23 programs, we offer multiple ways to aid seniors maintain their health, well-being, independence and participation in the community, fulfilling our mission.

Under the supervision of the Practicum Field Instructor and Program Supervisor, MSW Interns participate in the provision of care management services and coordination of supportive services for low-income older adults and people with disabilities. This is a paid, educational internship designed to support the development of clinical and case management skills in a supervised learning environment.

Interns will gain hands-on experience in assessment, care planning, and service coordination while working closely with experienced care managers.

Key Responsibilities

  • In partnership with the Field Instructor, develop a comprehensive learning agreement to establish educational goals and objectives
  • Complete required onboarding, including Workday training, documentation training, and shadowing visits
  • Participate in a structured learning experience that includes:
    • First-year MSW interns: Co-manage a caseload of approximately 10 clients alongside a Care Manager mentor
    • Second-year MSW interns: Co-manage a caseload of approximately 12–15 clients alongside a Care Manager mentor
  • Under supervision, assist in conducting comprehensive client assessments, including psychosocial, physical, mental health, environmental, and spiritual needs
  • Support the development and implementation of client-centered care plans (Community Living Plans)
  • Assist with identifying, coordinating, and monitoring appropriate community-based services
  • Learn and apply knowledge of Medicare, Medi-Cal, and other entitlement programs relevant to the population served
  • Build and maintain professional relationships with clients, caregivers, and service providers while demonstrating respect, dignity, and professionalism
  • Participate in client visits (minimum monthly or as appropriate), with guidance from supervisor
  • Learn and follow agency documentation standards, including timely and accurate progress notes (within 48 hours)
  • Maintain organized and accurate records to support continuity of care
  • Support client and caregiver education and empowerment strategies
  • Participate in evaluating the effectiveness of interventions
  • Assist with case transitions, including closure or transfer at the end of the internship
  • Participate in interdisciplinary team (MDT) meetings, staff meetings, and trainings as assigned
  • Maintain regular communication with supervisors and actively engage in supervision
  • Complete all required academic documentation in collaboration with Field Instructor
  • Adhere to the ethical standards of the National Association of Social Workers (NASW)

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree (BA or BS)
  • Seeking a MSW internship program from accredited MSW program.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with older adults and/or individuals with disabilities (preferred)
  • Familiarity with medical and psychosocial needs of vulnerable populations (preferred)
  • Strong communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively
  • Basic computer proficiency (e.g., documentation systems, Microsoft Office)

Physical & Work Requirements

  • Ability to perform essential job functions with or without reasonable accommodation
  • Ability to conduct field-based work, including traveling to client locations
  • Ability to use standard office equipment and complete electronic documentation

Language Requirements

  • Ability to communicate effectively in English for client care, documentation, and collaboration with care teams
  • Additional language skills are a plus

Compensation

  • $19.61 per hour (San Francisco minimum wage; subject to applicable updates)

Work Environment & Safety

This role includes field-based work in the community. The organization provides guidance and training to support safe practices during client visits.

Equal Opportunity Statement

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and interns. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, or any other protected status under applicable law.

title: Silicon Design Engineer
description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.

At AMD, we believe technology can change lives for the better. It can heal us, entertain us, and make us more connected, productive, and understanding of the world around us. And we’re looking for talent who feel the same: people who want to leave the planet better than they found it, those who don’t shy away from humanity’s challenges but are determined to help solve them.

AMD is powering the next generation of supercomputing, high-performance computing, cloud, and AI. Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or creating go-to-market plans, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward.




THE ROLE:

The ideal candidate will demonstrate knowledge in electrostatic discharge (ESD) design and protection verifications in advanced ASIC and FPGA applications. This position requires a basic understanding of device physics, ESD protection principles, circuit design simulations/verifications, and silicon manufacturing processes. Familiarity with circuit simulation/verification tools, layout analysis, data interpretation, and device characterization is essential. Experience in testing and measurement of ESD performance is preferred.

THE PERSON:

This role is suited for a self-motivated individual who can learn quickly, take initiative in their projects, and effectively resolve technical challenges. Strong collaboration and communication skills are critical, as the position involves working with cross-functional teams. Typically, the candidate will hold a degree in Electronic Engineering or a physical science and possess substantial relevant industry experience.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Participate in ESD protection schemes in the advanced Si technologies
  • Support the design and verification of ESD protection circuits in FPGA and ASIC applications
  • Assist in performing simulation, and validation of ESD protection effectiveness
  • Assist in layout review to ensure compliance with ESD design guidelines
  • Interpret silicon measurement data and correlate with simulation models to improve design accuracy
  • Conduct basic SPICE modelling and simulation tasks
  • Collaborate with senior ESD engineers and cross-functional teams to utilize PDKs and perform parasitic extraction
  • Engage in ESD testing and measurement activities

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

  • Understanding of ESD design and protection strategies in advanced logic technologies (beyond 7nm)
  • Familiarity with industry-standard EDA tools, such as Cadence Virtuoso or Calibre PERC, is a preferred
  • Knowledge of SPICE circuit simulations for ESD transient events
  • Understanding of foundry PDKs, parasitic extraction, and basic physical verification flows
  • Experience or coursework in EM simulation tools is beneficial
  • Awareness of semiconductor technologies and trends
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail
  • Excellent communication and teamwork abilities in cross-functional environments
  • Master's or Ph.D. degree in Electronic Engineering or a physical science discipline, along with relevant technical or industry experience

title: Senior Software Engineer, Test Automation
description:
Bring more to life.

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?

At Molecular Devices, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

Join Molecular Devices and help drive scientific discovery for life science customers in academia, biotech, pharma, and government. Our automated and AI-enabled technology empowers researchers to tackle complex questions and gain deep insights, accelerating the development of safer, more effective therapeutics. As part of our team—rooted in collaboration, authenticity, and innovation—you’ll ultimately contribute to groundbreaking science that enhances lives globally and shapes a healthier future for all.

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

The Senior Software Engineer, Test Automation is responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining automated tests and test infrastructure for high-content imaging software. This role works with software development, quality assurance, product ownership, and engineering leadership teams to improve automated coverage, integrate end-to-end workflows between products, monitor continuous integration pipelines, and provide clear, timely information about software build quality and release readiness.

This position reports to the Supervisor, Software Engineering and is part of the Imaging Software Engineering team located in Downingtown, PA. This is a 100% on-site role.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Automated Test Development: Design, implement, debug, and maintain reliable automated end-to-end and integration tests for complex imaging software using Cypress and related testing technologies.

  • Cross-Product Test Architecture: Collaborate with software development and quality assurance teams to develop reusable test frameworks and automate workflows that span multiple products, services, and instrument-control applications.

  • CI/CD, Build Quality, and Root-Cause Analysis: Monitor automated test pipelines and software builds daily; investigate complex or intermittent failures using evidence from multiple sources; distinguish product defects from test or infrastructure issues; communicate which builds are suitable for further verification and validation; and improve test reliability, diagnostics, processes, and infrastructure to prevent recurrence.

  • Test Strategy and Coverage: Translate product risks, customer workflows, and acceptance criteria into automated test designs and backlog stories; identify gaps in regression coverage and prioritize automation that delivers the greatest quality and business impact.

  • Technical Leadership and Collaboration: Work independently with product owners, software leads, quality assurance engineers, engineering managers, and developers; lead focused automation initiatives, build consensus on quality issues, and serve as a technical resource for colleagues with less automation experience.

The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Education and experience: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline with 5+ years of professional software development or software test automation experience; equivalent directly relevant experience may be considered.

  • Test automation expertise: Demonstrated experience designing and maintaining automated end-to-end or integration tests for commercial software, including practical expertise with Cypress or a comparable browser automation framework and JavaScript or TypeScript.

  • Continuous integration: Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, monitoring pipeline and build health, diagnosing failures, and communicating actionable quality and release-readiness information.

  • Software engineering practices: Proficiency with Git, package-management and build tools such as npm, REST-based applications, test design patterns, defect tracking, and Agile development practices.

  • Independent problem solving and collaboration: Ability to solve complex technical problems with minimal guidance, perform effective root-cause analysis, lead small initiatives, explain difficult technical information clearly, and build consensus across cross-functional teams.

It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

  • Scientific or instrument-control software: Testing laboratory instruments, imaging systems, robotic systems, or other software connected to physical hardware.

  • High-content imaging: Familiarity with microscopy, image acquisition and analysis workflows, or life science applications.

  • Cross-product automation: Building automated workflows that coordinate multiple desktop applications, browser applications, backend services, or independently released products.

  • Additional test technologies: Experience with Angular application testing, API testing, Windows desktop automation, test reporting systems, or improving the reliability and observability of large regression suites.

Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements:

  • Minimal travel expected—one week or less per year—for internal planning activities only.

  • This position requires working 100% on-site at the Downingtown, PA location.

At Early Warning, we’ve powered and protected the U.S. financial system for over thirty years with cutting-edge solutions like Zelle®, Paze℠, and so much more. Overall Purpose
The Sr. Distinguished Engineer – Enterprise Security is a strategic individual contributor responsible for defining technical direction and solving the organization’s most complex security engineering challenges. This role establishes enterprise security architecture and engineering standards, develops roadmaps for next-generation capabilities, and leads the design and implementation of secure, scalable, reliable, and resilient solutions across organizational boundaries.

Serving as both a visionary architect and hands-on technical leader, this position partners with Security, Technology, Architecture, Product, Risk, and business leaders to translate enterprise objectives into practical
technical solutions. The Sr. Distinguished Engineer influences critical decisions, resolves complex technical issues, and advances automation, engineering effectiveness, and operational resilience while balancing
business value, security risk, user experience, and financial impact.

Essential Functions

  • Define and advance the enterprise technical strategy, architecture, and engineering roadmap for critical security capabilities.
  • Lead the design, implementation, and measurement of strategic security engineering and innovation initiatives, including achievement of expected business, operational, and risk-reduction outcomes.
  • Provide enterprise-level architectural and design oversight, partnering with key technical resources to deliver practical solutions on time and within established financial and operational constraints.
  • Serve as the final technical escalation point for highly complex security architecture, engineering, implementation, and operational decisions.
  • Design and implement solutions that improve security engineering effectiveness and efficiency, including workflows, continuous integration and delivery, Infrastructure as Code, orchestration, configuration management, and other forms of automation.
  • Establish technical patterns, engineering standards, governance practices, and operating models that enable secure, scalable, reliable, and resilient enterprise solutions.
  • Provide expert technical and strategic oversight for major Security initiatives and implementations; proactively identify cross-functional dependencies, resolve architectural conflicts, and guide decisions that minimize operational, security, and financial risk.
  • Develop practical solutions for complex or emerging challenges while maintaining alignment with enterprise objectives and balancing business, security, operational, and financial considerations.
  • Lead the diagnosis of complex technical issues and guide or perform root-cause analysis, mitigation planning, and corrective action.
  • Assess technical and business risk and recommend, design, or implement manual and automated controls based on defined use cases and expected value.
  • Provide technical leadership for disaster recovery, business continuity, high availability, and recovery capabilities associated with enterprise security solutions.

  • Remain current on relevant technologies, threats, industry practices, and architectural trends and evaluate their applicability to the organization’s security strategy and roadmap.
  • Collaborate across the organization to investigate security-related issues, address systemic root causes, and deliver sustainable enterprise solutions.
  • Support the company’s commitment to risk management and to protecting the integrity and confidentiality of systems and data.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Typically has 15 years of experience or demonstrated portfolio consistent with experience required of the role.
  • Demonstrated experience providing technical leadership for large-scale, complex, enterprise technology or security initiatives.
  • Expert knowledge of server and endpoint operating systems, system interfaces, and application programming interfaces.
  • Expert knowledge of networking protocols, communication flows, and enterprise network architecture.
  • Expert experience architecting, engineering, or administering enterprise solutions, including solutions designed for high availability, resiliency, and recovery.
  • Expert knowledge of interpreted, compiled, and lower-level programming languages, such as Python, Java, C, C++, Perl, or assembly architecture.
  • Expert experience developing practical solutions across on-premises and cloud environments.
  • Demonstrated experience with continuous integration, continuous delivery and deployment, Infrastructure as Code, automated testing, orchestration, configuration management, and security automation.
  • Demonstrated ability to assess highly complex problems from technical, business, security, and operational perspectives; evaluate the feasibility of potential approaches; and determine an effective course of action.
  • Demonstrated ability to resolve complex architectural debates, influence technical direction, and align stakeholders with differing priorities and perspectives.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to technical teams, business partners, executive leaders, and other stakeholders.
  • Ability to operate independently or collaboratively and serve as a trusted advisor and enterprise technical leader for the Security organization.
  • Experience working in agile delivery environments and partnering with engineering and automation teams.
  • Experience defining or leading disaster recovery and business continuity capabilities.
  • Experience with software development lifecycle practices and IT service management principles.
  • Ability to satisfy applicable background-screening requirements.

  • Experience working for an enterprise hardware, software, cloud, or internet technology organization.

  • Experience influencing enterprise technology strategy, industry practices, technical standards, or external technical communities.

Physical Requirements

Working conditions consist of a normal office environment. Work is primarily sedentary and requires extensive use of a computer and involves sitting for periods of approximately four hours. Work may require occasional standing, walking, kneeling and reaching. Must be able to lift 10 pounds occasionally and/or negligible amount of force frequently. title: Embedded Yocto Build Engineer
description:
Our Deloitte Cyber team understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful solutions to help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat landscape. Through powerful solutions and managed services that simplify complexity, we enable our clients to operate with resilience, grow with confidence, and proactively manage to secure success.

Work You'll Do

As an Embedded Systems Developer/Engineer, you will contribute directly to the design, development, testing, and long-term maintenance of embedded software and firmware that runs on specialized hardware platforms. You'll help translate system requirements into implementable designs, build and integrate low-level components, and ensure the resulting solutions are deterministic, reliable, and performant in real-world operating conditions-often with tight constraints on memory, compute, power, and timing.

In this role, you'll write efficient, high-quality C/C++ (or similar C-family) code (and, ideally, Rust) for firmware, drivers, and hardware-facing application logic. You'll work with senior engineers to make sound technical tradeoffs around real-time behavior, interrupt handling, concurrency, and resource management, and you'll contribute to establishing and following coding standards that support safety, maintainability, and portability across hardware variants. Where applicable, you'll support development on a real-time operating system (RTOS) or bare-metal environments and help validate system behavior under stress, edge cases, and fault conditions.

You will actively participate in peer code reviews, debugging sessions, and root-cause analysis, strengthening the codebase through clear documentation, improved test coverage, and disciplined configuration management. You'll contribute to bring-up and integration activities-working closely with hardware engineers to interpret schematics, review board interfaces, validate peripherals, and troubleshoot issues using tools such as JTAG, logic analyzers, and oscilloscopes. You'll also support build and release workflows, including cross-compilation toolchains, continuous integration, and packaging of firmware images.

The successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others


The Team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes - is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Enterprise Security offering embeds security in all aspects of digital transformation by securing a client's technical backbone while enabling secure digital transformation. Includes security architecture, secure development and deployment, end-to-end cyber cloud capabilities, application security, and security for emerging technologies and connected products.

Qualifications

Required:
  • Bachelor's degree required
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain the required TS/SCI clearance for this role
  • Ability to travel 5-30%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
  • 4+ years of experience in hardware/software integration, including experience with common embedded interfaces and buses (for example, SPI, I²C, UART, CAN, GPIO), memory-mapped peripherals, and performance tuning on constrained devices.
  • 2+ years of experience building and customizing Yocto Linux images, including integrating and deploying FPGA bitfiles
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future

Preferred:
  • Experience with Git

description:

Sr. Claims Specialist, Professional Liability | Medical Malpractice | California

PRIMARY PURPOSE OF THE ROLE: To analyze complex or technically difficult medical malpractice claims; to provide resolution of highly complex nature and/or severe injury claims; to coordinate case management within Company standards, industry best practices and specific client service requirements; and to manage the total claim costs while providing high levels of customer service.

ARE YOU AN IDEAL CANDIDATE?

We are seeking experienced professionals to manage complex medical malpractice claims involving severe injury and high exposure. Ideal candidates demonstrate strong analytical and negotiation skills, exercise sound judgment, and are committed to delivering timely, cost‑effective claim resolutions while maintaining a high level of customer service.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBLITIES MAY INCLUDE:

  • Analyzes and processes complex or technically difficult medical malpractice claims by investigating and gathering information to determine the exposure on the claim; manages claims through well-developed action plans to an appropriate and timely resolution.

  • Conducts or assigns full investigation and provides report of investigation pertaining to new events, claims and legal actions.

  • Calculates and assigns timely and appropriate reserves to claims; monitors reserve adequacy throughout claim life.

  • Recommends settlement strategies; brings structured settlement proposals as necessary to maximize settlement.

  • Coordinates legal defense by assigning attorney, coordinating support for investigation, and reviewing attorney invoices; monitors counsel for compliance with client guidelines.

  • Uses appropriate cost containment techniques including strategic vendor partnerships to reduce overall claim cost for our clients.

  • Identifies and investigates for possible fraud, subrogation, contribution, recovery, and case management opportunities to reduce total claim cost.

  • Represents Company in depositions, mediations, and trial monitoring as needed.

  • Communicates claim activity and processing with the client; maintains professional client relationships.

  • Ensures claim files are properly documented and claims coding is correct.

  • Refers cases as appropriate to supervisor and management.

  • Performs other duties as assigned.

  • Supports the organization's quality program(s).

  • Create value propositions and product positioning to drive revenue and market share growth against competitors
  • Lead biosimilar pricing strategy to optimize the trade-off between performance and cost, ensuring competitiveness and scale in high-volume programs
  • Own market intelligence by monitoring originator biologic patent expiry and biosimilar pipeline activity, translating gained insight into actionable priorities and strategies
  • Commercial enablement through the creation of technical slides, competitive analysis and training materials

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience in Biology, Biochemistry, Chemical Engineering or a related field.

title: Communication Specialist - Dance
description:
In A Nutshell

Your focus is simple: bring Red Bull’s stories to life and strengthen brand relevance through impactful communication strategies. You help develop and execute global media strategies for Dance network projects, creating clear and consistent messaging that connects with core, casual, and new audiences across owned, earned, and managed channels.

You operate at the intersection of communication, culture, and media. By combining strategic thinking with strong storytelling, you identify meaningful narratives, build relevant partnerships, and support local markets in activating global projects. Working closely with Channel Managers, Producers, Partnerships teams, and creators, you ensure that content, distribution, and communication efforts come together to create authentic connections and lasting engagement.

Strategic Project Management

Support the development and the implementation of the global media strategies for Dance network projects, including street dance and breaking, aiming to create impact and spark word-of-mouth among key target audiences across owned, earned, and managed channels. You will manage projects throughout their lifecycle, from defining objectives and KPIs to coordinating timelines, budgets, milestones, and strategic partnerships.

Using data-driven insights, you will evaluate performance and optimize tactics while collaborating with Channel Managers, Producers, and Partnerships teams to align content, distribution, and communication strategies with brand objectives.

Communication Management & Storytelling

Develop compelling communication plans by creating strong narratives and story angles that build brand awareness and highlight product functionality. You will define audience profiles, understand media behaviors, and create meaningful connections across earned, managed, and owned channels.

You will collaborate with editorial partners, media outlets, and creators to identify opportunities, support market activations, Channel Manager and the Producer to shape impactful storytelling approaches for programming and content.

Drive and oversee all Still Image productions.

Market Collaboration

Enable successful local activation of global projects by providing markets with best practices, guidance, and relevant tools. You will identify local opportunities, cultural narratives, and projects with the potential to scale globally while ensuring that global strategies are adapted effectively to regional audiences and market needs.

Expertise

Bring experience from events, content, or cultural projects where you have successfully created impact within targeted communities and audiences. You understand the language, culture, and tonality required when communicating with and about artists, dancers, and creative communities, allowing you to build authentic connections and meaningful stories.

3+ years of experience in Communications, ideally within culture, entertainment, or creative projects.

Experience in developing communication strategies, media relations, PR, and content distribution across owned, earned, and managed channels.

Strong project management skills, with the ability to plan, prioritize, and manage multiple projects simultaneously while collaborating effectively with agencies, international stakeholders, and cross-functional teams.

Excellent storytelling, written, and verbal communication skills, with strong presentation abilities.

Highly organized, proactive, and structured, with a collaborative team-player mindset and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

Fluent in English; German or other languages are a plus.

However, our attractive compensation package is based on market-oriented salaries and is therefore significantly above the stated minimum salary.

As a Principal Test Engineer, you will offer mentorship to test engineers and serve as a technical subject matter expert for test events and documentation peer reviews. You will spearhead complex testing initiatives, ensuring our products meet the highest standards of performance, reliability, and compliance.

Our testing approach evolves with the design maturity, extending from initial stages through to post-production follow-ups on subsequent articles.

The role involves extensive system testing, aimed at assessing a broad spectrum of mission equipment such as communication, computing, navigation, and surveillance systems, to ensure they meet design and functionality standards.

Please note, this role does not require any knowledge or skills related to software or automation testing.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead strategic planning for testing initiatives and projects.
  • Develop and implement innovative testing methodologies and processes.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert, providing guidance and mentorship to test engineering teams.
  • Oversee the execution of the most critical and complex testing projects.
  • Foster strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to drive testing excellence.
  • Ensure that the sequence of test events accounts for safety risk management, including identifying potential risks and implementing mitigations, to conduct tests safely and effectively.

Qualifications You Must Have:

  • Bachelor's of Science in Engineering or related field.
  • 14+ years of experience in test engineering or a related role.
  • Higher level relevant degree may substitute for experience.
  • Extensive experience in advanced testing principles and methodologies.
  • Thorough understanding and ability to interpret engineering principles and practices.
  • Progressive Experience leading in multi-disciplinary design and development teams.
  • Advanced Knowledge of requirements management, system design, and systems integration.
  • Demonstrated expertise planning, conducting and documenting Verification and Validation (V&V) activities.
  • The ability to obtain and maintain a Top Secret U.S. Security Clearance is required.

Qualifications We Prefer:

  • Graduate of a recognized Test Pilot School - United States Naval Test Pilot School, United States Air Force Test Pilot School or National Test Pilot School, etc.
  • Recognized contributions to the field of test engineering.
  • Experience with various testing equipment, standards, and methodologies to include manual and automated testing.
  • Extensive experience authoring complex and professional test plans, test procedures, and test reports in order to demonstrate compliance to system requirements.
  • Experience Product and Quality Assurance principles and experienced in generation and disposition of product non-conformances.
  • Experience performing certification testing for various certification organizations (i.e. FAA, NASA, DoD).
  • Experience conducting testing per MIL-STD-810, DO-160, or other similar industry methods and standards.
  • Ability to read schematics, use service manuals, follow test procedures, and use logical trouble shooting techniques.
  • Extensive experience in the Aerospace and Defense Industry.

Essential Functions:

  • Ability to work on a computer for extended periods.
  • Ability to lift up to 25 lbs regularly.
  • Occasional travel may be required.
  • Ability to work in an office, lab, hangar, or offsite environment.

This posting will be open for application for a minimum of 5 days and may be extended based on business needs.

SNC offers annual incentive pay based upon performance that is commensurate with the level of the position.

SNC offers a generous benefit package, including medical, dental, and vision plans, 401(k) with 150% match up to 6%, life insurance, 3 weeks paid time off, tuition reimbursement, and more.

IMPORTANT NOTICE:

This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a Top Secret U.S. Security Clearance. U.S. Citizenship status is required as this position needs an active U.S. Security Clearance for employment. Non-U.S. Citizens may not be eligible to obtain a security clearance. The Department of Defense Consolidated Adjudications Facility (DoD CAF), a federal government agency, handles the adjudicative aspects of the security clearance eligibility process for industry applicants. Adjudicative factors which affect the outcome of the eligibility determination include, but are not limited to, allegiance to the U.S., foreign influence, foreign preference, criminal conduct, security violations and illegal drug use.
